threads.title_zh: CFTC提出CTX与CAM规则，建立联邦加密交易所框架
threads.title_en: CFTC Proposes CTX and CAM Rules to Establish Federal Crypto Exchange Framework
threads.summary_zh: CFTC 主席 Michael Selig 表示，拟议的 Reg CTX 规则将允许交易所在加密现货交易中提供零售保证金、杠杆和融资，其要求与永续合约对齐（最高约 7 倍），而配套的 Reg CAM 将为仅提供现货杠杆的交易所设立联邦“加密资产市场”牌照，目标是在数月内完成定稿。
threads.summary_en: CFTC Chair Michael Selig said the proposed Reg CTX rule would allow exchanges to offer retail margin, leverage and financing on crypto spot trading with requirements aligned to perpetual futures (~7x max), while companion Reg CAM would create a federal 'crypto asset market' license for spot-leverage-only exchanges, with finalization targeted within months.
threads.latest_update_zh: CFTC 主席 Michael Selig 表示，拟议的 Reg CTX 规则将允许交易所在加密现货交易中提供零售保证金、杠杆和融资，其要求与永续合约对齐（最高约 7 倍），而配套的 Reg CAM 将为仅提供现货杠杆的交易所设立联邦“加密资产市场”牌照，目标是在数月内完成定稿。
threads.latest_update_en: CFTC Chair Michael Selig said the proposed Reg CTX rule would allow exchanges to offer retail margin, leverage and financing on crypto spot trading with requirements aligned to perpetual futures (~7x max), while companion Reg CAM would create a federal 'crypto asset market' license for spot-leverage-only exchanges, with finalization targeted within months.
threads.background_zh: 2010 年《多德-弗兰克华尔街改革与消费者保护法案》是这场围绕 CFTC 权限之争的核心法律。预测市场服务商持有 CFTC 颁发的指定合约市场（DCM）牌照。法庭之友意见书是由非案件正式当事方提交的倡导性文件；最高法院每年收到数千份调卷令申请，但仅受理其中很小一部分。在正式发布之前，CFTC 已将这两项预测市场规则制定案送交白宫信息与监管事务办公室（OIRA）审查。
threads.background_en: The 2010 Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act is the law at the center of the argument over the CFTC's authority here. Prediction market providers operate under designated contract market (DCM) licenses issued by the CFTC. An amicus brief is an advocacy filing by a party that is not formally part of the case; the Supreme Court receives thousands of certiorari petitions a year but grants review in only a small fraction. The CFTC had sent both prediction-market rulemakings to the White House Office of Information and Regulatory Affairs for review before they were issued.
threads.latest_summary_zh: CFTC Chair Michael Selig said the proposed Reg CTX rule would allow exchanges to offer retail margin, leverage and financing on crypto spot trading with requirements aligned to perpetual futures (~7x max), while companion Reg CAM would create a federal 'crypto asset market' license for spot-leverage-only exchanges, with finalization targeted within months.
threads.latest_summary_en: CFTC Chair Michael Selig said the proposed Reg CTX rule would allow exchanges to offer retail margin, leverage and financing on crypto spot trading with requirements aligned to perpetual futures (~7x max), while companion Reg CAM would create a federal 'crypto asset market' license for spot-leverage-only exchanges, with finalization targeted within months.
threads.market_impact_zh: 这场争议决定的是由 CFTC 还是由各州来制定体育类事件合约的上架与准入规则，因此直接承受监管风险的是预测市场平台以及其他提供事件合约的场所，包括与加密相关的衍生品交易场所。临时最终规则将赌场式博彩产品排除在互换定义之外，而配套提案又拟将事件合约纳入互换定义，这改变了上述场所所适用的合规基准。
threads.market_impact_en: The dispute determines which regulator — the CFTC or individual states — sets the listing and access rules for sports-based event contracts, so prediction-market platforms and other venues offering event contracts, including crypto-adjacent derivatives venues, carry the direct regulatory exposure. The interim final rule's exclusion of casino-style gambling products from the swap definition, and the companion proposal to define swaps to include event contracts, change the compliance baseline those venues operate under.

timeline.text_zh: CFTC 主席 Michael Selig 表示，拟议的 Reg CTX 规则将允许交易所在加密现货交易中提供零售保证金、杠杆和融资，其要求与永续合约对齐（最高约 7 倍），而配套的 Reg CAM 将为仅提供现货杠杆的交易所设立联邦“加密资产市场”牌照，目标是在数月内完成定稿。
timeline.text_en: CFTC Chair Michael Selig said the proposed Reg CTX rule would allow exchanges to offer retail margin, leverage and financing on crypto spot trading with requirements aligned to perpetual futures (~7x max), while companion Reg CAM would create a federal 'crypto asset market' license for spot-leverage-only exchanges, with finalization targeted within months.

timeline.text_zh:
上周，包括前参议员 Chris Dodd、前 CFTC 与 SEC 主席 Gary Gensler、美国职业橄榄球大联盟（NFL）、39 个州及哥伦比亚特区以及 145 个部落民族在内的一批相关方提交了法庭之友意见书，敦促美国最高法院受理“以体育为基础的预测市场合约是否属于互换（swap）”这一问题。上周五，CFTC 就同一问题发布了两项方案，其中一项为已即刻生效的临时最终规则。

目前上诉法院之间已出现重大分歧：两个上诉法院裁定涉及体育的预测市场属于博彩产品、应由各州监管，而另一个上诉法院则裁定这属于 CFTC 的管辖范围。

Dodd 的意见书主张，《多德-弗兰克法案》的立法本意并非赋予 CFTC 取代各州博彩监管的权力，并指出将多个投注串联起来的“串关”（parlay）并不具有对冲或价格发现功能，因此不属于《商品交易法》下的互换；他还反驳了 CFTC 所获“专属管辖权”构成明确优先适用（preemption）条款的说法。据 CFTC 称，该临时最终规则将其长期立场成文化，即包括体育博彩和赌场投注在内的赌场式博彩产品被排除在“互换”定义之外，而另一项提案则将进一步把事件合约纳入互换的定义。
timeline.text_en: A coalition including former officials, the NFL, 39 states and 145 tribal nations filed amicus briefs urging the Supreme Court to weigh in on whether sports-based prediction market contracts are swaps, while the CFTC issued two proposals — one an interim final rule already in effect — setting out its own position on the question.

timeline.text_zh: CFTC提案明确将体育、政治、文化和天气事件合约纳入掉期定义，并发布临时最终规则排除体育博彩和赌场赌注，进一步划定预测市场与赌博的联邦界限。
timeline.text_en: The CFTC proposed expressly including sports, political, cultural and weather event contracts in the swap definition and issued an interim final rule excluding sportsbook and casino wagers, further drawing the federal line between prediction markets and gambling.

threads.title_zh: Bitmine 持续买入以太坊并计划在持仓达到 5% 后停止
threads.title_en: Bitmine keeps buying Ethereum and plans to stop once holdings reach 5%
threads.summary_zh: BitMine 持有约 6,041,481 枚 ETH（约占总供应量 4.9%），仍低于其设定的 5% 硬上限，继续增持中；同时持有 215 枚 BTC 和 5.82 亿美元现金及有价证券。
threads.summary_en: BitMine holds approximately 6,041,481 ETH (~4.9% of total supply), still below its 5% hard cap and continuing accumulation; it also holds 215 BTC and $582 million in cash and securities.
threads.latest_update_zh: Bitmine 过去一周增持 12,535 枚 ETH，截至 2026 年 10 月 18 日持仓增至 6,041,481 枚 ETH（约占总供应量 4.9%），并披露持有 215 枚 BTC 及 5.82 亿美元现金及有价证券。
threads.latest_update_en: Bitmine added 12,535 ETH over the past week, raising its treasury to 6,041,481 ETH (~4.9% of total supply) as of Oct 18, 2026, and disclosed holdings of 215 BTC plus $582 million in cash and securities.
threads.background_zh: 以太坊的权益证明系统将共识影响力赋予验证者，其签名密钥授权区块提议与证明，因此拥有为验证者提供资金的 ETH 本身并不能揭示谁能够履行这些职责。质押安排通常分离三种角色：ETH 所有者、节点运营商以及签名密钥的托管方，而以太坊将签名密钥与提款凭证分离的设计，旨在降低委托质押时的信任假设。分布式验证者技术更进一步，将单个验证者的签名密钥拆分到多台机器和多个运营商上，从而消除单点故障。
threads.background_en: Ethereum's proof-of-stake system assigns consensus influence to validators, whose signing keys authorize block proposals and attestations, so owning the ETH that funds a validator does not by itself reveal who can perform those duties. Staking arrangements commonly separate three roles — the ETH owner, the node operator, and whoever custodies the signing keys — and Ethereum's design of separating signing keys from withdrawal credentials is meant to reduce trust assumptions when staking is delegated. Distributed validator technology goes further by splitting a single validator's signing key across multiple machines and operators, removing single points of failure.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Bitmine added 12,535 ETH over the past week, bringing its treasury to 6,041,481 ETH, or 4.9% of Ethereum's total supply, alongside 215 BTC and $582 million in cash and securities.
threads.latest_summary_en: Bitmine added 12,535 ETH over the past week, bringing its treasury to 6,041,481 ETH, or 4.9% of Ethereum's total supply, alongside 215 BTC and $582 million in cash and securities.
threads.market_impact_zh: 其传导路径在于市场结构而非价格：它影响与 ETH 质押相关的资金流、机构托管与质押服务配置决策，以及市场参与者对以太坊最终确定性与抗审查风险的评估。若更多第三方 ETH 通过 MAVAN 迁移到与 BitMine 相关的基础设施上，将扩大运营商构成与密钥托管仍不透明的资金池，因此验证者群组与签名密钥的披露是这一事件传导至市场的主要渠道。
threads.market_impact_en: The transmission runs through market structure rather than price: it matters for ETH staking-related flows, for institutional custody and staking-service allocation decisions, and for how participants assess Ethereum's finality and censorship-resistance risk. Any further migration of third-party ETH onto BitMine-linked infrastructure through MAVAN would widen the pool whose operator mix and key custody remain opaque, making validator-cohort and signing-key disclosures the main channel through which this story reaches markets.

timeline.text_en: Bitmine added 12,535 ETH over the past week, raising its treasury to 6,041,481 ETH (~4.9% of total supply) as of Oct 18, 2026, and disclosed holdings of 215 BTC plus $582 million in cash and securities.

timeline.text_zh: Tom Lee 在新加坡 Token2049 表示，BitMine 已将持有 ETH 流通供应量的 5% 设为硬上限，达到后停止买入；当前持有约 6,016,414 枚 ETH（占比约 4.9%），还需约 9 万至 10 万枚 ETH 触及上限，预计需 6–7 周。停止增持后无需再为买币融资。
timeline.text_en: At Token2049 Singapore, Tom Lee said BitMine has set a hard cap of 5% of ETH circulating supply and will stop buying once reached; it currently holds ~6,016,414 ETH (~4.9% of supply), needs ~90k–100k more ETH to hit the cap, expected in 6–7 weeks. After stopping, no further financing for purchases is needed.

timeline.text_zh: Tom Lee表示，Bitmine在持有以太坊总供应量5%后将停止买入，结束自2025年年中开始的增持行动，这一行动曾使该公司成为全球最大的以太坊储备机构。
timeline.text_en: Tom Lee said Bitmine will stop buying ether once it holds 5% of the token's supply, ending an accumulation streak that began in mid-2025 and made the company the world's largest Ethereum treasury.

threads.title_zh: 持有超200万枚$SOL（约2.2亿美元）的SkyAI疑似正在亏损抛售$SOL！
threads.title_en: SkyAI, which holds over 2M $SOL($220M), appears to be dumping $SOL at a loss!
threads.summary_zh: SkyAI 已完成全部 SOL 清仓，并正式启动每股/每份 3 美元、最多覆盖 95% 股份及认股权证的现金要约收购，资金全部来自约 2.238 亿美元现金储备，要约不再设 SOL 价格条件，将于 10 月 30 日到期；此前大股东 Bastion Trading 对该要约的反对仍属事件背景。
threads.summary_en: SkyAI has fully liquidated its SOL holdings and formally launched a $3 per share/warrant cash tender offer for up to 95% of shares and warrants, funded entirely from about $223.8M in cash, with no SOL-price condition, expiring Oct 30; Bastion Trading's earlier opposition to the offer remains part of the event backdrop.
threads.latest_update_zh: SkyAI 已于 10 月 16 日启动现金要约收购，以每股或每份 3 美元收购最多 95% 的已发行普通股及认股权证，全额认购时总金额约 2.013 亿美元；公司称截至 10 月 16 日已出售全部 SOL，持有约 2.238 亿美元现金，要约不再以 SOL 价格为条件，并将于 10 月 30 日到期。
threads.latest_update_en: SkyAI launched its cash tender offer on Oct 16 at $3 per share or warrant for up to 95% of outstanding shares and warrants, totaling about $201.3M if fully subscribed; it said that as of Oct 16 it had sold all SOL and held about $223.8M cash, so the offer is no longer conditioned on SOL price and expires Oct 30.
threads.background_zh: 数字资产储备型公司（DAT）以持币作为上市公司资产，Solana 板块的储备积累竞争近期加剧，Forward Industries、DFDV 等公司均公布过数百万枚 SOL 的持仓。SkyAI 此次事件的核心，在于上市储备型公司如何披露和执行其核心储备的出售，以及 Form 8-K 这一用于向股东报告重大事件的 SEC 申报文件。
threads.background_en: Digital asset treasury (DAT) companies hold crypto on their balance sheets as a listed-market vehicle, and the Solana segment has seen intensifying accumulation, with firms such as Forward Industries and DFDV reporting multi-million SOL positions. SkyAI's situation centers on how a listed treasury vehicle discloses and executes sales of its core reserve, and on the Form 8-K, the SEC filing companies use to report major events to shareholders.
threads.latest_summary_zh: SkyAI (SKYA) has sold its entire SOL holdings and launched a cash tender offer at $3 per share or warrant for up to 95% of its outstanding shares and warrants — roughly $201.3M at about 0.95x net asset value, expiring Oct 30 and funded entirely from its $223.8M cash reserve, with no SOL-price condition.
threads.latest_summary_en: SkyAI (SKYA) has sold its entire SOL holdings and launched a cash tender offer at $3 per share or warrant for up to 95% of its outstanding shares and warrants — roughly $201.3M at about 0.95x net asset value, expiring Oct 30 and funded entirely from its $223.8M cash reserve, with no SOL-price condition.
threads.market_impact_zh: 此次处置将约 157 万枚此前由公司金库持有的 SOL 投放至市场，构成对 SOL 流动性与供给的直接渠道。被质疑的要约收购还关系到上市 SOL 储备型公司的溢价水平与融资能力，并可能通过情绪渠道传导至整个 DAT 板块。
threads.market_impact_en: The disposal places roughly 1.57 million SOL of previously treasury-held supply into the market, a direct channel to SOL liquidity and supply. The contested tender offer also bears on the premium-to-NAV and financing capacity of listed SOL treasury vehicles, which can transmit to sentiment across the DAT segment.

timeline.text_zh: 10月13日Form 8-K显示SkyAI的SOL持仓已降至约60万枚，较9月中旬“逾200万枚”减少约七成；持有约9.99%流通普通股的大股东Bastion Trading公开质疑公司10月11日宣布的每股3.00美元现金要约收购，要求立即全面披露SOL处置细节、启动独立审查、改组董事会，并将要约价提高至至少每股3.50美元，否则不会参与。

timeline.text_zh: SkyAI 披露已出售 100 万枚 SOL、套现约 1.07 亿美元，并表示可能继续出售；链上数据显示自 10 月初以来累计转出约 157 万枚 SOL（约 1.75 亿美元），按约 194 美元均价计算浮亏超过 1.6 亿美元。
timeline.text_en: SkyAI disclosed it has sold 1 million SOL for about $107M and signaled possible further sales; on-chain data now shows about 1.57M SOL (~$175M) moved out since early October, with unrealized losses exceeding $160M on a ~$194 average cost basis.

threads.title_zh: MSCI 通过规则，可能将 Strategy 等投资控股公司剔除出全球股票指数
threads.title_en: Strategy Faces Fresh Threat of Removal from MSCI Global Equity Indexes
threads.summary_zh: MSCI已敲定非经营性公司指数排除规则，将于11月30日收盘生效，受影响名单11月11日公布；临时宽限措施被取消，Strategy和Metaplanet面临被剔除风险，被动基金可能被迫抛售；Metaplanet已进行BTC买卖操作以示主动管理，Strategy继续增持，Saylor批评规则具有歧视性。
threads.summary_en: MSCI has finalized the non-operating company exclusion rule, effective at the close of Nov. 30, with the affected list due Nov. 11; the temporary reprieve is scrapped, Strategy and Metaplanet face removal risk, and passive funds may be forced to sell; Metaplanet has executed BTC sales and buybacks to show active management, Strategy kept accumulating, and Saylor criticized the rule as discriminatory.
threads.latest_update_zh: MSCI新规将于11月30日收盘生效，并废除此前对数字资产占总资产50%以上公司的临时宽限；Metaplanet卖出1万枚BTC并回购1.1万枚以展示主动资金管理，Strategy则继续增持；Saylor称该规则具有歧视性。
threads.latest_update_en: The MSCI rule takes effect at the close of Nov. 30, and its temporary reprieve for companies with 50%+ digital-asset holdings is scrapped; Metaplanet sold 10,000 BTC and bought back 11,000 to demonstrate active treasury management, while Strategy kept accumulating; Saylor called the rule discriminatory.
threads.background_zh: 此次规则通过之前经历了一轮咨询，Strategy（MSTR）曾致信要求 MSCI 撤回该提案，称其只是把 MSCI 于 2026 年 1 月 6 日撤回的数字资产专项规则重新包装，相关内容由 CryptoTimes 报道。另据 TradingView 转载的 Cointelegraph 报道，一家比特币政策智库也对 MSCI 制定该提案的过程提出质疑。MSCI 全球可投资市场指数是包括 MSCI ACWI IMI 在内的基准指数的编制基础。
threads.background_en: The adoption follows a consultation in which Strategy (MSTR) asked MSCI to withdraw the proposal, describing it as a repackaging of a digital-asset-specific rule the index provider had withdrawn on January 6, 2026, according to a letter reported by CryptoTimes. A Bitcoin policy think tank has separately questioned how MSCI developed the proposal, per a Cointelegraph report carried by TradingView. MSCI's Global Investable Market Indexes underpin benchmarks including the MSCI ACWI IMI.
threads.latest_summary_zh: MSCI finalized rules that will exclude 'non-operating' Bitcoin-treasury companies like Strategy and Metaplanet from its Global Investable Market Indexes effective Nov. 30, potentially forcing passive funds to sell their shares and removing a key source of demand.
threads.latest_summary_en: MSCI finalized rules that will exclude 'non-operating' Bitcoin-treasury companies like Strategy and Metaplanet from its Global Investable Market Indexes effective Nov. 30, potentially forcing passive funds to sell their shares and removing a key source of demand.
threads.market_impact_zh: 传导路径来自指数纳入规则与被动资金流：若最终名单确认剔除，追踪 MSCI 全球可投资市场指数的基金将不得不减少对 MSTR、Metaplanet 等上市比特币储备型股票的持仓，从而影响这一作为 BTC 敞口主要上市代理标的板块的流动性与情绪。SharpLink 被列入观察名单，意味着另一批数字资产储备型股票同样处于这一审查流程之下。
threads.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through index inclusion rules and passive fund flows: if the final list confirms removals, funds tracking MSCI's Global Investable Market Indexes would have to reduce exposure to MSTR, Metaplanet and other listed bitcoin-treasury equities, affecting liquidity and sentiment in the segment that serves as the main listed proxy for BTC exposure. SharpLink's watchlist status keeps a second group of digital-asset treasury stocks exposed to the same review process.

threads.title_zh: Ledger 硬件钱包供应链植入窃密组件事件
threads.title_en: Ledger Hardware Wallet Supply Chain Implant Seed Theft Incident
threads.summary_zh: Ledger披露，一个高度组织化的犯罪团伙花费数百万美元购买正版Ledger设备，植入隐藏组件以在初始化过程中窃取助记词，并通过东南亚分销商转售，促使Ledger暂停销售并更改东南亚和香港授权经销商的交付规则，同时与执法部门和SEAL 911合作追踪资金。
threads.summary_en: Ledger disclosed that a highly organized criminal group spent millions of dollars buying genuine Ledger devices, implanting hidden components to steal seed phrases during initialization and reselling them via Southeast Asian distributors, prompting Ledger to suspend sales and change delivery rules at authorized resellers in Southeast Asia and Hong Kong while it works with law enforcement and SEAL 911 to trace the funds.
threads.latest_update_zh: Ledger披露，一个高度组织化的犯罪团伙花费数百万美元购买正版Ledger设备，植入隐藏组件以在初始化过程中窃取助记词，并通过东南亚分销商转售，促使Ledger暂停销售并更改东南亚和香港授权经销商的交付规则，同时与执法部门和SEAL 911合作追踪资金。
threads.latest_update_en: Ledger disclosed that a highly organized criminal group spent millions of dollars buying genuine Ledger devices, implanting hidden components to steal seed phrases during initialization and reselling them via Southeast Asian distributors, prompting Ledger to suspend sales and change delivery rules at authorized resellers in Southeast Asia and Hong Kong while it works with law enforcement and SEAL 911 to trace the funds.
threads.background_zh: 据BleepingComputer报道，此次篡改据称涉及一种混入正品硬件的间谍植入物，并未改动安全芯片或Ledger固件，因此Ledger的真伪校验（Genuine Check）仍然通过。助记词是恢复加密钱包的“主密钥”，因此记录助记词的设备会把资金控制权交给攻击者。此事发生在7月底Coldcard助记词风波之后。
threads.background_en: The tampering reportedly involved a spy implant that blended into legitimate hardware without altering the secure chip or Ledger's firmware, so Ledger's Genuine Check still passed, according to BleepingComputer. A seed phrase is the master key that restores access to a crypto wallet, so a device that records it hands an attacker full control of the funds. The incident follows the Coldcard seed phrase debacle at the end of July.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Ledger disclosed that a highly organized criminal group spent millions of dollars buying genuine Ledger devices, implanting hidden components to steal seed phrases during initialization and reselling them via Southeast Asian distributors, prompting Ledger to suspend sales and change delivery rules at authorized resellers in Southeast Asia and Hong Kong while it works with law enforcement and SEAL 911 to trace the funds.
threads.latest_summary_en: Ledger disclosed that a highly organized criminal group spent millions of dollars buying genuine Ledger devices, implanting hidden components to steal seed phrases during initialization and reselling them via Southeast Asian distributors, prompting Ledger to suspend sales and change delivery rules at authorized resellers in Southeast Asia and Hong Kong while it works with law enforcement and SEAL 911 to trace the funds.
threads.market_impact_zh: 经销商停售使东南亚自托管硬件钱包这一细分市场的风险集中显现——依赖第三方经销商的买家若买到会记录助记词的被篡改设备，其资产的托管安全将直接暴露；Ledger称已确认盗窃仅限于亚洲，是主要的范围限定。另外，韩国屏蔽27家未注册交易所网站，是在应用之外进一步限制本国用户的网页访问渠道；泰国的ETF规则则为比特币和以太坊敞口打开了一条受监管的境内通道。
threads.market_impact_en: The reseller suspension concentrates risk in the self-custody hardware wallet segment in South East Asia, where buyers relying on third-party resellers face custody exposure if a tampered device records their seed phrase; Ledger's statement limiting confirmed thefts to Asia is the main scope caveat. Separately, South Korea's move to block 27 unregistered exchange websites restricts domestic access through the web rather than apps, while Thailand's ETF rules open a regulated onshore channel for Bitcoin and Ether exposure.

timeline.text_zh: Chainalysis 报告称，一名任务诈骗者因购买三台被篡改的 Ledger 设备而损失 60 BTC（约 480 万美元）；同一供应链攻击的链上被盗资金总额增至逾 1.034 亿美元，涉及 530 个地址。
timeline.text_en: Chainalysis reported a task-scammer lost 60 BTC (~$4.8M) after buying three tampered Ledger devices; the same supply-chain attack's onchain theft total rose to over $103.4M across 530 addresses.

timeline.text_zh: Ledger披露，一个有组织团伙花费数月时间将恶意硬件植入正版Ledger设备，并通过东南亚转售渠道重新分销，以拦截助记词并盗取用户资产；同时确认其安全芯片、BOLOS操作系统和服务器基础设施未遭入侵。
timeline.text_en: Ledger disclosed that an organized syndicate spent months implanting malicious hardware into genuine Ledger devices and redistributing them through Southeast Asian resale channels to intercept seed phrases and drain user assets, while confirming its secure element chips, BOLOS OS, and server infrastructure were not compromised.

threads.title_zh: Anthropic 推进 IPO 进程，纽约市审计长呼吁推迟
threads.title_en: Anthropic advances IPO process as NYC Comptroller urges delay
threads.summary_zh: 纽约市审计长马克·莱文敦促Anthropic推迟其计划的IPO，直到解决AI安全与治理风险，并警告称IPO后若发生重大安全事件可能损害公共养老金投资者，Anthropic已开始与其办公室进行讨论。
threads.summary_en: New York City Comptroller Mark Levine urged Anthropic to postpone its planned IPO until it resolves AI safety and governance risks, warning that a major post-IPO safety incident could harm public pension investors, and Anthropic has begun discussions with his office.
threads.latest_update_zh: 纽约市审计长马克·莱文敦促Anthropic推迟其计划的IPO，直到解决AI安全与治理风险，并警告称IPO后若发生重大安全事件可能损害公共养老金投资者，Anthropic已开始与其办公室进行讨论。
threads.latest_update_en: New York City Comptroller Mark Levine urged Anthropic to postpone its planned IPO until it resolves AI safety and governance risks, warning that a major post-IPO safety incident could harm public pension investors, and Anthropic has begun discussions with his office.
threads.background_zh: Anthropic 是一家 AI 安全与研究公司，以公益公司（public benefit corporation）形式运营，由包括 Amodei 兄妹在内的前 OpenAI 员工创立。若完成 IPO，公司将由私募持股转为公开上市。
threads.background_en: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that operates as a public benefit corporation and was founded by former OpenAI staff, including siblings Dario and Daniela Amodei. An IPO would move the company from private ownership into public markets.
threads.latest_summary_zh: New York City Comptroller Mark Levine urged Anthropic to postpone its planned IPO until it resolves AI safety and governance risks, warning that a major post-IPO safety incident could harm public pension investors, and Anthropic has begun discussions with his office.
threads.latest_summary_en: New York City Comptroller Mark Levine urged Anthropic to postpone its planned IPO until it resolves AI safety and governance risks, warning that a major post-IPO safety incident could harm public pension investors, and Anthropic has begun discussions with his office.
threads.market_impact_zh: Anthropic 并未发行代币，因此对加密市场的传导是间接的：一方面通过 AI 叙事类代币的市场情绪，另一方面是这样一笔大型 AI 股票上市可能吸走机构配置资金、加剧风险资本竞争。按其报道中的规模，这一事件更可能影响 AI 相关加密板块的情绪与流动性，而非某一具体资产。
threads.market_impact_en: Anthropic issues no token, so any crypto-market transmission would be indirect — through sentiment toward AI-narrative tokens and through competition for risk capital as a large AI equity listing absorbs institutional allocations. The scale of the reported offering makes it a potential sentiment and liquidity factor for AI-adjacent crypto segments rather than for any single asset.

timeline.text_en: New York City Comptroller Mark Levine sent a letter to Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei urging the company to postpone its IPO until it addresses AI safety, governance and development-speed risks and discloses concrete audit and control measures.

threads.title_zh: Character.AI申请破产后迪士尼同意聘用其多数员工并收购部分资产
threads.title_en: Character.AI申请破产：创始人回归谷歌、CEO转投迪士尼，平台面临关停
threads.summary_zh: Character.AI破产出售程序推进中：迪士尼拟以2000万美元获得部分技术/专利的永久非独占许可，并以约1.8亿美元三年成本接收66名员工；公司申请破产时仅剩18名全职员工，40名州总检察长介入保护用户聊天记录，11月20日为竞购截止日，若无人接盘平台将关闭。
threads.summary_en: Character.AI’s bankruptcy sale process is advancing: Disney is poised to pay $20 million for perpetual non-exclusive rights to some technology and patents and to hire 66 employees at an expected cost of about $180 million over three years; the company had only 18 full-time staff at filing, 40 state attorneys general intervened to protect user chat records, and November 20 is the bid deadline, with shutdown possible if no buyer keeps the platform running.
threads.latest_update_zh: 破产法院文件显示，迪士尼已向Character.AI的66名员工发出工作邀请，预计三年投入约1.8亿美元（含3000万美元留任奖励），而对其部分技术和专利仅报价2000万美元；Character.AI申请破产时仅剩18名全职员工；40名州总检察长介入要求保护用户聊天记录；其他买家须在11月20日前提交竞购报价，否则平台可能关闭。
threads.latest_update_en: Bankruptcy court filings show Disney had offered jobs to 66 Character.AI employees, expecting to spend about $180 million over three years including $30 million in retention bonuses, while bidding only $20 million for perpetual non-exclusive rights to some technology and patents; Character.AI had only 18 full-time staff when it filed; 40 state attorneys general intervened to protect user chat records; other bidders must submit offers by November 20 or the platform may shut down.
threads.background_zh: Character.AI 是一项生成式 AI 聊天机器人服务，用户可与可自定义的角色对话；该公司由两名前谷歌员工创立，曾获 Andreessen Horowitz 领投的 1.5 亿美元融资，估值达 10 亿美元。2026 年 9 月，迪士尼宣布 Character.AI 时任首席执行官 Karandeep Anand 将出任公司新设立的首位首席技术官，自 10 月 2 日起生效。
threads.background_en: Character.AI is a generative AI chatbot service where users converse with customizable characters; it was founded by two former Google employees and raised $150 million led by Andreessen Horowitz at a $1 billion valuation. Disney announced in September 2026 that Karandeep Anand, formerly Character.AI's chief executive, would become its first chief technology officer, a newly created position, effective October 2.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Character.AI entered bankruptcy with only 18 full-time staff as Disney moved to hire 66 employees for about $180M over three years, while 40 state attorneys general intervened to protect user chat records ahead of a November 20 bid deadline that could lead to shutdown.
threads.latest_summary_en: Character.AI entered bankruptcy with only 18 full-time staff as Disney moved to hire 66 employees for about $180M over three years, while 40 state attorneys general intervened to protect user chat records ahead of a November 20 bid deadline that could lead to shutdown.
threads.market_impact_zh: 该交易涉及一家私营 AI 初创公司与一家传统媒体公司，二者均无直接的加密资产敞口；其对数字资产市场的影响仅可能通过市场对 AI 相关代币的情绪传导，而非流动性、托管或供给渠道。
threads.market_impact_en: The transaction involves a private AI startup and a traditional media company with no direct crypto exposure; any effect on digital-asset markets would run only through sentiment toward AI-related tokens rather than through liquidity, custody or supply channels.

timeline.text_en: Disney agreed to hire the majority of Character.AI’s workforce and acquire some of its assets for $20 million after the chatbot startup filed for bankruptcy.

timeline.text_zh: 新增：公司预计在11月底至12月初完成出售；平台目前尚未关停，并称若找不到愿意继续运营的买家将停止服务；前CEO Karandeep Anand已于10月2日加入迪士尼任CTO，部分技术员工随之转投，并在出售期间暂时帮助维持平台运营。
timeline.text_en: Added: the company expects to complete the sale between late November and early December; the platform has not yet shut down and will stop if no buyer willing to keep operating it is found; former CEO Karandeep Anand joined Disney as CTO on October 2, with some technical staff moving with him and temporarily helping keep the platform running during the sale.

threads.title_zh: ENSv2 激活提案将停止新的 ENSv1 注册
threads.title_en: ENSv2 Activation Proposal Would Halt New ENSv1 Registrations
threads.summary_zh: ENSv2 激活提案已进入链上投票阶段（结束时间 10 月 25 日 13:32），早期投票约 100% 赞成但尚未达到法定票数；若通过，15 项操作将原子执行：v1 注册器冻结新 .eth 注册、开放 v2 注册与迁移、v2 合约管理权限移交 DAO、已获批的涨价方案生效，现有持有人无需操作且迁移无截止期限。
threads.summary_en: The ENSv2 activation proposal is now in an onchain vote (ending 25 October 13:32 UTC); early voting is ~100% in favor but quorum is not yet met. If passed, 15 actions execute atomically: the v1 registrar freezes new .eth registrations, v2 registration and migration open, v2 contract admin control transfers to the DAO, and the previously approved fee increase takes effect; existing holders need no action and migration has no deadline.
threads.latest_update_zh: ENS DAO 已就该 ENSv2 激活提案启动链上投票，投票于 10 月 25 日 13:32 结束；截至发稿 6 个钱包投出 531,252 枚 ENS，赞成约 100%，但未达法定票数；提案包含 15 项操作，由 DAO 控制的执行合约一次性全部执行，任一失败则全部不生效；此前已获批的定价方案自执行起生效，5 个字符及以上域名年费由 5 美元上调至 8 美元。
threads.latest_update_en: ENS DAO opened onchain voting on the ENSv2 activation proposal, with voting ending 25 October 13:32; as of publication 6 wallets had cast 531,252 ENS, roughly 100% in favor, but quorum had not been reached; the proposal bundles 15 actions executed atomically by a DAO-controlled executor contract, and a previously approved pricing scheme takes effect on execution, raising annual fees for 5+ character domains from $5 to $8.
threads.background_zh: ENS 是以太坊的域名服务协议，将可读名称映射到地址及其他链上资源。据 ENS 官方文档，ENSv2 是对协议智能合约的重新构建，目标是让协议更具可扩展性、模块化并面向未来，同时配套面向现有域名的迁移方案。该草案发布在 ENS DAO 治理论坛，这里是协议与元治理决策的讨论场所。
threads.background_en: ENS is Ethereum's naming protocol, mapping human-readable names to addresses and other onchain resources. ENSv2 is presented in ENS documentation as a rebuild of the protocol's smart contracts intended to make it more scalable, modular and future-proof, together with a migration strategy for existing names. The draft was posted on the ENS DAO governance forum, the venue used for protocol and meta-governance decisions.
threads.latest_summary_zh: ENS DAO opened on-chain voting on a 15-action proposal to activate ENSv2 on Ethereum mainnet, which would freeze new v1 .eth registrations, open v2 registration and migration, hand v2 contract control to the DAO, and apply a previously approved pricing scheme raising annual fees for 5+ character domains from $5 to $8.
threads.latest_summary_en: ENS DAO opened on-chain voting on a 15-action proposal to activate ENSv2 on Ethereum mainnet, which would freeze new v1 .eth registrations, open v2 registration and migration, hand v2 contract control to the DAO, and apply a previously approved pricing scheme raising annual fees for 5+ character domains from $5 to $8.
threads.market_impact_zh: 该提案涉及 ENS DAO 治理与 .eth 域名市场：v2 合约管理权限移交 DAO，意味着后续升级的控制权转向代币持有人治理；宽限期缩短则改变过期域名在被重新注册前的保留时长。对 ENS 代币或 .eth 域名二级市场的传导，主要通过治理机制与域名供给规则，而非协议收入或流动性渠道。
threads.market_impact_en: The proposal touches ENS DAO governance and the .eth name market: the transfer of v2 contract admin roles to the DAO shifts control over future upgrades to token-holder governance, while the shorter grace period changes how long expired names remain reserved before they can be re-registered. Any read-through to the ENS token or to secondary .eth name markets runs through governance and name-supply mechanics rather than through protocol revenue or liquidity.

timeline.text_en: ENS DAO opened onchain voting on the ENSv2 activation proposal, with voting ending 25 October 13:32; as of publication 6 wallets had cast 531,252 ENS, roughly 100% in favor, but quorum had not been reached; the proposal bundles 15 actions executed atomically by a DAO-controlled executor contract, and a previously approved pricing scheme takes effect on execution, raising annual fees for 5+ character domains from $5 to $8.

timeline.text_zh: 报道补充了过渡期间新 .eth 注册将在 v1 和 v2 两个版本上暂停数小时，ENS Labs 已在 v2 为现有 .eth 名称保留所有权，并说明治理规则要求至少 1% 投票参与（100 万 ENS 票）、多数批准、7 天投票期及至少 2 天 timelock，尚未公布投票日期。
timeline.text_en: The report adds that new .eth registrations would be paused for several hours on both v1 and v2 during the transition, ENS Labs has reserved existing .eth names on v2, and governance rules require at least 1% voter participation (1 million ENS votes), majority approval, a seven-day voting period and a minimum two-day timelock; no voting date has been announced.

timeline.text_zh: ENS 创始人 Nick Johnson 在 ENS DAO 治理论坛提交可执行草案提案，新增细节：v2 宽限期由 90 天缩短为 28 天，解析将切换至 v2，v2 合约管理权限全部移交 DAO，现有 .eth 持有人无需操作。
timeline.text_en: ENS founder Nick Johnson submitted a draft executable proposal to the ENS DAO forum, adding details: v2 grace period shortened from 90 to 28 days, resolution migrated to v2, all v2 contract admin control transferred to the DAO, and existing .eth holders need no action.

threads.title_zh: 币安推出Binance Intelligence AI产品栈，包含Binance AI、AI Pro与Agent OS
threads.title_en: 【币安推出 AI 产品栈 Binance Intelligence，包含 AI Pro 与 Agent OS 等】
threads.summary_zh: 币安 Intelligence 产品栈中的 Binance AI Pro 已面向全球用户开放，覆盖网页端和 App，并提供免费与付费订阅层级；此前的 Beta 版继续运行并支持迁移。
threads.summary_en: Binance AI Pro, part of Binance Intelligence, is now globally available on web and app with free and paid subscription tiers; the prior beta remains available with migration support.
threads.latest_update_zh: 币安于10月19日在网页端和App面向全球所有用户推出币安 AI Pro，提供免费标准版和月费19.99 USDC的高级版；此前Beta版继续运行，用户可迁移聊天记录和策略。
threads.latest_update_en: Binance launched Binance AI Pro globally on web and app on October 19, offering a free standard tier and a 19.99 USDC monthly premium tier; the prior beta remains available with migration for chats and strategies.
threads.background_zh: 币安此前已提供较为完整的自动化工具组合，包括现货网格、合约网格和套利机器人，并发布了用于连接其交易API的AI agent技能文档。生成式界面（generative UI）指让大语言模型不仅输出文本，还直接生成界面元素，从而按用户需求定制交互界面。
threads.background_en: Binance already offers a large built-in automation suite, including spot grid, futures grid and arbitrage bots, and has published documentation for AI agent skills that connect to its trading APIs. Generative UI refers to letting a large language model generate interface elements rather than only text, producing interfaces tailored to a user's request.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Binance launched Binance AI Pro globally across web and app, a finance-focused AI agent that converts conversational trading ideas into testable automated strategy workflows, with a free standard tier and a 19.99 USDC monthly premium tier offering higher usage quotas and access to additional AI models.
threads.latest_summary_en: Binance launched Binance AI Pro globally across web and app, a finance-focused AI agent that converts conversational trading ideas into testable automated strategy workflows, with a free standard tier and a 19.99 USDC monthly premium tier offering higher usage quotas and access to additional AI models.
threads.market_impact_zh: 此次发布影响的是币安面向零售用户的入口，而非市场结构本身：如果该界面将图表、新闻、社交媒体与链上信号集中到一处，可能影响英语零售用户在币安上的下单路径与情绪判断方式。事件不涉及上币、费率或监管变更。
threads.market_impact_en: The rollout affects Binance's retail-facing channel rather than market structure: if the interface concentrates chart, news, social and onchain signals into one place, it could influence how English-language retail users route orders and interpret sentiment on the venue. No listing, fee or regulatory change is involved.

timeline.text_zh: 币安于10月19日在网页端和App面向全球所有用户推出币安 AI Pro，提供免费标准版和月费19.99 USDC的高级版；此前Beta版继续运行，用户可迁移聊天记录和策略。
timeline.text_en: Binance launched Binance AI Pro globally on web and app on October 19, offering a free standard tier and a 19.99 USDC monthly premium tier; the prior beta remains available with migration for chats and strategies.

timeline.text_zh:
币安向所有英语用户开放了Binance AI——一个免费的生成式界面（generative UI）交易工具，此前该产品处于测试阶段，约有15万名测试者参与。

币安是按交易量计算最大的交易所，将AI驱动的界面开放给其全部英语零售用户，意味着AI工具从测试性实验进入主流交易流程。

Binance AI是一套免费功能组合，将图表、新闻、社交媒体、链上数据和研究工具的市场信号整合到单一界面中，并通过生成式界面适配不同用户的知识水平。本次开放范围限于英语用户。
timeline.text_en: Binance launched Binance AI, a free generative-UI trading interface, to all English-language users following a beta that involved roughly 150,000 testers.

timeline.text_zh: Agent OS 自 8 月上线以来日调用量已超过 28 万次。
timeline.text_en: Agent OS has surpassed 280,000 daily calls since its August launch.

threads.title_zh: 法国国民议会财政委员会通过稳定币兑换税及加密资产退出税修正案后否决预算收入部分
threads.title_en: French lawmakers back stablecoin swap tax in 2027 budget bill
threads.summary_zh: 法国国民议会全体会议已以一票优势通过取消加密兑MiCA稳定币税收递延的2027年预算修正案，拟自2027年1月1日起将此类兑换视为应税处置；此前财政委员会还通过31.4%税率、自托管钱包超10万欧元申报和加密退出税等修正案，但预算收入部分曾被否决；目前措施仍处国民议会一读阶段，尚未成为法律，后续需参议院审议，预计10月20日和11月17日分别投票。
threads.summary_en: France's full National Assembly has passed by a single vote a 2027 budget amendment removing tax deferral for crypto-to-MiCA-stablecoin conversions, treating them as taxable disposals from January 1, 2027; the finance committee had also adopted a 31.4% rate, self-custody reporting above €100,000, and a crypto exit tax, while rejecting the revenue section; the measures remain in first reading, are not law, and still require Senate review, with votes expected Oct. 20 and Nov. 17.
threads.latest_update_zh: 法国国民议会全体会议以38票赞成、37票反对、25票弃权通过了一项2027年预算修正案，拟从2027年1月1日起取消加密货币兑换为MiCA定义稳定币的税收递延待遇，将其视为应税处置；该修正案仍处一读阶段，尚未成为法律，国民议会预计10月20日对预算第一部分投票、11月17日对整部法案表决。
threads.latest_update_en: France's full National Assembly passed by 38 votes to 37, with 25 abstentions, a 2027 budget amendment that would remove tax deferral for crypto-to-MiCA-defined-stablecoin conversions starting January 1, 2027, treating them as taxable disposals; the amendment remains in first reading and is not law, with the Assembly expected to vote on the budget's first part Oct. 20 and the whole bill Nov. 17.
threads.latest_summary_zh: France's National Assembly passed by a single vote an amendment to the 2027 budget that would remove tax deferral for crypto-to-stablecoin conversions starting January 1, 2027, treating them as taxable capital-gains events even without fiat conversion.
threads.latest_summary_en: France's National Assembly passed by a single vote an amendment to the 2027 budget that would remove tax deferral for crypto-to-stablecoin conversions starting January 1, 2027, treating them as taxable capital-gains events even without fiat conversion.

timeline.text_zh: 法国国民议会全体会议以38票赞成、37票反对、25票弃权通过了一项2027年预算修正案，拟从2027年1月1日起取消加密货币兑换为MiCA定义稳定币的税收递延待遇，将其视为应税处置；该修正案仍处一读阶段，尚未成为法律，国民议会预计10月20日对预算第一部分投票、11月17日对整部法案表决。
timeline.text_en: France's full National Assembly passed by 38 votes to 37, with 25 abstentions, a 2027 budget amendment that would remove tax deferral for crypto-to-MiCA-defined-stablecoin conversions starting January 1, 2027, treating them as taxable disposals; the amendment remains in first reading and is not law, with the Assembly expected to vote on the budget's first part Oct. 20 and the whole bill Nov. 17.

timeline.text_zh: 新增具体税率：法国2027年预算修正案拟对加密货币兑换为MiCA监管稳定币征收31.4%资本利得税；财政委员会以31票对3票否决政府收入部分；预计10月20日就收入部分进行投票；目前尚无任何措施成为法律。
timeline.text_en: Adds the specific 31.4% capital gains tax rate on crypto-to-MiCA-regulated-stablecoin conversions in France's 2027 budget amendment; the finance committee rejected the government's revenue section by 31 votes to 3; a revenue vote is expected Oct. 20; no measure is law yet.

timeline.text_zh: 新增事实：法国财政委员会另于10月7日通过允许加密损失结转最多10年的修正案；Chainalysis法国CEO警告31.4%稳定币税可能推动交易转向不受监管的离岸稳定币；议会需在12月10日前通过2027年预算。
timeline.text_en: New facts: a separate Oct. 7 amendment backed by the finance committee would allow crypto losses to be carried forward up to 10 years; Chainalysis' France CEO warned the 31.4% regulated-stablecoin tax could push trading toward unregulated offshore stablecoins; lawmakers have until Dec. 10 to pass the 2027 budget.

threads.title_zh: Solana基金会确定Alpenglow主网升级日期
threads.title_en: Solana Foundation Sets Alpenglow Mainnet Upgrade Date
threads.summary_zh: Solana已将Alpenglow主网激活时间定在10月21日，届时将退役其原始共识机制，目标终局时间约为150毫秒，而目前约为12.8秒；与此同时，加密市场整体遭遇抛售，主流币种下跌3%至5%，清算金额超过9亿美元。
threads.summary_en: Solana has scheduled Alpenglow's mainnet activation for October 21, retiring its original consensus mechanism and targeting finality of roughly 150 milliseconds versus today's ~12.8 seconds, amid a broader crypto selloff that saw majors drop 3-5% and over $900M in liquidations.
threads.latest_update_zh: Solana已将Alpenglow主网激活时间定在10月21日，届时将退役其原始共识机制，目标终局时间约为150毫秒，而目前约为12.8秒；与此同时，加密市场整体遭遇抛售，主流币种下跌3%至5%，清算金额超过9亿美元。
threads.latest_update_en: Solana has scheduled Alpenglow's mainnet activation for October 21, retiring its original consensus mechanism and targeting finality of roughly 150 milliseconds versus today's ~12.8 seconds, amid a broader crypto selloff that saw majors drop 3-5% and over $900M in liquidations.
threads.background_zh: Alpenglow 被描述为 Solana 自 TowerBFT 以来的首次重大共识替换，改变验证者的投票方式、区块达成最终确认的方式，以及共识信息向下游基础设施暴露的方式，同时保持交易执行与 SVM 不变。Anza 是一家专注于 Solana 的研发实验室，成立于 2023 年 1 月，负责 Solana 核心协议的工程开发。
threads.background_en: Alpenglow is described as Solana's first major consensus replacement since TowerBFT, changing how validators vote, how blocks reach finality and how consensus information is exposed to downstream infrastructure, while leaving transaction execution and the SVM unchanged. Anza is a Solana-focused research and development lab, founded in January 2023, that engineers the network's core protocol.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Solana has scheduled Alpenglow's mainnet activation for October 21, retiring its original consensus mechanism and targeting finality of roughly 150 milliseconds versus today's ~12.8 seconds, amid a broader crypto selloff that saw majors drop 3-5% and over $900M in liquidations.
threads.latest_summary_en: Solana has scheduled Alpenglow's mainnet activation for October 21, retiring its original consensus mechanism and targeting finality of roughly 150 milliseconds versus today's ~12.8 seconds, amid a broader crypto selloff that saw majors drop 3-5% and over $900M in liquidations.
threads.market_impact_zh: 更快的最终确认缩短了交易所、托管机构和支付处理商必须管理的结算窗口，这一传导渠道涉及 DeFi、MEV 与验证者经济，而该网络承载着相当大比例的链上活动。这一消息发布之际，市场正因宏观因素普遍抛售，主流币下跌 3%–5%，其中 SOL 报 102 美元、跌 5%，24 小时内超过 9 亿美元的加密多头被清算。
threads.market_impact_en: Faster finality shortens the settlement window that exchanges, custodians and payment processors must manage — a channel that touches DeFi, MEV and validator economics on a network carrying a large share of on-chain activity. The announcement lands during a broader macro-driven selloff in which majors fell 3-5%, including SOL at $102, down 5%, with over $900M in crypto longs liquidated in 24 hours.

timeline.text_zh: Solana已将Alpenglow主网激活时间定在10月21日，届时将退役其原始共识机制，目标终局时间约为150毫秒，而目前约为12.8秒；与此同时，加密市场整体遭遇抛售，主流币种下跌3%至5%，清算金额超过9亿美元。
timeline.text_en: Solana has scheduled Alpenglow's mainnet activation for October 21, retiring its original consensus mechanism and targeting finality of roughly 150 milliseconds versus today's ~12.8 seconds, amid a broader crypto selloff that saw majors drop 3-5% and over $900M in liquidations.

timeline.text_zh: Solana基金会将10月21日（epoch 1064）定为Alpenglow主网激活日期，该升级将用新系统取代TowerBFT共识，目标是将交易最终确认时间从当前的约12.8秒缩短至约150毫秒，并将从区块中移除投票交易——这会大幅降低表面TPS数据，但实际活动不会减少。
timeline.text_en: The Solana Foundation set October 21 (epoch 1064) for the Alpenglow mainnet activation, which replaces the TowerBFT consensus with a new system targeting roughly 150ms transaction finality instead of the current ~12.8 seconds, and will remove vote transactions from blocks — sharply lowering headline TPS counts without any decline in real activity.

timeline.text_zh: Solana已将其Alpenglow共识升级安排在10月21日，目标是通过取代TowerBFT并将验证者投票移至链下，实现约150毫秒的交易最终性，同时要求验证者迁移至Agave 4.3.0。
timeline.text_en: Solana has scheduled its Alpenglow consensus upgrade for Oct. 21, targeting roughly 150-millisecond transaction finality by replacing TowerBFT and moving validator votes off-chain, while requiring validators to migrate to Agave 4.3.0.

threads.title_zh: 摩根大通将JPM Coin存款代币扩展至以太坊主网面向机构客户
threads.title_en: 【摩根大通正将 JPM Coin 存款代币扩展至以太坊，面向机构客户】
threads.summary_zh: JPM Coin 已在以太坊主网上线，面向经审核的机构客户用于支付、交易结算和抵押，并可在 Base 与以太坊之间转移。
threads.summary_en: JPM Coin is live on Ethereum mainnet for vetted institutional clients to use for payments, trade settlement and collateral, and can move between Base and Ethereum.
threads.latest_update_zh: 报道确认 JPM Coin 已在以太坊上线，而此前事件状态为扩展/报道阶段；并补充其可在 Base 与以太坊之间转移、仅限经审核对手方持有等细节。
threads.latest_update_en: The report confirms JPM Coin has launched on Ethereum, whereas the prior state was expansion/reporting; it adds that the token can move between Base and Ethereum and is restricted to vetted counterparties.
threads.latest_summary_zh: JPMorgan launched JPM Coin on Ethereum, allowing institutional clients to redeem the token for dollars and use it for payments, trade settlement, and collateral posting.
threads.latest_summary_en: JPMorgan launched JPM Coin on Ethereum, allowing institutional clients to redeem the token for dollars and use it for payments, trade settlement, and collateral posting.

timeline.text_zh: 报道确认 JPM Coin 已在以太坊上线，而此前事件状态为扩展/报道阶段；并补充其可在 Base 与以太坊之间转移、仅限经审核对手方持有等细节。
timeline.text_en: The report confirms JPM Coin has launched on Ethereum, whereas the prior state was expansion/reporting; it adds that the token can move between Base and Ethereum and is restricted to vetted counterparties.

timeline.text_zh: 摩根大通正将其 JPM Coin 存款代币扩展至以太坊主网，面向机构客户，支持全天候资金转账与结算。
timeline.text_en: JPMorgan is expanding its JPM Coin deposit token to Ethereum mainnet for institutional clients, enabling round-the-clock fund transfers and settlement.

threads.title_zh: 【Mesh 与 Visa 达成合作，实现加密货币余额直接消费】
threads.title_en: 【Mesh 与 Visa 达成合作，实现加密货币余额直接消费】
threads.summary_zh: Mesh 与 Visa 的合作已宣布，用户可直接从加密和稳定币钱包在 Visa 商户消费；Mesh 负责交易资金、资产转换、KYC 和 Visa 支付凭证发放，Visa 网络覆盖 175M+ 商户地点，但参与钱包和上线日期尚未公布。
threads.summary_en: The Mesh-Visa partnership has been announced to let users spend directly from crypto and stablecoin wallets at Visa merchants; Mesh handles funding, asset conversion, KYC and Visa credential provisioning, with Visa's network covering 175M+ merchant locations, while participating wallets and launch dates are not yet announced.
threads.latest_update_zh: 新增披露 Visa 网络覆盖超过 175 亿个商户地点、200 多个国家和地区，并称参与钱包、支持设备和上线日期将在 rollout 计划确定后公布。
threads.latest_update_en: Added that Visa's network covers more than 175 million merchant locations across over 200 countries and territories, and that participating wallets, supported devices and launch dates will be announced as rollout plans are finalized.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Visa and Mesh are partnering to let users spend crypto and stablecoin wallet balances directly at merchants across Visa's global network of more than 175 million locations without needing a separate crypto card.
threads.latest_summary_en: Visa and Mesh are partnering to let users spend crypto and stablecoin wallet balances directly at merchants across Visa's global network of more than 175 million locations without needing a separate crypto card.

timeline.text_zh: 新增披露 Visa 网络覆盖超过 175 亿个商户地点、200 多个国家和地区，并称参与钱包、支持设备和上线日期将在 rollout 计划确定后公布。
timeline.text_en: Added that Visa's network covers more than 175 million merchant locations across over 200 countries and territories, and that participating wallets, supported devices and launch dates will be announced as rollout plans are finalized.

timeline.text_zh: Mesh 已与 Visa 合作，让用户可直接在 Visa 商户处使用加密货币、稳定币和法币钱包余额消费，由 Mesh 生成 Visa 支付凭证并负责 KYC 及后端资产转换。
timeline.text_en: Mesh has partnered with Visa to let users spend cryptocurrency, stablecoin, and fiat wallet balances directly at Visa merchants, with Mesh generating Visa payment credentials and handling KYC and back-end asset conversion.

threads.title_zh: Anthropic设立公共利益基金：初始承诺5%股份，公司估值上涨将自动追加
threads.title_en: Anthropic设立公共利益基金：初始承诺5%股份，公司估值上涨将自动追加
threads.summary_zh: Anthropic已宣布设立公共利益基金并承诺5%股份，但该承诺仍需股东批准，尚不能确认已正式完成；基金采用全资LLC结构，含估值上涨自动追加2%的机制，并禁止用于政治游说或政治捐款；连同联合创始人和员工承诺，约20%股份将用于公共利益。公司同时筹备最早11月IPO。
threads.summary_en: Anthropic has announced a Public Benefit Fund with a 5% share commitment, but the commitment remains subject to stockholder approval and is not confirmed as completed; the fund is a wholly owned LLC with a 2% share ratchet per 50% valuation increase and is barred from political lobbying or donations; including co-founder and employee pledges, roughly 20% of shares are intended for public causes. The company is also preparing an IPO as soon as November.
threads.latest_update_zh: 新增关键程序性事实：该5%股份承诺仍需股东批准，因此不能视为已正式落地；基金为全资LLC，董事会可在估值较未披露基准上涨50%时追加2%股份；Anthropic正筹备最早11月IPO，报道估值约2万亿美元；联合创始人承诺捐出80%股权并设员工配捐。
threads.latest_update_en: Adds material procedural details: the 5% share commitment is subject to stockholder approval, so it is not confirmed as launched; the fund is a wholly owned LLC whose board can add 2% of shares each time valuation rises 50% above an undisclosed baseline; Anthropic is preparing an IPO as soon as November at a reported ~$2 trillion valuation; co-founders pledged 80% of their equity with an employee matching program.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Anthropic said it will dedicate 5% of its shares to a new Public Benefit Fund — with about 20% of its stock going to public causes including co-founder and employee pledges — and Elon Musk responded by promising one SpaceX share to every child in the United States next year, a giveaway worth over $10 billion at current prices.
threads.latest_summary_en: Anthropic said it will dedicate 5% of its shares to a new Public Benefit Fund — with about 20% of its stock going to public causes including co-founder and employee pledges — and Elon Musk responded by promising one SpaceX share to every child in the United States next year, a giveaway worth over $10 billion at current prices.

timeline.text_zh: 新增关键程序性事实：该5%股份承诺仍需股东批准，因此不能视为已正式落地；基金为全资LLC，董事会可在估值较未披露基准上涨50%时追加2%股份；Anthropic正筹备最早11月IPO，报道估值约2万亿美元；联合创始人承诺捐出80%股权并设员工配捐。
timeline.text_en: Adds material procedural details: the 5% share commitment is subject to stockholder approval, so it is not confirmed as launched; the fund is a wholly owned LLC whose board can add 2% of shares each time valuation rises 50% above an undisclosed baseline; Anthropic is preparing an IPO as soon as November at a reported ~$2 trillion valuation; co-founders pledged 80% of their equity with an employee matching program.

timeline.text_zh: Anthropic 推出“Anthropic 公共利益基金”，以公司 5% 股权作为初始资金，其结构设定为估值每上涨 50% 便自动增持 2%，并明确禁止用于政治游说或捐款；这是其将约 20% 总股份投入公共利益事业（包括应对 AI 引发的劳动力冲击）的更广泛承诺的一部分。
timeline.text_en: Anthropic launched an 'Anthropic Public Benefit Fund' seeded with 5% of company equity, structured to automatically grow by 2% per 50% valuation increase and explicitly barred from political lobbying or donations, part of a broader commitment putting roughly 20% of total shares toward public-interest causes including AI-driven labor disruption.

threads.title_zh: Paxos的USDG稳定币在Arbitrum上线并加入Global Dollar网络
threads.title_en: Paxos' USDG stablecoin launches on Arbitrum and joins Global Dollar Network
threads.summary_zh: Entropy 发起温度检查投票，拟将 Paxos 发行的 USDG 列为 ArbitrumDAO 的核心战略举措，向 DRIP 激励计划追加 1 亿 ARB，并将 Arbitrum 扩展计划的费用收入通过财务委员会导入 USDG。
threads.summary_en: Entropy opened a temperature-check vote to make Paxos-issued USDG a core strategic initiative of ArbitrumDAO, adding 100 million ARB to the DRIP incentive program and routing Arbitrum Expansion Program fee revenue through the treasury committee into USDG.

threads.title_zh: 谷歌发布Gemini 4 Argon模型，四个智能体自主通关《我的世界》
threads.title_en: Google releases Gemini 4 Argon model; four agents autonomously beat Minecraft
threads.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 让四个 Gemini 4 Argon 编程智能体在《我的世界》中自主规划并协作，经过 27 小时、605 次死亡和约 520 美元的 API 成本后击败末影龙，全程使用自行编写的 JavaScript 而非预置游戏工具。
threads.summary_en: Google DeepMind let four Gemini 4 Argon coding agents autonomously plan and collaborate in Minecraft, beating the Ender Dragon after 27 hours, 605 deaths and roughly $520 in API costs, using self-written JavaScript rather than pre-built game tools.
threads.latest_update_zh: Google DeepMind 让四个 Gemini 4 Argon 编程智能体在《我的世界》中自主规划并协作，经过 27 小时、605 次死亡和约 520 美元的 API 成本后击败末影龙，全程使用自行编写的 JavaScript 而非预置游戏工具。
threads.latest_update_en: Google DeepMind let four Gemini 4 Argon coding agents autonomously plan and collaborate in Minecraft, beating the Ender Dragon after 27 hours, 605 deaths and roughly $520 in API costs, using self-written JavaScript rather than pre-built game tools.
threads.background_zh: 末影龙是《我的世界》的最终 Boss，玩家需先找到要塞、激活传送门才能进入末地；本次实验中一名 Agent 通过两次投掷末影之眼，计算出距目标仅 43 米的位置。Mineflayer 是一个用于构建《我的世界》机器人的开源 JavaScript 框架，Agent 借助它读取坐标、背包与周围环境，寻路则由现成插件负责。根据谷歌开发者文档，Gemini 4 Argon 是面向自主多步骤 Agent 的旗舰推理模型，具备 100 万 Token 上下文窗口；Vals AI 列出的价格为每百万输入 Token 4 美元、每百万输出 Token 20 美元。
threads.background_en: The Ender Dragon is Minecraft's final boss, fought in the End dimension after locating a stronghold and activating a portal; in this run one agent threw Eyes of Ender twice to calculate a target about 43 meters away. Mineflayer is an open-source JavaScript framework for building Minecraft bots, which the agents used to read coordinates, inventory and surroundings, while a dedicated plugin handled pathfinding. Gemini 4 Argon is described in Google's developer documentation as a flagship reasoning model built for autonomous multi-step agents with a 1M-token context window, and Vals AI lists it at $4.00 per million input tokens and $20.00 per million output tokens.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Google DeepMind let four Gemini 4 Argon coding agents autonomously plan and collaborate in Minecraft, beating the Ender Dragon after 27 hours, 605 deaths and roughly $520 in API costs, using self-written JavaScript rather than pre-built game tools.
threads.latest_summary_en: Google DeepMind let four Gemini 4 Argon coding agents autonomously plan and collaborate in Minecraft, beating the Ender Dragon after 27 hours, 605 deaths and roughly $520 in API costs, using self-written JavaScript rather than pre-built game tools.
threads.market_impact_zh: 本次实验披露的成本与 Token 消耗数据，为长周期 Agent 推理的经济性提供了一个具体参照，这类信息会通过 AI 算力与自主 Agent 叙事影响加密市场的情绪。事件本身不直接涉及具体协议或代币，其传导路径是围绕 Agent 概念及去中心化算力／推理板块的市场情绪，而非文中描述的任何链上资金流动。
threads.market_impact_en: The run's disclosed cost and token-consumption data provide a concrete reference point for the economics of long-horizon agentic inference, a channel that feeds the prevailing AI-compute and autonomous-agent narratives in crypto markets. There is no direct exposure to a specific protocol or token; the effect runs through sentiment around agent-themed and decentralized compute/inference segments rather than through any on-chain flow described here.

timeline.text_en: Google DeepMind let four Gemini 4 Argon coding agents autonomously plan and collaborate in Minecraft, beating the Ender Dragon after 27 hours, 605 deaths and roughly $520 in API costs, using self-written JavaScript rather than pre-built game tools.

timeline.text_zh: Gemini 4 Argon 从仅面向部分网络安全合作伙伴，扩大至向全球所有付费用户正式开放；可在 Gemini App（Google AI Pro/Ultra）、Antigravity（仅 Ultra）和付费 API 使用；API 首发价每百万输入 2 美元、输出 10 美元，优惠持续至 11 月 30 日后翻倍。谷歌还展示了其视频驱动机器人技能学习和仿真生成能力，ERQA 得分 87%。
timeline.text_en: Gemini 4 Argon expanded from limited availability for selected cybersecurity partners to a general opening for all global paid users; it is available in the Gemini App (Google AI Pro/Ultra), Antigravity (Ultra only), and paid API. Introductory API pricing of $2/$10 per million tokens lasts until Nov 30, after which it doubles. Google also showcased video-driven robot skill learning, simulation generation, and an 87% ERQA score.

timeline.text_zh: Google DeepMind 发布了 Gemini 4“Argon”，这是一款新的前沿模型，可通过 API 使用，入门价格为每百万输入 token 2 美元、每百万输出 token 10 美元（缓存输入享 95% 折扣），因其 SVG 生成和自然语言写作质量而受到关注。
timeline.text_en: Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 'Argon', a new frontier model available via API at introductory pricing of $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens (95% off cached input), drawing attention for its SVG generation and natural-language writing quality.

threads.title_zh: 美联储加息几近锁定，Clarity法案投票临近
threads.title_en: Federal Reserve Rate Hike Close To A Lock ; Clarity Act Vote Looms : Week Ahead
threads.summary_zh: 9月加息后，美联储未锁定进一步行动；沃什10月16日拒绝提供前瞻指引，市场定价10月加息概率约17%，政策路径仍不确定。
threads.summary_en: After the September hike, the Fed has not locked further action; Warsh on Oct 16 declined forward guidance, with markets pricing about 17% odds of an October hike and the policy path still uncertain.
threads.latest_update_zh: 美联储主席沃什10月16日在曼谷IMF会议期间拒绝预判年内剩余两次议息会议结果，市场对10月加息的概率从约30%降至约17%，美元走低。
threads.latest_update_en: Fed Chair Warsh on Oct 16 at the IMF meetings in Bangkok declined to pre-judge the remaining two rate decisions of the year, cutting October hike odds from about 30% to roughly 17% and weakening the dollar.
threads.background_zh: 联邦基金利率是存款类机构之间隔夜拆借准备金余额的利率，由联邦公开市场委员会以目标区间形式设定，该委员会通常每年召开八次会议；美联储主要通过准备金余额利率等工具把有效利率引导至目标区间内。一个基点等于百分之一的百分点，因此加息25个基点即利率上升0.25个百分点。所谓"点阵图"是一张季度图表，匿名记录每位美联储官员对未来数年政策利率的预测，其中值被市场广泛视为委员会的前瞻指引。
threads.background_en: The federal funds rate is the overnight rate at which depository institutions lend reserve balances to one another, and it is set as a target range by the FOMC, which normally meets eight times a year; the Fed steers the effective rate into that range mainly through the interest on reserve balances. A basis point is one hundredth of a percentage point, so a 25 basis point hike moves the rate by 0.25 percentage points. The "dot plot" is a quarterly chart recording each Fed official's anonymous projection for the policy rate over coming years, and its median is widely read as the committee's forward guidance.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh declined to pre-judge the year's remaining two rate decisions, saying the Fed 'no longer does this,' which cut market-implied odds of an October hike from about 30% to roughly 17% and weakened the dollar.
threads.latest_summary_en: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh declined to pre-judge the year's remaining two rate decisions, saying the Fed 'no longer does this,' which cut market-implied odds of an October hike from about 30% to roughly 17% and weakened the dollar.
threads.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道是流动性与贴现率：更高的联邦基金利率和更鹰派的点阵图路径使美债与现金相对风险资产更具吸引力，从而对比特币和以太坊构成压力——两者在声明发布前后剧烈震荡，最终基本持平。美元、短端美债收益率、对利率敏感的股票板块以及加密衍生品资金费率是受影响最直接的领域，而偏鹰派的点阵图使2026年进一步加息成为影响仓位布局的潜在风险因素。
threads.market_impact_en: The transmission runs through liquidity and the discount rate: higher fed funds and a higher dot-plot path make Treasuries and cash more attractive relative to risk assets, which pressures bitcoin and ether — both of which whipsawed around the announcement before settling roughly flat. The dollar, front-end Treasury yields, rate-sensitive equity sectors and crypto derivatives funding are the most directly exposed segments, while the hawkish dot keeps a further 2026 hike as a live risk factor for positioning.

timeline.text_zh: 美联储主席沃什10月16日在曼谷IMF会议期间拒绝预判年内剩余两次议息会议结果，市场对10月加息的概率从约30%降至约17%，美元走低。
timeline.text_en: Fed Chair Warsh on Oct 16 at the IMF meetings in Bangkok declined to pre-judge the remaining two rate decisions of the year, cutting October hike odds from about 30% to roughly 17% and weakening the dollar.

timeline.text_zh: 美联储理事沃勒于10月8日表示，9月加息是数月来多重证据累积的结果，而非单一数据驱动；他称最新数据强化了‘就业稳定、通胀过高’的判断，政策将聚焦通胀；未来可能再加息75个基点，但不锁定节奏，市场预期12月前至少加息一次概率85%，2027年3月前至少加两次概率近80%。
timeline.text_en: Fed Governor Waller said on Oct 8 that the September hike was the result of months of cumulative evidence, not a single data point; he said recent data reinforced 'stable employment, too-high inflation' and that policy will focus on inflation; further hikes of up to 75bp are possible but not locked to consecutive meetings, with markets pricing 85% odds of at least one more hike before December and nearly 80% odds of at least two by March 2027.

timeline.text_zh: 新报道补充：FOMC以12-0将利率上调25个基点至3.75%-4%，并将2026年底利率中位数预测从6月的3.8%上调至4.1%；比特币在决议后五分钟内冲高至76,499.99美元，半小时内回吐全部涨幅；Zcash rally至1,383美元。
timeline.text_en: New report adds: FOMC voted 12-0 to raise rates 25 bps to 3.75%-4% and lifted the 2026 year-end median rate projection to 4.1% from 3.8% in June; Bitcoin spiked to $76,499.99 five minutes after the release and gave back the move within half an hour; Zcash rallied to $1,383.

threads.summary_zh: Echo Protocol 正在逐步关停：新增借贷、Strategy 及 LSD 存款/借款已冻结；用户须在 11 月 14 日前偿还债务，并在 11 月 19 日 23:59 UTC 前完成提现与解除质押，此后剩余仓位将被清算，仅保留 Aptos 至 B² 跨链桥赎回。

threads.latest_summary_zh: Bitcoin infrastructure protocol Echo Protocol said it is winding down operations, freezing new deposits and borrowing across its lending, strategy and LSD products while opening repayment/withdrawal channels, with all debt to be settled by 2026-11-14 and a final exit deadline of 2026-11-19 23:59 UTC before residual positions are liquidated and only the Aptos-to-B² bridge redemption remains.
threads.latest_summary_en: Bitcoin infrastructure protocol Echo Protocol said it is winding down operations, freezing new deposits and borrowing across its lending, strategy and LSD products while opening repayment/withdrawal channels, with all debt to be settled by 2026-11-14 and a final exit deadline of 2026-11-19 23:59 UTC before residual positions are liquidated and only the Aptos-to-B² bridge redemption remains.

timeline.text_zh: 公告补充了具体清算时间表：未结清债务须在2026年11月14日前偿还，最终还款、提现及解除质押截止为2026年11月19日23:59 UTC，此后仅保留 Aptos-to-B² 跨链桥赎回服务。
timeline.text_en: The announcement added a detailed liquidation timeline: outstanding debt must be repaid by 2026-11-14, the final repayment/withdrawal/unstaking deadline is 2026-11-19 23:59 UTC, and afterward only the Aptos-to-B² bridge redemption service remains.

timeline.text_zh: Echo Protocol 在 2026 年 5 月 eBTC 漏洞事件后逐步关停，停止新增借贷、Strategy 及 LSD 存款，并给予用户至 11 月 20 日的时间提现、还款和解除质押，之后剩余仓位将被清算或结算。
timeline.text_en: Echo Protocol is gradually shutting down after its May 2026 eBTC exploit, stopping new lending, Strategy, and LSD deposits while giving users until November 20 to withdraw, repay, and unstake before remaining positions are liquidated or settled.

threads.title_zh: ⚡️Starknet考虑转为L1以自主推进量子安全升级，最快2027年实现相关升级
threads.title_en: ⚡️Starknet考虑转为L1以自主推进量子安全升级，最快2027年实现相关升级
threads.summary_zh: Starknet 关于是否研究转为独立后量子 L1 的七天非约束性 STRK 持有人投票仍在进行，当前支持率约 99.95%，投票将于 10 月 22 日结束，最终结果尚未公布；该投票不授权实际迁移。
threads.summary_en: Starknet's seven-day non-binding STRK holder vote on whether to research becoming an independent post-quantum L1 remains open, currently at about 99.95% support, with voting set to close on Oct. 22 and final results not yet published; the vote does not authorize an actual transition.
threads.latest_update_zh: Snapshot 投票页面显示，该研究提案当前支持率约为 99.95%，赞成票超过 3.45 亿，反对票约 15.77 万，投票仍将于 10 月 22 日结束。
threads.latest_update_en: The Snapshot vote page shows the research proposal currently at about 99.95% support, with over 345 million votes in favor versus roughly 158,000 against, and voting still set to close on Oct. 22.
threads.background_zh: Starknet 由 StarkWare 开发，是一条以太坊 ZK rollup，近期一直在评估从二层转为独立一层。联合创始人兼 CEO Eli Ben-Sasson 提到，此举是为了掌控自身安全迁移的时间表，并为量子计算和 AI 相关威胁做准备，同时提出了到 2027 年实现抗量子能力的路径。
threads.background_en: Starknet, built by StarkWare, is an Ethereum ZK-rollup that has been weighing a shift from layer 2 to independent layer 1 status. Co-founder and CEO Eli Ben-Sasson cited control over the network's own security migration timeline and preparation for quantum computing and AI-related threats, with a stated path to quantum resistance by 2027.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Starknet's Snapshot research proposal on whether the network should continue transitioning into an L1 is passing with 99.95% support (over 345 million votes in favor versus roughly 158,000 against), with voting set to close on October 22.
threads.latest_summary_en: Starknet's Snapshot research proposal on whether the network should continue transitioning into an L1 is passing with 99.95% support (over 345 million votes in favor versus roughly 158,000 against), with voting set to close on October 22.
threads.market_impact_zh: 此次投票目前并不改变跨链桥、托管或结算机制，其传导路径主要通过围绕 STRK 代币的治理情绪，以及若 L1 方向推进、市场如何重新定价 Starknet 与以太坊之间的安全与结算关系。
threads.market_impact_en: The vote does not change bridging, custody or settlement mechanics today; its transmission path runs through governance sentiment around the STRK token and how the market prices Starknet's security and settlement relationship with Ethereum if the L1 direction advances.

timeline.text_en: The Snapshot vote page shows the research proposal currently at about 99.95% support, with over 345 million votes in favor versus roughly 158,000 against, and voting still set to close on Oct. 22.

timeline.text_zh: Starknet已开启为期七天的STRK持有人非约束性投票，询问是否研究成为独立的后量子Layer-1以摆脱对以太坊量子安全升级时间表的依赖；投票于10月22日结束，结果公布；Yes仅支持进一步研究，不授权迁移，也无L1时间表。
timeline.text_en: Starknet opened a seven-day non-binding STRK holder vote on whether to research becoming an independent post-quantum layer-1 to reduce dependence on Ethereum's quantum-security upgrade timeline; voting closes Oct. 22, results will be published, and a Yes vote only supports further research without authorizing a transition or setting an L1 timetable.

timeline.text_zh: StarkWare CEO Eli Ben-Sasson表示，Starknet正在权衡包括转为L1在内的多种选项，以便能够独立推动其后量子安全迁移，升级最早可能在2027年到来。
timeline.text_en: StarkWare CEO Eli Ben-Sasson said Starknet is weighing options including converting to an L1 so it can independently drive its post-quantum security migration, with upgrades potentially arriving as early as 2027.

threads.title_zh: CoreWeave扩大借款计划引发市场不安，高收益债券持续下跌
threads.title_en: CoreWeave扩大借款计划引发市场不安，高收益债券持续下跌
threads.summary_zh: CoreWeave债券仍处困境水平，收益率约15%；其融资担忧已扩散至更广泛的AI高收益债市场，高收益债平均收益率创18个月新高，部分AI基础设施借款人融资条款趋严，市场担心AI垃圾债融资可能阶段性关闭。CoreWeave称偿债能力充足，并探索投资级债务及保险资金渠道。
threads.summary_en: CoreWeave bonds remain at distressed levels with yields around 15%; its financing concerns have spread to the broader AI high-yield market, where average yields hit an 18-month high and some AI infrastructure borrowers face stricter terms, raising fears of a temporary closure in AI junk-debt financing. CoreWeave says it has sufficient debt-service capacity and is exploring investment-grade debt and insurance funding.
threads.latest_update_zh: 彭博社报道称，CoreWeave的融资困境正外溢至更广泛的AI高收益/垃圾债市场：高收益债平均收益率升至8.41%的18个月新高，风险溢价扩至3月以来最高；AI云初创公司Volta Infrastructure的50亿美元杠杆贷款条款被调整，最终收益率超过11%；新AI基础设施借款人可能面临更严格条款，甚至无担保融资成本过高而无法发行。CoreWeave联合创始人称正探索投资级债务市场和保险机构资金，公司称财务状况足以偿债，英伟达CEO黄仁勋亦公开维护其财务健康。
threads.latest_update_en: Bloomberg reported that CoreWeave's financing troubles are spilling into the broader AI high-yield/junk-debt market: average high-yield yields rose to 8.41%, an 18-month high, and risk premiums widened to the highest since March; AI cloud startup Volta Infrastructure's $5 billion leveraged loan terms were revised to a yield above 11%; new AI infrastructure borrowers may face stricter terms or prohibitive unsecured funding costs. CoreWeave's co-founder said the company is exploring investment-grade debt and insurance funding, while CoreWeave said its finances are sufficient to service obligations and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang publicly defended its financial health.
threads.background_zh: CoreWeave 是一家 GPU 加速云服务商，出租英伟达算力用于 AI 训练与推理。高收益债利差——即投资者相对更安全债券所要求的风险补偿——在经济不确定或市场波动时期通常走阔，反映投资者避险情绪上升。AI 基建热潮高度依赖债务融资：报道援引高盛数据显示，今年以来企业已在美元市场发行 1060 亿美元投资级及高收益项目融资债券，不少用于数据中心等 AI 投资，规模接近 2025 年全年 370 亿美元的 3 倍；明年全球相关项目融资债券发行量可能超过 3000 亿美元。
threads.background_en: CoreWeave is a GPU-accelerated cloud provider that rents out Nvidia compute for AI training and inference. High-yield bond spreads — the premium investors demand over safer debt — widen during periods of economic uncertainty or market volatility, signaling increased risk aversion. The AI infrastructure buildout has been financed heavily with debt: Goldman Sachs data cited in the report show companies have issued $106 billion of investment-grade and high-yield project-finance bonds in the dollar market this year, many for data centers, close to three times 2025's full-year total of $37 billion, with global related issuance potentially exceeding $300 billion next year.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Bloomberg reports that CoreWeave's financing concerns are worsening AI junk-debt market conditions, with its high-yield yields reaching 15%, broader high-yield spreads at 18-month highs, and new AI infrastructure borrowers facing stricter terms and potentially prohibitive unsecured funding costs.
threads.latest_summary_en: Bloomberg reports that CoreWeave's financing concerns are worsening AI junk-debt market conditions, with its high-yield yields reaching 15%, broader high-yield spreads at 18-month highs, and new AI infrastructure borrowers facing stricter terms and potentially prohibitive unsecured funding costs.
threads.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在于信用条件：若 AI 基建的高收益债融资变得过于昂贵，CoreWeave、Volta 等发行方可能转向可转债、股权、有担保债务及证券化融资，从而抬高数据中心与 GPU 算力建设的资金成本。AI 相关信用风险的这轮重定价会通过风险偏好渠道影响风险资产，包括 AI 主题加密代币，以及扩张计划依赖债市的上市或代币化数据中心与算力运营方。
threads.market_impact_en: The transmission runs through credit conditions: if high-yield funding for AI infrastructure becomes prohibitively expensive, issuers such as CoreWeave and Volta may shift toward convertibles, equity, secured debt and securitization, raising the cost of capital for data-center and GPU capacity buildouts. That repricing of AI-related credit risk is a sentiment channel for risk assets, including AI-themed crypto tokens and listed or tokenized data-center and compute capacity operators whose expansion plans depend on debt markets.

timeline.text_en: Bloomberg reported that CoreWeave's financing troubles are spilling into the broader AI high-yield/junk-debt market: average high-yield yields rose to 8.41%, an 18-month high, and risk premiums widened to the highest since March; AI cloud startup Volta Infrastructure's $5 billion leveraged loan terms were revised to a yield above 11%; new AI infrastructure borrowers may face stricter terms or prohibitive unsecured funding costs. CoreWeave's co-founder said the company is exploring investment-grade debt and insurance funding, while CoreWeave said its finances are sufficient to service obligations and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang publicly defended its financial health.

timeline.text_zh: CoreWeave债券价格跌至面值80美分以下，收益率接近15%，达到市场通常视为困境债券的水平；该公司股价本周下跌17%；英伟达过去一周市值蒸发约2700亿美元。投资者正在抛售数据中心债券，市场担忧AI收入不足以支撑巨额债务，安联CIO称数据中心债券迎来“达尔文时刻”。
timeline.text_en: CoreWeave bonds fell below 80 cents on the dollar with yields near 15%, reaching levels typically viewed as distressed; the company's stock dropped 17% this week; Nvidia lost about $270 billion in market value over the past week. Investors are dumping datacenter debt amid doubts that AI revenues can service the sector's massive debt load, with Allianz's CIO calling it a 'Darwin moment' for datacenter bonds.

timeline.text_zh:
ICE Data Services 数据显示，CoreWeave 五年期信用违约掉期（CDS）成本周四一度上涨 74.5 个基点，至 1194.5 个基点，创盘中历史新高，意味着掉期市场定价反映该公司未来五年内违约概率超过 60%。同日，CoreWeave 债券成为美国高收益债券市场跌幅最大的债券之一，此前该公司计划进一步扩大借款规模。

报道将这一走势归因于债券投资者对人工智能融资热潮的不安，这促使市场重新评估部分大型科技公司的信用风险，表现为信用违约保险价格飙升、市场波动加剧以及债券表现疲软。

报道称 CoreWeave 是较早进入人工智能云计算领域的企业，并高度依赖高收益债券市场为其业务扩张融资，因此格外受到投资者关注。CDS 与债券数据来自 ICE Data Services。
timeline.text_en: CoreWeave's expanded borrowing plans drove its five-year credit default swap cost to a record 1194.5 bps — implying over 60% default probability — and made its bonds among the biggest decliners in the US high-yield market.

threads.title_zh: 博通为Anthropic芯片采购安排融资并提供贷款
threads.title_en: Broadcom arranges financing and extends loans for Anthropic chip purchases
threads.summary_zh: 该600亿美元AI芯片融资方案（现称“北极星项目”）已进入银团分销阶段，由美国银行、花旗集团和摩根士丹利牵头分销，其中约420亿美元博通支持的高级担保贷款已启动分销；黑石承诺向约180亿美元次级债务中的90亿美元部分提供资金，并获得超过10%的收益率，该债务以Anthropic未来五年芯片租赁付款为支持。
threads.summary_en: The $60 billion AI chip financing package (now called Project North Star) has entered syndication led by Bank of America, Citigroup and Morgan Stanley; the ~$42 billion Broadcom-backed senior secured loans have launched syndication; Blackstone has committed $9 billion to the ~$18 billion subordinated debt at a yield above 10%, backed by Anthropic's future five-year chip lease payments.
threads.latest_update_zh: 该600亿美元芯片融资计划被称为“北极星项目”，Anthropic向黑石提供超过10%的收益率，黑石基金承诺投资90亿美元购买以Anthropic未来五年芯片租赁付款为支持的债务，占约180亿美元次级贷款的一半；资金用于采购约1.5吉瓦谷歌TPU。
threads.latest_update_en: The $60B chip financing plan is called "Project North Star"; Anthropic is offering Blackstone a yield above 10%; Blackstone funds commit $9B to purchase debt backed by Anthropic's future five-year chip lease payments, half of the ~$18B subordinated tranche; proceeds to acquire ~1.5 GW of Google TPUs.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Anthropic is reportedly offering Blackstone a yield above 10% on a $60 billion debt financing, dubbed Project North Star, to acquire roughly 1.5 gigawatts of Google TPUs, with Blackstone's funds committing $9 billion of an approximately $18 billion subordinated tranche.
threads.latest_summary_en: Anthropic is reportedly offering Blackstone a yield above 10% on a $60 billion debt financing, dubbed Project North Star, to acquire roughly 1.5 gigawatts of Google TPUs, with Blackstone's funds committing $9 billion of an approximately $18 billion subordinated tranche.

timeline.text_zh: 该600亿美元芯片融资计划被称为“北极星项目”，Anthropic向黑石提供超过10%的收益率，黑石基金承诺投资90亿美元购买以Anthropic未来五年芯片租赁付款为支持的债务，占约180亿美元次级贷款的一半；资金用于采购约1.5吉瓦谷歌TPU。
timeline.text_en: The $60B chip financing plan is called "Project North Star"; Anthropic is offering Blackstone a yield above 10%; Blackstone funds commit $9B to purchase debt backed by Anthropic's future five-year chip lease payments, half of the ~$18B subordinated tranche; proceeds to acquire ~1.5 GW of Google TPUs.

timeline.text_zh: 美国银行、花旗集团和摩根士丹利已启动向其他银行分销该600亿美元融资方案的份额，银团分销程序已开始；其中约420亿美元博通支持的高级担保贷款已启动分销，180亿美元次级债务将稍后推出。
timeline.text_en: Bank of America, Citigroup and Morgan Stanley have begun syndicating the $60 billion financing package to other banks; the ~$42 billion Broadcom-backed senior secured loans have launched syndication, while the $18 billion subordinated debt will be introduced later.

timeline.text_zh: 博通正在安排一项600亿美元的AI芯片融资方案，其中包括420亿美元的高级担保债务和由黑石集团牵头的180亿美元次级债务，Anthropic是受益方之一。
timeline.text_en: Broadcom is arranging a $60 billion AI chip financing package, including $42B in senior secured debt and $18B in subordinated debt led by Blackstone, with Anthropic among the beneficiaries.

threads.title_zh: Payward 收购立陶宛 Saldo 银行以获取欧盟银行牌照
threads.title_en: Payward to acquire Lithuania-based Saldo Bank for EU banking license
threads.summary_zh: Payward已同意收购Saldo Bank以获得欧盟银行牌照，交易待监管批准，预计2027年完成。
threads.summary_en: Payward has agreed to acquire Saldo Bank to obtain an EU banking license, pending regulatory approval, expected to close in 2027.
threads.latest_update_zh: CoinDesk 报道补充：该交易据 Financial Times 称为加密公司首次收购欧洲银行；Saldo Bank 2025 年底总资产约 1.639 亿欧元（1.8 亿美元）；Payward 计划提供有息存款、贷款、卡服务和欧元支付；其银行业务已发放逾 20 亿美元贷款，并持有美联储有限用途主账户和爱尔兰电子货币机构牌照。
threads.latest_update_en: CoinDesk adds that the deal is reportedly the first acquisition of a European bank by a crypto company according to the Financial Times; Saldo Bank had €163.9 million ($180 million) in total assets at end-2025; Payward plans to offer interest-bearing deposits, loans, card services and euro payments; its banking business has originated over $2 billion in loans and holds a Federal Reserve limited-purpose master account and an Irish electronic money institution license.
threads.background_zh: Kraken 是一家成立于 2011 年的美国加密货币交易所，据维基百科介绍，它是首家获得银行牌照的加密公司。Payward 一直在推进受监管金融基础设施布局：它已申请美国的 national trust bank 牌照，CoinDesk 在 7 月报道称 Kraken 正在争取立陶宛的银行牌照。Payward 联合首席执行官 Arjun Sethi 表示，一家受监管的欧盟银行“让我们能够像主要金融机构那样服务欧洲客户：一个可以持有资产、自由转移资产并让资产产生收益的地方”。
threads.background_en: Kraken is a US-based cryptocurrency exchange founded in 2011, and per Wikipedia it was the first crypto company to obtain a bank charter. Payward has been pushing into regulated financial infrastructure: it has applied for a US national trust bank charter, and CoinDesk reported in July that Kraken was seeking a banking license in Lithuania. Payward co-CEO Arjun Sethi said a regulated EU bank "is the piece that lets us serve European clients the way a primary financial institution should: one place to hold assets, move them freely, and put them to work."
threads.latest_summary_zh: Payward, the parent of crypto exchange Kraken, agreed to acquire Lithuania-based Saldo Bank to secure an EU banking license and expand into interest-bearing deposits, lending, cards and euro payments — reportedly the first such acquisition of a European bank by a crypto company.
threads.latest_summary_en: Payward, the parent of crypto exchange Kraken, agreed to acquire Lithuania-based Saldo Bank to secure an EU banking license and expand into interest-bearing deposits, lending, cards and euro payments — reportedly the first such acquisition of a European bank by a crypto company.
threads.market_impact_zh: 这笔交易把加密行业的资金直接引入受欧盟监管的银行基础设施，使 Payward 掌握吸收存款、放贷和欧元支付通道，与面向欧盟加密用户的传统银行形成竞争。主要影响传导至面向欧盟市场的交易所、托管与支付服务商——其法币出入金和收益类产品将面对一家持牌银行的竞争；同时该交易预计 2027 年完成，并仍待监管批准。
threads.market_impact_en: The transaction channels crypto-native capital directly into EU-regulated banking infrastructure, giving Payward control of deposit-taking, lending and euro payment rails that compete with traditional lenders serving EU crypto users. The main exposure runs through EU-facing exchanges, custody and payments providers whose fiat on/off-ramp and yield products would face a licensed banking competitor, with the deal's 2027 closing and regulatory approval still pending.
