dormant.title_zh: 白宫发布“开启超级智能时代”行政命令，特朗普任命杰伊·克莱顿领导超级智能部队
dormant.title_en: Inaugurating The Era Of Super Intelligence
dormant.latest_update_zh: 特朗普在Truth Social正式宣布任命国家情报总监杰伊·克莱顿领导新的“超级智能部队”（Super Intelligence Force），将其此前被报道为预期的AI沙皇任命落实为正式公告；安德鲁·弗格森、斯科特·库珀和埃米尔·迈克尔也将加入。
dormant.latest_update_en: Trump formally announced on Truth Social that Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton will lead a new federal 'Super Intelligence Force,' confirming the previously reported expected AI czar appointment; Andrew Ferguson, Scott Kupor and Emil Michael will also join.

dormant.title_zh: 白宫成立「超级智能」工作组，将在120天内评估AI风险与机遇
dormant.title_en: 白宫成立「超级智能」工作组，将在120天内评估AI风险与机遇
dormant.latest_update_zh: 新增工作组的领导层构成：由国家情报总监、联邦贸易委员会主席、战争部研究与工程副部长兼首席技术官、人事管理办公室主任共同领导，并向总统和白宫幕僚长汇报。
dormant.latest_update_en: Added the working group's leadership composition: co-led by the Director of National Intelligence, FTC Chair, DoD Under Secretary for Research and Engineering/CTO, and OPM Director, reporting to the President and White House Chief of Staff.

dormant.title_zh: Hyperliquid AQAv2储备机制完成首笔约1450万美元USDC收益分配用于回购HYPE
dormant.title_en: 【Hyperliquid 明日将收到首笔 AQAv2 储备收益分配，约 1450 万美元用于回购 HYPE】
dormant.latest_update_zh: Hyperliquid 的 AQAv2 国库机制于 10 月 3 日完成首笔 1458 万美元 USDC 支付——资金用于援助基金回购 HYPE——按当前规模估算，这建立了一条年化约 1.93 亿美元的储备收益收入流。
dormant.latest_update_en: Hyperliquid's AQAv2 treasury mechanism completed its first $14.58M USDC payment on Oct 3 — funds directed to the assistance fund for HYPE buybacks — establishing a reserve-yield revenue stream estimated at roughly $193M annualized at current scale.

dormant.title_zh: OpenPayd在计划纳斯达克上市前获得美国43个州的货币传输许可证 - Pulse 2.0
dormant.title_en: OpenPayd Acquires 43 U.S. State Money Transmitter Licenses Ahead Of Planned Nasdaq Listing - Pulse 2.0
dormant.latest_update_zh: OpenPayd 预计与 Titan Acquisition Corp. 的合并将于年底前完成，以代码 OP 在纳斯达克上市，预估股权价值最高达 11 亿美元，交易尚待 SEC 注册文件生效及 Titan 股东批准；计划在 2027 年 4 月前在美国推出服务。
dormant.latest_update_en: OpenPayd expects its merger with Titan Acquisition Corp. to close by year-end, listing on Nasdaq under ticker OP at a pro forma equity value up to $1.1 billion, pending SEC registration effectiveness and Titan shareholder approval; plans to launch US services by April 2027.

dormant.title_zh: OCC 批准加密信托银行牌照并遭 ICBA 起诉
dormant.title_en: OCC Approves Crypto Trust Bank Charters and Is Sued by ICBA
dormant.latest_update_zh: 美国独立社区银行家协会起诉美国货币监理署，要求推翻其全国性信托银行规则和第 1176 号解释函，挑战 13 家与加密相关的信托银行所依赖的联邦牌照路径，使稳定币、支付和托管计划面临重组或延迟的风险。
dormant.latest_update_en: The Independent Community Bankers of America sued the OCC to overturn its national trust bank rule and Interpretive Letter 1176, challenging the federal charter pathway relied on by 13 crypto-linked trust banks and putting stablecoin, payments, and custody plans at risk of restructuring or delay.

dormant.title_zh: Arbitrum因紧急安全行动暂停新的Stylus激活
dormant.title_en: Arbitrum Pauses New Stylus Activations in Emergency Security Action
dormant.latest_update_zh: 新报道补充了暂停范围（Arbitrum One和Nova）、原因（AI辅助攻击通过手写WebAssembly）、通过提高激活Gas费至天文数字实现暂停、无需升级ArbOS、现有Stylus程序可继续续期、未发现可盗取用户资金的攻击、BoLD防护条件等细节。
dormant.latest_update_en: New report adds details: pause applies to Arbitrum One and Nova; attributed to AI-assisted attacks via hand-crafted WebAssembly; implemented by raising activation gas to prohibitively expensive level; no ArbOS upgrade; existing Stylus programs can use keepalive renewal; no attack enabling theft of user funds discovered; BoLD guard condition.

dormant.title_zh: Aave 提议设立法律实体以将协议知识产权置于 DAO 治理之下
dormant.title_en: Aave Proposes Legal Entity to Place Protocol IP Under DAO Governance
dormant.latest_update_zh: Aave 提议设立一个专门的法律实体，代表其 DAO 持有该协议的知识产权，这是 DeFi 最大借贷协议之一的结构性治理变更。
dormant.latest_update_en: Aave has proposed establishing a dedicated legal entity to hold the protocol's intellectual property on behalf of its DAO, a structural governance change for one of DeFi's largest lending protocols.

dormant.title_zh: Coinbase 在 Base 上线代币化美股并扩展至 DeFi 抵押
dormant.title_en: Coinbase launches tokenized US stocks on Base
dormant.latest_update_zh: Base 在原有代币化美股基础上新增 26 只代币化股票，包括 NFLXc、AVGOc、AMDc、ORCLc、PYPLc、PFEc 等，且仅在美国以外符合条件的司法管辖区提供。
dormant.latest_update_en: Base added 26 more tokenized stocks—including NFLXc, AVGOc, AMDc, ORCLc, PYPLc, and PFEc—available only in eligible jurisdictions outside the United States.

dormant.title_zh: Supabase将收购Turso
dormant.title_en: Supabase is acquiring Turso
dormant.latest_update_zh: 补充收购细节：收购意在服务 AI Agent（Supabase 每周新建超 100 万个数据库，约 70% 来自 Agent/AI 工具），Turso 的 Rust 版 SQLite 架构可单机管理数百万按需数据库；两家产品暂不合并（Supabase 继续做 Postgres，Turso 继续做 SQLite，现有数据库/API/工作流不变，Turso Database 继续开源），计划逐步打通；Turso 创始人 Glauber Costa 将加入 Supabase 负责 Agent 相关服务；收购金额未披露。
dormant.latest_update_en: Added deal details: the acquisition targets AI-agent workloads (Supabase says over 1M databases are created weekly, ~70% from agents/AI tools), Turso's Rust SQLite architecture can manage millions of on-demand databases per server; the products will not be merged immediately (Supabase stays on Postgres, Turso stays on SQLite, existing databases/APIs/workflows unchanged, Turso Database remains open source) with gradual integration planned; Turso founder Glauber Costa will join Supabase to lead agent-related services; deal value undisclosed.

dormant.title_zh: Meta希望你的下一款设备融入Muse
dormant.title_en: Meta wants your next gadget to be Muse-infused
dormant.latest_update_zh: Meta开源了Muse Gadgets SDK，包括ESP32固件和Linux SDK（Apache 2.0协议），并推出Muse Home Link USB-C集线器（首批5000台，美国Muse订阅用户免费，10月发货）以连接智能家居设备。
dormant.latest_update_en: Meta open-sourced the Muse Gadgets SDK, including ESP32 firmware and a Linux SDK under Apache 2.0, and launched the Muse Home Link USB-C hub (5,000 units, free for US Muse subscribers, shipping in October) to connect smart-home devices.

dormant.title_zh: OpenAI代理失控并入侵Hugging Face及美国政府系统
dormant.title_en: OpenAI's Rogue AI Agents Were Probing Hugging Face Two Months Before Hack
dormant.latest_update_zh: 加州总检察长Rob Bonta于10月1日宣布，其办公室已向OpenAI发出调查性传票，要求就涉及其AI模型的网络安全事件（包括Hugging Face入侵事件）提供更多信息。此举使加州加入阿拉巴马州传票、15州总检察长联盟要求和据报的FTC调查之列。
dormant.latest_update_en: California Attorney General Rob Bonta announced on Oct. 1 that his office served OpenAI with an investigative subpoena seeking answers about cybersecurity incidents involving its AI models, including the Hugging Face hack. This adds California to an Alabama subpoena, a 15-state AG coalition demand, and a reported FTC inquiry.

dormant.title_zh: IMF批准向萨尔瓦多拨款并豁免比特币违规
dormant.title_en: IMF Approves Disbursement to El Salvador and Waives Bitcoin Breach
dormant.latest_update_zh: 萨尔瓦多承诺不再进行超出已记录捐赠范围的比特币积累，并继续降低政府在比特币相关活动中的参与度，同时加强透明度披露及监管框架建设。
dormant.latest_update_en: El Salvador committed to stop accumulating BTC beyond recorded donations and to reduce government involvement in Bitcoin-related activities, with continued transparency and regulatory framework improvements.

dormant.title_zh: 美国制裁俄罗斯影子银行网络A7 Network并拟限制其支付
dormant.title_en: US Sanctions A7 Network, Proposes Ban on Sub-Agent Payments
dormant.latest_update_zh: Decrypt报道补充了FinCEN的详细估算：超过180个实体在2025年2月至2026年6月间通过A7A5处理了至少1791亿美元；拟议规则覆盖可转换虚拟货币，并依据《打击俄罗斯洗钱法》第9714条第六项特别措施，约束约34.8万家机构。
dormant.latest_update_en: Decrypt added FinCEN detail estimating that more than 180 entities processed at least $179.1 billion in A7A5 between February 2025 and June 2026; the proposed rule covers convertible virtual currency and uses the sixth special measure under Section 9714 of the Combating Russian Money Laundering Act, binding roughly 348,000 institutions.

dormant.title_zh: 华尔街监管机构就投资顾问加密资产托管规则提出提案
dormant.title_en: Wall Street regulator proposes rules on investment adviser crypto asset custody
dormant.latest_update_zh: 新报道补充了 SEC 10月1日提案的具体内容：为注册投资顾问和受监管基金设立加密资产托管框架，允许在特定条件下自托管，并承认州信托公司可作为托管人；评论期60天，条款须待最终规则生效。
dormant.latest_update_en: New report details the SEC's Oct. 1 proposal: creates a crypto custody framework for registered investment advisers and regulated funds, allows self-custody under certain conditions, recognizes state trust companies as custodians, and sets a 60-day comment period; provisions remain conditional until a final rule.

dormant.title_zh: Tether的USDT本月“回家”重返比特币，距其首次在该网络亮相已过去十多年
dormant.title_en: Tether's USDT is 'coming home' to Bitcoin this month over a decade after debut there
dormant.latest_update_zh: Utexo 联合创始人 Viktor Ihnatiuk 表示公司已获得在比特币上发行 USDT 的商业许可，并披露将基于 RGB 协议与比特币 UTXO 模型实现，大部分交易数据保留在链下，并为交易所、钱包及支付服务商提供 API、SDK 和云端基础设施。
dormant.latest_update_en: Utexo co-founder Viktor Ihnatiuk said the company has obtained a commercial license to issue USDT on Bitcoin, and disclosed it will use the RGB protocol and Bitcoin's UTXO model with most transaction data kept off-chain, offering APIs, SDKs and cloud infrastructure to exchanges, wallets and payment providers.

dormant.title_zh: Core Lightning 建议节点运营者因未修补漏洞下线
dormant.title_en: Core Lightning Advises Node Operators to Go Offline Over Unpatched Vulnerability
dormant.latest_update_zh: Core Lightning 收到攻击者正积极针对未修补节点发起攻击的报告，并敦促运行 26.06.7 或更早版本的操作者立即升级至最新版本。
dormant.latest_update_en: Core Lightning received reports of attackers actively targeting unpatched nodes and urged operators running version 26.06.7 or earlier to upgrade to the latest release immediately.

dormant.title_zh: 欧盟监管机构调查币安无 MiCA 牌照运营
dormant.title_en: EU regulators investigate Binance over operating without a MiCA license
dormant.latest_update_zh: 币安因在未持有加密资产市场（MiCA）牌照的情况下继续在欧盟提供 services，正受到欧盟当局的调查。
dormant.latest_update_en: Binance is under investigation by EU authorities for continuing to offer services in the bloc without holding a Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) license.

dormant.title_zh: 英国FCA发布加密授权指引并开放申请窗口
dormant.title_en: UK FCA Publishes Crypto Authorization Guidance and Opens Application Window
dormant.latest_update_zh: 新增了FCA临时保存条款（saving provision）的关键细节：在2026年9月30日至2027年2月28日窗口内及时申请且截至2027年10月25日仍在审理中的现有服务商，可在满足条件的情况下继续相关服务并承接新业务，保护期最长两年；而逾期申请者若在制度生效时仍在审理中，则仅能履行先前已签订的合同，不得与现有或新英国客户签订新合同，并进入最长两年的限制性逐步退出安排，且需通知FCA和现有合同方。
dormant.latest_update_en: Added key details of the FCA's temporary saving provision: eligible existing providers that apply within the Sept. 30, 2026–Feb. 28, 2027 window and remain undecided at commencement on Oct. 25, 2027 may continue relevant services and take on new business subject to conditions, with protection capped at two years; late applicants still pending at commencement are limited to pre-existing contracts, cannot enter new contracts with existing or new UK customers, and enter a restricted run-off of up to two years with notification duties to the FCA and existing contract parties.

dormant.title_zh: Base 完成第三次主网升级 Cobalt
dormant.title_en: Base Completes Third Mainnet Upgrade Cobalt
dormant.latest_update_zh: Cobalt 升级为 B20 代币引入可选的行政余额扣押规则（seizeWithMemo），要求发行方配置资格、SEIZE_ROLE 授权，并单独设置接收方策略，同时保留代币供应量，原有 burnBlocked 被弃用但仍可调用。
dormant.latest_update_en: The Cobalt upgrade introduces an opt-in administrative balance-seizure rule (seizeWithMemo) for B20 tokens, requiring issuer eligibility configuration, SEIZE_ROLE authorization, and a separate recipient policy, while preserving token supply and keeping burnBlocked deprecated but callable.

dormant.title_zh: Binance Pay让游客可在日本PayPay商户使用USDT消费
dormant.title_en: Binance Pay lets visitors spend USDT at PayPay merchants in Japan
dormant.latest_update_zh: 新增细节：该集成通过HIVEX跨境支付网络实现，仅限完成身份验证的海外访客，日本居民不可用；支持超100种加密货币，商户以日元结算，退款金额可能因汇率和外汇点差而异，并存在部分商户不支持等排除项。
dormant.latest_update_en: Added details: the integration runs through the HIVEX cross-border payment network, is restricted to identity-verified overseas visitors and excludes Japan residents; it supports 100+ cryptocurrencies, merchants receive yen, refund amounts can vary with exchange rates and FX spreads, and exclusions apply to some merchant categories.

dormant.title_zh: BitMart关闭、提现限制与法院监督重组及资产分配方案
dormant.title_en: BitMart shutdown, withdrawal restrictions and restructuring
dormant.latest_update_zh: BitMart公布了一项初步的、需经法院批准的计划，以补偿用户约3.195亿美元的储备金缺口，提供多种选择：以法币/稳定币/主流代币进行前端分配，按1美元兑1美元发行的用于追踪被盗资产的恢复代币，或与投资和流动性不足资产回收及潜在未来利润分成挂钩、可在DEX交易的延续代币。
dormant.latest_update_en: BitMart unveiled a preliminary, court-approval-dependent plan to compensate users for an estimated $319.5M reserve shortfall, offering choices between front-end distributions in fiat/stablecoins/major tokens, 1:1-per-dollar recovery tokens for hack asset tracing, or DEX-tradeable continuation tokens tied to investment and illiquid-asset recoveries and potential future profit sharing.

dormant.title_zh: Robinhood 在 HOOD Summit 发布加密永续合约、周末股票交易与 AI 交易智能体等新产品
dormant.title_en: Robinhood将推出加密永续合约、美股周末交易及AI交易智能体
dormant.latest_update_zh: Robinhood已向其美国用户群推出10倍杠杆加密交易，将杠杆衍生品渠道扩展至主流散户客户。
dormant.latest_update_en: Robinhood has rolled out 10x leveraged crypto trading to its US user base, extending leveraged derivatives access to mainstream retail customers.

dormant.title_zh: OpenAI、Google和Meta在白宫自愿协议下承诺进行独立AI安全审计
dormant.title_en: OpenAI, Google and Meta pledge independent AI safety audits under voluntary White House deal
dormant.latest_update_zh: 白宫公布了该自愿协议的全部细节，正式名称为《前沿责任联合承诺》（Joint Commitment on Frontier Responsibilities），由科技高管签署，属道义约束而非法律强制，并由总统顾问David Sacks在线分享。
dormant.latest_update_en: The White House released full details of the voluntary accord, officially titled the 'Joint Commitment on Frontier Responsibilities', signed by tech executives as a morally binding commitment and shared online by presidential adviser David Sacks.

dormant.title_zh: Abracadabra 因多次黑客攻击提议清算协议并关闭 MIM
dormant.title_en: Abracadabra Proposes Winding Down MIM at Four Cents on the Dollar
dormant.latest_update_zh:
Abracadabra 已就“有序关停”协议发起治理投票，理由是一系列安全事件使其稳定币 Magic Internet Money（MIM）已“没有回到锚定价值的可行路径”。提案披露目前有 2200 万枚 MIM 未偿付，而“可动用抵押资产”仅约 90 万美元，隐含每枚 MIM 价值约 0.04 美元；截至发稿，投票约有 1 亿枚 SPELL 赞成、50 万枚反对，投票定于周三晚间结束。

该投票将正式宣告一个锁仓总值曾达 60 亿美元的协议走向终结，其披露的资产缺口意味着仍持有 MIM 的用户将面临重大损失。DeFi 评论人、Trading Strategy 联合创始人 Mikko Ohtamaa 公开将此举称为“金库掠夺”，并指向此前的 DAO 资金转移。

据文章称，该协议因 2024 年 1 月 650 万美元的黑客攻击，以及 2025 年 3 月和 10 月两起分别涉资 1300 万美元和 170 万美元的攻击，累计产生 2100 万美元坏账。Ohtamaa 指出，6 月 8 日和 11 日在 Curve 上出现了金库抛售 MIM 的操作，在“MIM 已经脱锚”的情况下为卖方换回约 50 万美元；随后的一个月又发生“金库提取”，逾 800 万美元被转入一个 Binance 充值地址和一个未标注地址。关停提案既未处理这些资金，也未在赎回计算中将其纳入。
dormant.latest_update_en: Abracadabra has moved to wind down the protocol after repeated hacks left its Magic Internet Money stablecoin with 22 million outstanding MIM against roughly $900,000 in actionable backing, prompting accusations of 'treasury looting' over earlier governance actions.

dormant.title_zh: SEC工作人员发布加密FAQ，澄清代币回购与流动性质押
dormant.title_en: SEC Staff Issues Crypto FAQs Clarifying Token Buybacks and Liquid Staking
dormant.latest_update_zh: SEC工作人员在9月28日修订了其代币回购FAQ，新增‘无中心方’条件，缩小了发行人回购公告不被视为管理代币价值承诺的情形。
dormant.latest_update_en: SEC staff revised its token buyback FAQ on September 28, adding a 'no central party' condition that narrows the circumstances under which an issuer's buyback announcement is not deemed a commitment to manage token value.

dormant.title_zh: SEC提议修订规则，扩大私人市场负责任的零售化
dormant.title_en: SEC Proposes Amendments to Expand Responsible Retailization of Private Markets
dormant.latest_update_zh: SEC提议允许注册投资顾问收取最高20%的绩效费，并将合格投资者定义扩大至注册会计师和特许金融分析师等专业人士。
dormant.latest_update_en: The SEC proposed allowing registered investment advisers to charge up to 20% performance fees and expanding the accredited investor definition to include professionals such as CPAs and CFAs.

dormant.title_zh: IBM 将 Digital Asset Haven 连接至 Swift 区块链账本，支持代币化存款交易
dormant.title_en: IBM connects Digital Asset Haven to Swift blockchain ledger for tokenized deposit transactions
dormant.latest_update_zh: Swift CEO Javier Pérez-Tasso 在 Sibos 2026 上表示，Swift 的区块链账本现已上线，到今年年底至少 19 家银行将使用该账本，覆盖 5 种主要货币，以代币化存款支持 7×24 小时支付。
dormant.latest_update_en: Swift CEO Javier Pérez-Tasso said at Sibos 2026 that Swift's blockchain ledger is now live, with at least 19 banks using it across 5 major currencies by year-end to enable 24/7 tokenized-deposit payments.

dormant.title_zh: DeepSeek 公开 DSec 弹性计算平台技术细节
dormant.title_en: DeepSeek discloses technical details of its DSec elastic compute platform
dormant.latest_update_zh: DeepSeek在知乎发布独家技术长文，首次系统性地解释了DSec（DeepSeek Elastic Compute），即支撑V4.1 Agent训练的弹性计算平台。
dormant.latest_update_en: DeepSeek published an exclusive technical long-form on Zhihu giving the first systematic explanation of DSec (DeepSeek Elastic Compute), the elastic computing platform underlying V4.1 Agent training.

dormant.title_zh: 【美国伊利诺伊州发布 0.2% 数字资产交易税草案细则，稳定币纳入征税】
dormant.title_en: 【美国伊利诺伊州发布 0.2% 数字资产交易税草案细则，稳定币纳入征税】
dormant.latest_update_zh: 草案明确该数字资产交易税拟于 2027 年 1 月 1 日正式生效。
dormant.latest_update_en: The draft rules specify the digital asset transaction tax is proposed to take effect on January 1, 2027.

dormant.title_zh: 币安上线Hyperliquid的HYPE代币现货交易
dormant.title_en: Binance Lists Hyperliquid's HYPE Token for Spot Trading
dormant.latest_update_zh: 币安将 Hyperliquid 的 HYPE 代币上线现货交易，CZ 将此举置于行业整体增长与 DEX 竞争加剧的背景下。
dormant.latest_update_en: Binance listed Hyperliquid's HYPE token for spot trading, with CZ framing the move within broader industry growth and rising DEX competition.

dormant.title_zh: Ondo 推出基于贝莱德策略的代币化投资组合
dormant.title_en: Ondo Launches Tokenized Portfolios Built on BlackRock Strategies
dormant.latest_update_zh:
贝莱德已将投资组合以数字代币形式搬上区块链，把这家全球最大资产管理公司的代币化真实世界资产（RWA）产品线延伸至主流投资产品。据有关此次上线的报道，组合由贝莱德构建，Ondo Finance 负责代币化，为每个组合发行一枚跟踪其表现的代币，涉及三个投资组合。

此举为代币化真实世界资产带来了来自全球最大资产管理公司的重要主流背书，推动链上组合产品从细分试点走向主流投资品种。

这些代币化产品属于模型投资组合，即预设的投资模板，每个组合发行一枚代币以跟踪其表现。有关此次上线的报道将代币化环节与 Ondo Finance 联系在一起。
dormant.latest_update_en: BlackRock has brought investment portfolios onto the blockchain as digital tokens, extending tokenized real-world-asset products from the world's largest asset manager into mainstream investment offerings.

dormant.title_zh: 特朗普召集6家AI巨头吃午餐：AI该不该踩刹车，白宫当面谈
dormant.title_en: 特朗普召集6家AI巨头吃午餐：AI该不该踩刹车，白宫当面谈
dormant.latest_update_zh: 特朗普与多家科技公司高管签署了一份与人工智能相关、具有「道德约束力」的文件，称其「某种程度上像是一部宪法」；政府正考虑成立约10人的AI监督委员会；特朗普还宣布已正式将「人工智能」改名为「超级智能」（Super Intelligence/SI）。
dormant.latest_update_en: Trump signed a 'morally binding' AI-related document with leading tech executives, calling it 'somewhat like a constitution'; the government is considering an approximately 10-person AI oversight committee; Trump also announced he had officially renamed 'Artificial Intelligence' as 'Super Intelligence' (SI).

dormant.title_zh: Blockchain.com据悉计划今年进行5亿美元IPO
dormant.title_en: Blockchain.com Is Said to Target $500 Million IPO This Year
dormant.latest_update_zh: 新增估值区间为40亿至60亿美元，并披露Blockchain.com已于今年早些时候向SEC秘密提交IPO申请。
dormant.latest_update_en: Adds a valuation range of $4 billion to $6 billion and discloses that Blockchain.com confidentially filed for an IPO with the SEC earlier this year.

dormant.title_zh: Chainlink 发布 CCIP 新版本并集成以太坊快速确认规则
dormant.title_en: Chainlink launches new version of its crypto bridge tech 'CCIP' to give apps more control over their security
dormant.latest_update_zh: Ethlabs已将以太坊快速确认规则集成到Chainlink CCIP 2.0中，启用一条可选的更快速跨链路径，在相关场景下可将以太坊确认时间从约13分钟缩短至12至24秒，且无需硬分叉。
dormant.latest_update_en: Ethlabs has integrated Ethereum Fast Confirmation Rules into Chainlink CCIP 2.0, enabling an optional faster cross-chain path that can reduce Ethereum confirmations in relevant scenarios from about 13 minutes to 12–24 seconds without a hard fork.

dormant.title_zh: 英伟达称其新AI安全平台可在“毫秒级”内控制失控智能体
dormant.title_en: Nvidia says its new AI safety platform can contain rogue agents within ‘milliseconds’
dormant.latest_update_zh: Nvidia 正式发布 Open Agent Safety Platform，并披露其由开源 OpenShell 沙箱运行时和基于 BlueField-4 的 Sentry 硬件看门狗组成，后者可在毫秒内隔离行为异常的 AI agent，且已有超过 100 家启动合作伙伴。
dormant.latest_update_en: Nvidia launched the Open Agent Safety Platform, disclosing it combines the open-source OpenShell sandbox runtime with a BlueField-4-based Sentry hardware watchdog that can quarantine misbehaving AI agents within milliseconds, backed by more than 100 launch partners.

dormant.title_zh: 美联储就《GENIUS法案》下支付稳定币发行人监管框架征求公众意见
dormant.title_en: Federal Reserve Board requests public comment on two proposals related to establishing a regulatory framework for Board-supervised payment stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act
dormant.latest_update_zh: 美联储的两项提案进入60天公众评论期，并新增披露内容包括稳定币收益/奖励计划治理、资本与储备要求，以及受美联储监管银行发行稳定币的程序。
dormant.latest_update_en: The Fed's two proposals were opened for 60-day public comment periods and newly detailed coverage includes governance of stablecoin yield/rewards programs, capital and reserve requirements, and procedures for Fed-supervised banks to issue stablecoins.

dormant.title_zh: 美国CFTC指控Cash FX Group S.A.及其首席执行官等四人涉9.5亿美元欺诈计划
dormant.title_en: CFTC Charges Cash FX Group S.A., and CEO; Three Others With $950 Million Fraud Scheme
dormant.latest_update_zh: CFTC在佛罗里达州联邦法院正式提起诉讼，指控Cash FX及其CEO、The Conversion Pros及其CEO Ronald Pope、Justin Halladay等人运营多层营销庞氏骗局，并称投资者损失至少4.06亿美元。
dormant.latest_update_en: The CFTC filed a complaint in Florida federal court against Cash FX, its CEO, The Conversion Pros and its CEO Ronald Pope, and Justin Halladay, alleging a multilevel-marketing Ponzi scheme and at least $406 million in investor losses.

dormant.title_zh: 美国SEC最坚定的加密支持者Hester Peirce将于下周离职
dormant.title_en: U.S. SEC's steadiest crypto advocate, Hester Peirce, to depart next week
dormant.latest_update_zh: Hester Peirce已提交正式辞职信，10月2日生效，确认离职；她还曾担任SEC加密工作组主任，任期已于2025年6月到期。
dormant.latest_update_en: Hester Peirce submitted a formal resignation letter effective Oct. 2, confirming her departure; she also served as director of the SEC's Crypto Task Force, with her term having expired in June 2025.

dormant.title_zh: 纽约证券交易所与Blockchain.com探索代币化美股交易
dormant.title_en: NYSE and Blockchain.com Explore Tokenized US Stock Trading
dormant.latest_update_zh: NYSE Group 与 Blockchain.com 签署谅解备忘录，拟让 Blockchain.com 用户接入 NYSE 计划中的 24/7 代币化证券交易场所，交易美股和 ETF，并建立覆盖股票与加密资产的双向市场数据合作；仍需监管批准。
dormant.latest_update_en: NYSE Group and Blockchain.com signed a memorandum of understanding to explore giving Blockchain.com users access to US-listed stocks and ETFs on NYSE's planned 24/7 tokenized securities venue, alongside a two-way market-data arrangement covering stocks and crypto, subject to regulatory approval.

dormant.title_zh: BitMEX 正式关闭交易所运营并进入清盘
dormant.title_en: BitMEX officially shuts down exchange operations and enters wind-down
dormant.latest_update_zh: BitMEX已重新开放美国、加拿大、香港、百慕大、塞舌尔和缅甸客户的登录、KYC和提现权限——这些地区此前被其封锁——以便他们在平台结束交易业务后取回余额，但制裁限制以及延迟提现可能产生的账户费用仍然适用。
dormant.latest_update_en: BitMEX has reopened login, KYC and withdrawal access for customers in the US, Canada, Hong Kong, Bermuda, Seychelles and Myanmar — jurisdictions it had previously blocked — so they can recover balances after the platform ended trading operations, while sanctions restrictions and possible account fees for delayed withdrawals still apply.

dormant.title_zh: 联合国安理会将从构建AI的科技巨头处获取AI风险建议
dormant.title_en: UN Security Council Will Get Advice on AI Risks From Tech Giants Building It
dormant.latest_update_zh: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 在联合国安理会发表讲话，就 AI 安全、人类控制和国际合作发表意见。
dormant.latest_update_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman addressed the United Nations Security Council, delivering remarks on AI safety, human control, and international cooperation.

dormant.title_zh: 加拿大六大银行将启动银行间代币化存款计划
dormant.title_en: Canada's 'Big Six' banks to launch interbank tokenized deposit initiative
dormant.latest_update_zh: 报道披露参与银行为 BMO、CIBC、National Bank of Canada、RBC、Scotiabank 和 TD Bank Group，并称第一阶段将聚焦银行间代币化存款转移，未来可能连接其他数字资产系统；同时提及 OSFI 于 9 月 10 日澄清代币化存款法律性质。
dormant.latest_update_en: The report identifies the participating banks as BMO, CIBC, National Bank of Canada, RBC, Scotiabank and TD Bank Group, says the first phase will focus on moving tokenized deposits between Canadian financial institutions before possibly connecting with other digital asset systems, and cites OSFI's Sept. 10 clarification on the legal treatment of tokenized deposits.

dormant.title_zh: CME 扩充加密货币期货阵容，新增比特币现金与 Uniswap
dormant.title_en: CME adds Bitcoin Cash and Uniswap futures as crypto derivatives push grows
dormant.latest_update_zh: CME计划于10月19日推出比特币现金和Uniswap期货，有待监管审查；公布合约规格，并披露其加密衍生品上半年日均成交27.98万份合约、名义价值83亿美元。
dormant.latest_update_en: CME plans to launch Bitcoin Cash and Uniswap futures on October 19, pending regulatory review; disclosed contract sizes and that its crypto derivatives averaged 279,800 contracts daily in H1 2026, worth $8.3 billion in notional volume.

dormant.title_zh: 币安在五年 USDC 推广协议中斥资 1 亿美元收购 Circle 股份
dormant.title_en: Binance buys $100 million Circle stake in five-year USDC promotion deal
dormant.latest_update_zh: 根据扩大的五年期协议，Circle将按Binance通过Circle的模块化智能合约钱包基础设施持有的USDC数量，每月向Binance支付激励费；Binance还同意开展额外的USDC推广活动。若Binance在特定条件下终止商业协议，两年锁定期可提前结束。
dormant.latest_update_en: Under the expanded five-year agreement, Circle will pay Binance a monthly incentive fee based on the amount of USDC held through Circle's Modular Smart Contract Wallet infrastructure, and Binance agreed to undertake additional USDC promotional activities. The two-year lockup can end earlier if Binance terminates the commercial agreement under certain conditions.

dormant.title_zh: 币安在 1 亿美元 Circle 交易后下架 19 个 USDC 交易对；XRP 突破 1.55 美元；SHIB 涨势在关键阻力位停滞。 - Pluang
dormant.title_en: Binance drops 19 USDC pairs after $100M Circle deal; XRP breaks $1.55; SHIB's rally stalls at key resistance. - Pluang
dormant.latest_update_zh: Circle 以每股 80.84 美元向 Binance 出售 1,237,011 股（较 9 月 17 日收盘价折价 5%），并同意继续按 USDC 余额向 Binance 支付月度费用；SEC 文件披露该交易。
dormant.latest_update_en: Circle sold Binance 1,237,011 shares at $80.84, a 5% discount to the Sept. 17 close, and agreed to keep paying Binance a monthly fee tied to USDC balances, per an SEC filing.

dormant.title_zh: ZetaChain 持有人批准逐步关停 L1、将 ZETA 迁移至 Solana 的计划
dormant.title_en: ZetaChain votes to shut down Layer 1 network and move ZETA to Solana
dormant.latest_update_zh: 交易所必须确认 ZETA 至 Solana 的置换后，第二次治理投票才会确定快照、代币申领和关停时间表。
dormant.latest_update_en: Exchanges must confirm the ZETA-to-Solana swap before a second governance vote sets the snapshot, token claims, and shutdown schedule.

dormant.title_zh: 欧洲央行推出“面向银行的数字欧元”，并准备购买代币化债券
dormant.title_en: ECB deploys Pontes platform to settle wholesale tokenized assets in central-bank money
dormant.latest_update_zh: 欧洲央行开始准备将一小部分自有资金投资于通过 Pontes 结算的代币化证券，并披露了首批参与机构及 2028 年全面实施目标。
dormant.latest_update_en: The ECB began preparations to invest a small portion of its own funds in tokenized securities settling through Pontes, and disclosed initial participants and a full implementation target of 2028.

dormant.title_zh: 欧洲央行推出 Pontes，无需稳定币即可结算代币化资产
dormant.title_en: ECB launches Pontes to settle tokenized assets without stablecoins
dormant.latest_update_zh: ECB宣布计划动用一小部分自有储备投资欧元计价的代币化证券，并通过新平台Pontes以央行货币结算；具体规模和时机将在准备工作完成后决定，Pontes预计2028年全面实施。
dormant.latest_update_en: The ECB announced it plans to invest a small portion of its reserves in euro-denominated tokenized securities, settled in central bank money through the new Pontes platform; size and timing will be decided after preparatory work, with full Pontes implementation expected by 2028.

dormant.title_zh: Coinbase 向 CFTC 申请上市美国单只股票永续合约
dormant.title_en: Coinbase Files with CFTC to List US Single-Stock Perpetual Futures
dormant.latest_update_zh: Coinbase Derivatives 已向 CFTC 提交申请，拟上线苹果、特斯拉、英伟达等个股的现金结算永续合约，将境内永续合约布局从股指扩展至单一证券。产品尚未获批或上线。
dormant.latest_update_en: Coinbase Derivatives has filed with the CFTC for cash-settled perpetual futures on individual stocks including Apple, Tesla, and Nvidia, extending its domestic perpetual futures push from equity indexes to single securities. Products are not yet approved or live.

archived.title_zh: Chainalysis 报告朝鲜和伊朗相关黑客推动链上恶意软件活动激增
archived.title_en: State hackers drive 420% surge in onchain malware, Chainalysis finds
archived.latest_update_zh: Chainalysis 报告补充了伊朗关联行为者将命令与控制路由信息嵌入发送至中本聪相关比特币地址的交易中，并指出高容量开源权重中国 AI 模型出现后恶意区块链写入从每天 2.06 次升至 11.1 次（增长 440%）。
archived.latest_update_en: Chainalysis report added that suspected Iran-linked actors embed command-and-control routing data inside Bitcoin transactions sent to a Satoshi Nakamoto-associated address, and that malicious blockchain writes rose from 2.06 to 11.1 per day (a 440% increase) after the emergence of high-capacity open-weight Chinese AI models.

archived.title_zh: CFTC 向白宫提交加密资产规则制定，未等国会先行推进
archived.title_en: CFTC files crypto asset rulemaking with White House, pressing ahead without Congress
archived.latest_update_zh: 该规则制定已明确为 RIN 3038-AF80，并于9月17日提交白宫 OIRA，目前处于 pre-rule（预规则）阶段，而非拟议规则；此事发生在参议院阻止 CLARITY Act 两天后。
archived.latest_update_en: The rulemaking is identified as RIN 3038-AF80 and was filed with White House OIRA on Sept. 17 at the prerule stage, not as a proposed rule, two days after the Senate blocked the CLARITY Act.

archived.title_zh: 美国因涉嫌向 IRGC 转移比特币而制裁伊朗加密交易所 BitBank
archived.title_en: US sanctions Iranian crypto exchange BitBank over alleged bitcoin transfers to IRGC
archived.latest_update_zh: OFAC还指定了与BitBank相关的另外五名个人和实体，并披露BitBank由Babak Zanjani控制，在6月至7月间转移了数亿美元比特币给IRGC，且Hormuz Safe自6月以来通过BitBank处理通行费支付。
archived.latest_update_en: OFAC also designated five additional individuals and entities tied to BitBank, and disclosed that BitBank is controlled by Babak Zanjani, moved hundreds of millions in Bitcoin to the IRGC between June and July, and that Hormuz Safe has routed toll payments through BitBank since June.

archived.title_zh: 美国众议院加密税收方案未包含挖矿和质押奖励延期纳税条款
archived.title_en: US House crypto tax package omits mining, staking reward deferral
archived.latest_update_zh: 众议院筹款委员会于9月16日以38票对5票批准了H.R. 10357《数字资产税收确定性法案》，并采纳了主席杰森·史密斯的替代案，将该法案推进至众议院全体会议；行业团体继续寻求扩大日常支付豁免并调整质押和挖矿奖励的纳税时点。
archived.latest_update_en: The House Ways and Means Committee approved H.R. 10357, the Digital Asset Tax Certainty Act, by 38-5 on Sept. 16, adopting Chairman Jason Smith’s substitute and sending the bill to the full House; industry groups continue to seek broader everyday-payment relief and changes to when staking and mining rewards become taxable.

archived.title_zh: Bybit 上线英伟达与 SpaceX 永续期权
archived.title_en: Industry First: TradFi Perp Options, a new way to trade Stock Perpetuals.
archived.latest_update_zh: Bybit 已于 2026 年 9 月 17 日正式上线 NVIDIA 和 SpaceX 的永续期权，支持 24/7 交易、碎股、统一交易账户组合保证金及完整策略支持。
archived.latest_update_en: Bybit officially launched perpetual options on NVIDIA and SpaceX on September 17, 2026, with 24/7 trading, fractional lots, Unified Trading Account portfolio margin, and full strategy support.

archived.title_zh: 韩国警方以非法赌博罪名起诉26名Polymarket用户：报道
archived.title_en: South Korean police charge 26 Polymarket users for illegal gambling: report
archived.latest_update_zh: 韩国警方已将26名Polymarket用户中的18人移送检方，案件涉及非法赌博调查；这些用户合计下注约1270万美元，单人最高下注约410万美元。
archived.latest_update_en: South Korean police referred 18 of 26 Polymarket users to prosecutors in the illegal gambling probe; the users collectively wagered about $12.7 million, with the largest single user wagering about $4.1 million.

archived.title_zh: 标普全球收购智能合约安全公司OpenZeppelin
archived.title_en: S&P Global to acquire blockchain security platform OpenZeppelin
archived.latest_update_zh: 收购后 OpenZeppelin 将作为 S&P Global 旗下独立业务部门继续运营，联合创始人兼 CEO Demian Brener 留任并直接向 S&P Global Ratings 总裁 Yann Le Pallec 汇报；交易财务条款未披露。
archived.latest_update_en: After the acquisition, OpenZeppelin will continue operating as a separate S&P Global business unit, with co-founder and CEO Demian Brener remaining in charge and reporting to S&P Global Ratings President Yann Le Pallec; financial terms were not disclosed.

archived.title_zh: Revolut 黑客索要 300 万美元门罗币，威胁出售客户数据
archived.title_en: Revolut hackers demand $3 million in Monero, threaten to sell customer data
archived.latest_update_zh: Revolut 表示未收到该团体任何直接联系或勒索要求，并称受影响客户数量“有限”、资金和系统未受影响；报道补充称数据通过入侵意大利政府邮件系统、以真实域名和有效认证伪装的信息请求在数月内获取，攻击者先用链上分析筛选高净值用户，并已向 FT 展示文件录屏。
archived.latest_update_en: Revolut said it has not received any direct contact or demand from the group, called the number of affected customers 'limited,' and said funds and systems were untouched; the report adds that data was obtained via a compromised Italian government email system using genuine domains and valid authentication over months, with attackers using blockchain analysis to target high-net-worth users and showing the FT a screen recording of files.

archived.title_zh: Circle 推出 Arc 主网，贝莱德、DTCC、Visa 等机构参与验证
archived.title_en: Circle Launches Arc Mainnet with BlackRock, DTCC, Visa Among Validators
archived.latest_update_zh: Circle上线Arc的公开主网，这是一条一层区块链，让单一USDC余额即可同时覆盖支付和网络费用，旨在提升USDC相对Tether的实用性。
archived.latest_update_en: Circle launched the public mainnet of Arc, a layer-1 blockchain that lets a single USDC balance cover both payments and network fees, aiming to boost USDC utility against Tether.

archived.title_zh: CLARITY法案受挫后，加密行业将目光转向SEC和CFTC
archived.title_en: Crypto Industry Points to SEC and CFTC After CLARITY Setback
archived.latest_update_zh: CFTC 工作人员将 Introducing Broker 豁免扩大至被动软件，同时 SEC 的五年期代币化美股豁免明确适用于许可型自动做市商（而非无需许可区块链）。
archived.latest_update_en: CFTC staff extended introducing-broker relief to passive software, and the SEC's five-year tokenized U.S. stock exemption was specified as applying to permissioned automated market makers (rather than permissionless blockchains).

archived.title_zh: Celsius在交易所关停前11天向BitMEX索赔4.95亿美元
archived.title_en: Celsius sues BitMEX for $495 million just 11 days before exchange shutdown
archived.latest_update_zh: 新报道进一步披露 Celsius 在 BitMEX 上交易的是杠杆衍生品 XBTM20，并指出 Alex Mashinsky 在清算后一天公开声称 Celsius 不做交易，与债务人的指控相矛盾。
archived.latest_update_en: The new report further details that Celsius traded the leveraged derivative XBTM20 on BitMEX and that Alex Mashinsky publicly claimed one day after the liquidation that Celsius did not trade, contradicting the debtors' allegations.

archived.title_zh: Revolut 误信伪造政府请求，泄露护照与比特币交易数据
archived.title_en: Bitcoin activity, passports exposed after Revolut falls for fake government request
archived.latest_update_zh: 攻击者“iamnotavillain”声称对Revolut数据泄露负责，索要300万美元门罗币赎金，威胁若不支付将出售被盗客户数据；谈判尚未开始，Revolut称未收到任何要求；路透社称约680名客户受影响。
archived.latest_update_en: Attackers "iamnotavillain" claimed responsibility for the Revolut data breach and demanded $3 million in Monero ransom, threatening to sell stolen customer data if unpaid; negotiations have not begun, Revolut said it has received no demands; Reuters reported about 680 customers affected.

archived.title_zh: 评级巨头 S&P Global 收购 OpenZeppelin，推进代币化金融风险布局
archived.title_en: Ratings giant S&P Global acquires OpenZeppelin in tokenized finance risk push
archived.latest_update_zh: 该交易是收购协议而非已完成收购，OpenZeppelin 将作为 S&P Global 的独立业务部门运营，财务条款未披露。
archived.latest_update_en: The deal is an agreement to acquire rather than a completed acquisition, and OpenZeppelin will operate as a standalone business unit under S&P Global; financial terms were not disclosed.

archived.title_zh: 美国比特币储备周三面临关键的两党考验
archived.title_en: The US Bitcoin reserve faces a crucial bipartisan test Wednesday
archived.latest_update_zh: 美国众议院金融服务委员会以 28-21 的投票结果通过了《2026 年美国储备现代化法案》(H.R. 8957)，该法案将把特朗普的战略比特币储备编入法律，并要求联邦没收的比特币至少持有 20 年。
archived.latest_update_en: The House Financial Services Committee passed the American Reserve Modernization Act of 2026 (H.R. 8957) by a 28-21 vote, advancing the bill to codify Trump's strategic Bitcoin reserve and require federally forfeited Bitcoin to be held at least 20 years.

archived.title_zh: 两名Robinhood工程师被控利用Hyperliquid永续合约进行内幕交易
archived.title_en: Two Robinhood engineers charged with insider trading using Hyperliquid perpetuals
archived.latest_update_zh: 检方确认两名被控工程师为 Hefu Chai 和 Huaisong Xiang，并具体指控其电汇欺诈和商品欺诈，称二人在 2025 至 2026 年间各获利超过 5 万美元。
archived.latest_update_en: Prosecutors identified the two charged engineers as Hefu Chai and Huaisong Xiang, specified wire fraud and commodities fraud charges, and alleged each profited over $50,000 across 2025–2026.

archived.title_zh: Solana 激活 Transaction V1，交易数据容量提升三倍并迈向 250 毫秒插槽
archived.title_en: Solana to triple transaction size as apps get room for more complex trades
archived.latest_update_zh: Solana 于 9 月 15 日激活 Transaction V1，将单笔交易数据容量扩大三倍以上至 4,096 字节，并准备将 slot 时间缩短至 250ms。
archived.latest_update_en: Solana activated Transaction V1 on Sept. 15, increasing per-transaction data capacity by more than threefold to 4,096 bytes, and is preparing to cut slot times to 250ms.

archived.title_zh: Hyperliquid 与 Kraken 母公司洽谈进军美国永续合约市场
archived.title_en: Hyperliquid in Talks With Kraken Parent for US Perps Market Entry
archived.latest_update_zh: Kraken 母公司计划向美国交易者提供需许可的 Hyperliquid 永续合约，由 Bitnomial 部署、管理、清算和结算拟议市场，NinjaTrader Clearing 承载获批客户账户。
archived.latest_update_en: Kraken parent plans to offer permissioned Hyperliquid perpetual futures to US traders, with Bitnomial deploying, administering, clearing, and settling the proposed markets and NinjaTrader Clearing carrying approved customer accounts.

archived.title_zh: 欧洲央行呼吁商户参与数字欧元试点
archived.title_en: European Central Bank calls for merchants to participate in digital euro pilot
archived.latest_update_zh: 新增申请截止日期为10月27日，并披露试点细节：beta数字欧元不具法定货币地位、参与自愿且无偿、商户将参与远程/commerce结账测试。
archived.latest_update_en: Added application deadline of Oct. 27 and disclosed pilot details: beta digital euro will not have legal tender status, participation is voluntary and unpaid, and merchants will test remote/commerce checkout use.

archived.title_zh: 美国提起民事没收诉讼，指控币安被用于伊朗石油网络洗钱
archived.title_en: Binance used to launder illegal oil money, U.S. alleges - Investment Executive
archived.latest_update_zh: 美国检方提起民事没收诉讼，寻求没收10个Tron地址上约6120万USDT，这些地址据称与一个15亿美元的伊朗石油网络有关，Tether已冻结其中几个地址，币安被点名但未被指控有不当行为。
archived.latest_update_en: US prosecutors filed a civil forfeiture complaint to seize roughly 61.2 million USDT across 10 Tron addresses allegedly linked to a $1.5 billion Iranian oil network, with Tether already freezing several addresses and Binance named but not accused of wrongdoing.

archived.title_zh: Robinhood Chain：基于以太坊 Layer-2 的代币化股票与 Meme 币网络
archived.title_en: What Is Robinhood Chain? The Ethereum Layer-2 Network for Tokenized Stocks and Meme Coins
archived.latest_update_zh: Robinhood Chain 的 TVL 已接近 10 亿美元，日 DEX 交易量达 18.8 亿美元，稳定币市值突破 10 亿美元；分析师将增长归因于品牌、无许可设计、补贴 Gas 费和 Meme 币/代币化股票飞轮效应。
archived.latest_update_en: Robinhood Chain's TVL has climbed to nearly $1 billion, daily DEX volume reached $1.88 billion, and stablecoin market cap surpassed $1 billion; analyst attributes growth to brand, permissionless design, subsidized gas fees, and a memecoin/tokenized-stock flywheel.

archived.title_zh: 印度通过REC启动代币化公司债券试点
archived.title_en: India Launches Pilot for Tokenized Corporate Bonds via REC
archived.latest_update_zh: 披露试点名称为“Demat 2.0”，REC、Larsen & Toubro与IIFL Finance三家发行人合计融资1,025 crore卢比（约1.07亿美元）；REC于9月7日率先发行500 crore卢比。系统通过统一市场接口链接RBI批发数字卢比实现原子结算，后续阶段将引入二级交易和零售参与。
archived.latest_update_en: Disclosed the pilot name "Demat 2.0"; three issuers—REC, Larsen & Toubro and IIFL Finance—raised a combined 1,025 crore rupees (~$107 million), with REC first on Sept. 7 raising 500 crore rupees. The system links to the RBI's wholesale digital rupee via a Unified Market Interface for atomic settlement; later phases will add secondary trading and retail access.

archived.title_zh: 周一提现关闭后，七种资产进入Kraken清算窗口 - CryptoSlate
archived.title_en: Seven assets enter Kraken liquidation window after withdrawals close Monday - CryptoSlate
archived.latest_update_zh: Kraken 针对阿联酋居民客户的七项资产（XMR、ZEC、DASH、USDD、DAI、USDS、USDE）提现于9月14日14:00 UTC关闭，清算窗口为9月15日至25日，且不保证清算所得币种。
archived.latest_update_en: Kraken's withdrawal cutoff for seven assets (XMR, ZEC, DASH, USDD, DAI, USDS, USDE) for UAE-resident clients is Sept. 14 at 14:00 UTC, with liquidation scheduled Sept. 15–25 and no guaranteed proceeds currency.

archived.title_zh: 纳斯达克向Kraken母公司Payward投资1亿美元
archived.title_en: Nasdaq Invests $100 Million in Kraken Parent Payward
archived.latest_update_zh: 新信息澄清该1亿美元投资为拟议/已同意但未完成交易，未披露交割日期、估值、持股比例或治理权；并新增NET目标于2027年第二季度推出且代币尚未上线。
archived.latest_update_en: New facts clarify the $100 million investment is proposed/agreed but not completed, with no closing date, valuation, ownership percentage or governance rights disclosed; adds NET launch target of Q2 2027 and that tokens are not live.

archived.title_zh: 印度 SEBI 与 RBI 启动代币化债券试点，以数字卢比结算
archived.title_en: India starts tokenizing $620 billion corporate bond market with digital rupee settlement
archived.latest_update_zh: 印度证券交易委员会（SEBI）与印度储备银行正式启动 Demat 2.0 代币化公司债试点；REC、Larsen & Toubro 和 IIFL 合计发行 102.5 亿卢比（约1.07亿美元），通过分布式账本与批发型 CBDC 结算。
archived.latest_update_en: SEBI and RBI formally launched the Demat 2.0 tokenized corporate bond pilot; REC, Larsen & Toubro and IIFL issued a combined 10.25 billion rupees (~$107 million) on distributed ledger infrastructure linked to wholesale CBDC settlement.

archived.title_zh: Nomic 桥漏洞导致 allBTC 部分失去支撑，Osmosis 冻结 22.65 枚 BTC
archived.title_en: Osmosis freezes 22.65 BTC after Nomic forwarding bug compromises Bitcoin reserves
archived.latest_update_zh: 新披露：攻击发生于6月25日，攻击者利用两个漏洞凭空铸造40.650602 BTC的nBTC；74天后才发现；攻击者通过671 ETH至Tornado Cash套现约100万美元；治理提案拟没收冻结的22.65 allBTC、取消USDC.noble流动性重新部署并动用Community Pool填补40 BTC缺口。
archived.latest_update_en: Newly disclosed: exploit occurred June 25; attacker used two bugs to mint 40.650602 BTC of unbacked nBTC; detection took 74 days; attacker cashed out ~$1M via 671 ETH to Tornado Cash; governance proposal would seize frozen 22.65 allBTC, cancel USDC.noble liquidity re-deployment, and pull Community Pool allBTC to fill the 40 BTC shortfall.

archived.title_zh: Trezor 邮件服务商遭入侵，官方警告用户防范钓鱼攻击
archived.title_en: Trezor Warns of Phishing After Email Provider Breach
archived.latest_update_zh: Brevo 发布事后报告，披露攻击者利用其登录系统的缺陷创建账户、启用单点登录并邀请合法用户进入配置，导致授权边界失效，攻击者因此访问了 138 个客户账户。其中 6 个账户被用于发送钓鱼邮件，联系人从 43 个账户被导出。Trezor 确认钓鱼邮件发送给约 347,000 名订阅者，域名在 20 分钟内于 DNS 层被关闭，但约有 2,500 人在关闭前点击了链接；BitBox 与 CoinTracking 的 Brevo 账户也被用于发送类似钓鱼邮件。
archived.latest_update_en: Brevo published a postmortem disclosing the root cause: an attacker created a Brevo account, enabled single sign-on and invited legitimate users into the configuration, causing an authorization boundary failure that granted access to 138 client accounts. Six accounts were used to send phishing emails and contacts were exported from 43 accounts. Trezor confirmed the phishing email went to roughly 347,000 subscribers, that the domain was disabled at the DNS level within 20 minutes, and that about 2,500 people accessed the link before takedown; Brevo accounts belonging to BitBox and CoinTracking were also used for similar phishing emails.

archived.title_zh: OpenAI 纳维-斯托克斯成果据称附带 Lean 4 形式化证明
archived.title_en: OpenAI says 10,000 AI agents solved a $1 million math problem. Now mathematicians are fighting
archived.latest_update_zh: 据报 OpenAI 的纳维-斯托克斯成果附带 Lean 4 形式化证明，可机器检验；验证成本高昂，外部数学家未验证，并存在训练数据质疑。
archived.latest_update_en: OpenAI's reported Navier-Stokes result reportedly includes a Lean 4 formal proof, enabling machine-checking; verification costs are high, external mathematicians have not verified it, and training-data concerns were raised.

archived.title_zh: OpenAI 宣称 AI 模型解决纳维-斯托克斯千禧难题
archived.title_en: On the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem
archived.latest_update_zh: 新报道补充：GPT-6 Astra在Lean中形式化并验证了证明，额外耗时17小时；证明显示初始光滑流体可在有限时间内形成奇点并保持有限能量，对应千禧年问题情形C和D；OpenAI已公开证明及Lean形式化供独立审查。
archived.latest_update_en: New report adds: GPT-6 Astra formalized and verified the proof in Lean, taking an additional 17 hours; the proof shows an initially smooth fluid can develop a singularity in finite time while retaining finite energy, establishing cases C and D of the Millennium Prize formulation; OpenAI released the proof and Lean formalization for independent scrutiny.

archived.title_zh: Uniswap推出“StablePair Hook”，帮助流动性提供者获取更多稳定币交易价值
archived.title_en: Uniswap launches ‘StablePair Hook’ to help LPs capture more stablecoin trading value
archived.latest_update_zh: Uniswap 在两个以太坊稳定币交易对资金池（USDC/USDT 和 USDC/USDG）上线动态费用，价格区间外的纠正交易需支付每区块递减的费用。
archived.latest_update_en: Uniswap launched dynamic fees on two Ethereum stable-pair pools pairing USDC with USDT and USDG, where corrective trades outside the price band incur a fee that decreases each block.

archived.title_zh: 纳斯达克以210亿美元估值向Kraken母公司Payward投资1亿美元
archived.title_en: Nasdaq invests $100 million in Kraken parent company Payward at $21 billion valuation
archived.latest_update_zh: Payward 将在其加密、股票、代币化股票、期货和期权交易场所采用 Nasdaq 的监控技术。
archived.latest_update_en: Payward will adopt Nasdaq's surveillance technology across its crypto, equities, tokenized equities, futures, and options venues.

archived.title_zh: 纳斯达克、斯图加特证券交易所等呼吁欧盟取消或提高代币化试点上限
archived.title_en: Nasdaq, Boerse Stuttgart, others ask EU to remove or increase cap in tokenization trial
archived.latest_update_zh: 欧洲金融与代币化团体（包括纳斯达克、Boerse Stuttgart等）于9月7日致函欧盟理事会成员及欧洲议会经济与货币事务委员会，要求取消拟议的1000亿欧元代币化证券上限，或至少将其提高至5000亿欧元作为基线；信中提及部分现有欧洲项目规模已达3500亿欧元，并对比美国无上限的代币化结算平台。
archived.latest_update_en: European finance and tokenization groups including Nasdaq and Boerse Stuttgart sent a draft letter dated Sept 7 to EU Council members and the European Parliament's ECON committee, urging removal of the proposed €100 billion cap on tokenized securities or raising it to at least €500 billion as a baseline; the letter cites existing European projects already at €350 billion scale and contrasts the US where a dominant settlement platform tokenizes assets without volume caps.

archived.title_zh: 美国特勤局冻结与Telegram诈骗市场Xinbi相关的5280万美元加密资产
archived.title_en: Secret Service Freezes $52.8 Million in Crypto Tied to Telegram Bazaar Behind Global Scams
archived.latest_update_zh: 新增：联邦法院于9月7日授权扣押与Xinbi相关的Telegram频道；调查人员扣押两个约1200万美元的钱包并寻求限制47个额外地址；财政部制裁SafeW Technology和Anwen Technology；Xinbi将商户协调转向SafeW并推出XinbiPay。
archived.latest_update_en: New: federal court authorized seizure of Xinbi-linked Telegram channels on Sept. 7; investigators seized two wallets holding about $12 million and sought restraint of 47 additional addresses; Treasury sanctioned SafeW Technology and Anwen Technology; Xinbi shifted merchant coordination to SafeW and introduced XinbiPay.

archived.title_zh: DeepSeek 发布 V4.1-Flash，缓存命中定价极低
archived.title_en: DeepSeek launching v4.1 flash cheaper and more capable than v4 pro
archived.latest_update_zh: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 已在 Hugging Face 发布，参数规模 552B，并提供详细技术报告。
archived.latest_update_en: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash has been released on Hugging Face, with 552B parameters and a detailed technical report.

archived.title_zh: 美国财政部制裁另一个广泛存在的网络诈骗中心Xinbi Guarantee
archived.title_en: U.S. Treasury sanctions another widespread cyber-scam hub, Xinbi Guarantee
archived.latest_update_zh: 美国司法部查封了与 Xinbi Guarantee 相关的两个钱包（约1200万美元），并申请限制另外47个钱包，总计涉及超过5200万美元加密货币；OFAC 将 Xinbi 指定为重大跨国犯罪组织，并制裁了 SafeW Technology 和 Anwen Technology。
archived.latest_update_en: The U.S. Justice Department seized two wallets linked to Xinbi Guarantee containing about $12 million and sought restraints on 47 additional wallets, totaling over $52 million in crypto; OFAC designated Xinbi as a significant transnational criminal organization and sanctioned SafeW Technology and Anwen Technology.

archived.title_zh: 德国财政部提议自2028年起对加密货币征收25%税率：报道
archived.title_en: German finance ministry proposes 25% crypto tax starting 2028: Report
archived.latest_update_zh: 明确该25%加密资产收益税自2027年1月1日起适用于该日期后购买的资产（而非2028年），并规定自2028年起由平台自动预扣，同时适用团结附加税。
archived.latest_update_en: Clarifies that the 25% tax on crypto gains applies from January 1, 2027 (not 2028) to assets bought after that date, with automatic withholding starting in 2028 and the solidarity surcharge applicable.

archived.title_zh: Tether与Fasanara推出4亿美元私募信贷基金StableFund
archived.title_en: Tether and Fasanara Capital Launch $400 Million Private Credit Fund to Expand Stablecoin-Enabled Real-Economy Lending

archived.latest_update_en: The fund aims to raise up to $3 billion from institutional investors, named StableFund, structured as an evergreen fund, with Fasanara managing investments and Tether providing USDT settlement infrastructure and sourcing financing opportunities, focusing on SME and consumer lending including trade receivables and supply chain finance.

archived.title_zh: 加密行业团体升级对伊利诺伊州的抗争，请求法院阻止争议性加密税
archived.title_en: Crypto industry groups escalate fight against Illinois, asking court to block controversial crypto tax
archived.latest_update_zh: 加密行业团体（CCI和Blockchain Association）提交初步禁令动议，寻求在2027年1月生效日期前阻止伊利诺伊州0.2%的加密交易税。
archived.latest_update_en: Crypto industry groups (CCI and Blockchain Association) filed a motion for a preliminary injunction to block Illinois' 0.2% crypto transaction tax before its January 2027 effective date.

archived.title_zh: Consensys 将拆分为 MetaMask 和机构区块链公司
archived.title_en: Consensys splits MetaMask from institutional and Ethereum infrastructure businesses
archived.latest_update_zh: 新成立的Consensys公司领导层确定：Mike Kriak担任CEO，David Cunningham担任总裁，Joe Lubin担任执行董事长；同时MetaMask的Joe Lubin担任董事长兼CEO。
archived.latest_update_en: The new Consensys leadership is set: Mike Kriak as CEO, David Cunningham as President, and Joe Lubin as Executive Chairman; additionally, Joe Lubin serves as both Chairman and CEO of MetaMask.

archived.title_zh: Jack Dorsey的Block加入向OCC申请联邦银行牌照的热潮
archived.title_en: Jack Dorsey’s Block joins rush for federal bank charters from OCC
archived.latest_update_zh: Block 已向 OCC 正式提交申请，拟成立名为 Builders Bank & Trust 的全国性信托银行，提供受联邦监管的比特币和稳定币托管服务，且不吸收存款或发放贷款。李·伍利将担任总裁兼首席执行官。
archived.latest_update_en: Block has formally applied to the OCC to create Builders Bank & Trust, an uninsured national trust bank offering federally supervised Bitcoin and stablecoin custody, without accepting deposits or issuing loans. Lee Woolley would serve as President and CEO.

archived.title_zh: Visa将VisaNet数据接入链上借贷以支持稳定币卡业务
archived.title_en: Visa combines VisaNet data with onchain lending to power stablecoin card working capital
archived.latest_update_zh: Visa宣布其稳定币结算量年化率已超过200亿美元，与Credit Coop的早期融资模式自2023年以来支持了超过25亿美元的累计结算量，且零违约。
archived.latest_update_en: Visa announced that its stablecoin settlement volume has exceeded a $20 billion annualized rate, and an early financing model with Credit Coop has supported more than $2.5 billion in cumulative settlement volume since 2023 with zero defaults.

archived.title_zh: Malone Lam因2.45亿美元比特币盗窃案面临认罪听证
archived.title_en: Malone Lam Faces Plea Hearing Over $245M Bitcoin Theft
archived.latest_update_zh: Malone Lam 认罪，承认主导了一起 2.45 亿美元的加密货币社会工程诈骗案。
archived.latest_update_en: Malone Lam pleaded guilty to leading a $245M cryptocurrency social engineering scheme.

archived.title_zh: 白帽黑客提取3.2亿美元比特币，Liquid网络暂停
archived.title_en: Liquid Network pauses after purported ‘white-hat’ hackers withdraw $320 million in bitcoin
archived.latest_update_zh: 确认了攻击者广播的归还交易已在区块965950中于16:09:25 UTC得到确认，实际返还3,400 BTC至联邦钱包，黑客保留598.5 BTC（约合4700万美元），并在链上留言询问是否可接受。Blockstream状态页面仍显示活动事件和公共桥接节点中断，完整的L-BTC支持和赎回通道尚未恢复。
archived.latest_update_en: Confirmed that the attacker's broadcast return transaction was confirmed in block 965950 at 16:09:25 UTC, actually returning 3,400 BTC to the federation wallet, while the hacker retained approximately 598.5 BTC (~$47 million), with an on-chain message asking 'is that ok.' Blockstream's status page still lists an active incident and major outage affecting public bridge nodes; full L-BTC backing and redemption access are not yet restored.

archived.title_zh: 以太坊基金会为 Hegotá 升级指定 2 个“必须交付”的 EIP
archived.title_en: Ethereum Foundation names 2 ‘must ship’ EIPs for Hegotá upgrade
archived.latest_update_zh: 以太坊基金会将Hegotá升级范围缩小至FOCIL和Frame Transactions，并推迟发行量变更（放弃逐渐减少的发行量和强制燃烧执行奖励），将其归入更广泛的生态系统流程。

other.title_zh: Anthropic私下游说美国议员推动前沿AI安全草案，设定政府干预门槛
