other.title_zh: Cysic 加密跨链桥在 1000 万枚 CYS 被未经授权铸造后暂停
other.title_en: Cysic crypto bridge halted after unauthorized mint of 10M CYS
other.latest_update_zh: Cysic 补充称攻击发生于 10 月 17 日，黑客获取跨链服务相关数据库访问权限并提交虚假铸造消息；本次事件仅影响跨链桥消息处理与铸造功能，未影响 Cysic 主网或用户钱包现有资产，团队已聘请安全公司调查攻击路径并追踪资金。
other.latest_update_en: Cysic added that the attack occurred on October 17 after the attacker gained access to a database related to the cross-chain service and submitted false mint messages; the incident was limited to the bridge's message-processing and minting functions, did not affect the Cysic mainnet or existing assets in user wallets, and the team hired a security firm to investigate the attack path and trace funds.

other.title_zh: Anthropic披露Claude Code团队以AI审查AI的大规模代码审查实践
other.title_en: Anthropic details AI-reviewing-AI code review practice for Claude Code team
other.latest_update_zh: Anthropic 披露，Claude Code 约 90% 的代码如今由 Claude 编写，并已围绕多智能体 AI 检查与按风险分级的人工审批重建代码审查流程，同时对失控的审查循环设限——此前有一次改动在一夜之间经历了 50 多轮审查。
other.latest_update_en: Anthropic disclosed that roughly 90% of Claude Code's code is now written by Claude and that it has rebuilt code review around multi-agent AI checking with risk-tiered human approval, while capping runaway review loops after one change went through 50+ rounds in a single night.

other.title_zh: Ripple 与多家机构建立基础设施合作
other.title_en: Ripple forms infrastructure partnerships with multiple institutions
other.latest_update_zh:
据彭博社10月15日报道，Ripple旗下主经纪商部门Ripple Prime正面向机构客户推出现实世界资产（RWA）永续合约，覆盖股票、指数、ETF、大宗商品等100多个参考市场。该产品通过Hyperliquid上的Trade.xyz提供，并支持跨仓位共享保证金，延续了Ripple Prime此前向客户开放加密永续合约交易的布局。

Ripple Prime国际首席执行官Michael Higgins表示，此举有助于机构提高资金使用和仓位管理效率。客户既可将永续合约与标的资产配对开展基差交易，也可利用合约进行方向性交易，在传统市场休市期间及周末获取相关资产敞口。

Higgins还表示，传统对冲基金已「非常接近」直接参与代币化RWA市场，关键在于建立符合其交易对手及反洗钱要求的基础设施。据报道，过去一年，数个主要交易平台的RWA永续合约未平仓规模已从接近零增至90亿美元。
other.latest_update_en: Ripple's prime brokerage arm Ripple Prime rolled out institutional RWA perpetual contracts spanning 100+ stock, index, ETF and commodity markets through Hyperliquid-based Trade.xyz, offering shared cross-position margin and weekend/after-hours exposure.

other.title_zh: 德意志银行计划在欧洲为机构客户提供比特币、以太币托管服务
other.title_en: Deutsche Bank plans bitcoin, ether custody for institutional clients in Europe
other.latest_update_zh: 新增：据ESMA临时MiCA登记册，德意志银行已于周一获得德国联邦金融监管局（BaFin）的加密托管授权；初期上线地点明确为德国，并将AllUnity EUR（EURAU）纳入初期支持的稳定币；该行企业银行业务目标为到2028年实现8%的复合年增长。
other.latest_update_en: New: per ESMA's interim MiCA register, Deutsche Bank received crypto custody authorization from Germany's BaFin on Monday; the initial launch is specified for Germany and AllUnity EUR (EURAU) is included among initial stablecoins; the bank targets 8% compound annual growth in corporate banking by 2028.

other.title_zh: Stripe 稳定币卡业务全球扩张并整合 Privy
other.title_en: Stripe expands stablecoin card business globally and integrates Privy
other.latest_update_zh: Link 余额即将推出。
other.latest_update_en: Link balances are launching soon.

other.title_zh: Meta发布Muse Spark Open开源权重模型
other.title_en: Meta launches Muse Spark Open open-weight model
other.latest_update_zh: Meta 新发布的开放权重模型 Muse Spark Open 在 Artificial Analysis 智能指数上得分 39，取代英伟达的 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 成为美国最强开放模型，但落后于小米 MiMo-V2.6-Pro（46）和智谱 GLM-5.3（45）等中国模型，其智能体测试表现明显偏弱，但以同类最佳的知识准确性和更低的 token 成本弥补。
other.latest_update_en: Meta's newly released open-weights model Muse Spark Open scored 39 on the Artificial Analysis intelligence index, displacing Nvidia's Nemotron 3.5 Super VL as the top US open model but trailing Chinese models like Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Pro (46) and Zhipu GLM-5.3 (45), with notably weak agent-test performance offset by best-in-class knowledge accuracy and lower token costs.

other.title_zh: Reflection 推出 Beam：一款以更低算力成本对标中国模型的开源权重 AI 模型
other.title_en: Reflection debuts Beam, an open-weight AI model to rival Chinese models at lower compute cost
other.latest_update_zh: Reflection 已将 Beam 1.0 的权重上传至 Hugging Face，兑现 10 月 5 日预告，采用 Apache 2.0 许可，同时开放 BF16、FP8、NVFP4 版本，支持 100 万 token 上下文。此外还开源了 Mirror CLI 编程智能体框架和 DFlash2 推测解码加速模型，并与 vLLM 团队合作优化推理，单请求解码每步耗时从 8.95ms 降至 3.30ms（2.71 倍提速）。Artificial Analysis 独立评测给 Beam 30 分，在美国开放权重模型中排名第二，但落后于中国模型。发布获 AWS、Google Cloud、英伟达等 40 多家合作伙伴支持。此前报道的英伟达进一步注资或收购 Reflection 的谈判仍在进行中。
other.latest_update_en: Reflection has uploaded the weights of Beam 1.0 to Hugging Face, fulfilling its October 5 preview, under Apache 2.0 with BF16, FP8 and NVFP4 versions and 1M-token context. It also open-sourced the Mirror CLI coding agent framework and DFlash2 speculative decoding accelerator, and worked with vLLM to optimize inference, cutting per-step decoding time for a single request from 8.95 ms to 3.30 ms (2.71x speedup). Artificial Analysis gives Beam a score of 30, ranking second among US open-weight models but behind Chinese models. The release has support from over 40 partners including AWS, Google Cloud and Nvidia. Nvidia's reported talks to further invest in or acquire Reflection are ongoing.

other.title_zh: Evernorth 通过与 Armada 合并登陆纳斯达克并选定机构合作伙伴部署 XRP 储备
other.title_en: Evernorth shareholders approve $1 billion XRP treasury deal, clearing path to Nasdaq debut
other.latest_update_zh: 纳斯达克上市的Evernorth已选择Ripple、Kraken、Coinbase和BitGo作为其首批机构合作伙伴，从第四季度开始部署约4.73亿枚XRP（约6.48亿美元），后续将扩展到XRP Ledger借贷和链上DeFi策略，由前Coinbase Asset Management联合首席投资官Hugo Jeandesboz领导。
other.latest_update_en: Nasdaq-listed Evernorth has selected Ripple, Kraken, Coinbase and BitGo as its first institutional partners to deploy roughly 473 million XRP (about $648 million) starting in Q4, with later expansion into XRP Ledger lending and on-chain DeFi strategies led by former Coinbase Asset Management co-CIO Hugo Jeandesboz.

other.title_zh: 币安推出 bStocks 代币化股票产品并扩展交易对
other.title_en: Binance launches bStocks tokenized equities and expands trading pairs
other.latest_update_zh: 币安宣布，其代币化股票产品 bStocks 上线约四个月后管理资产规模已突破 10 亿美元，累计交易量超过 400 亿美元，约 100 种资产的日交易量超过 3 亿美元，标的股票与代币之间的 1:1 兑换金额超过 60 亿美元。
other.latest_update_en: Binance announced that its tokenized equities product bStocks has surpassed $1 billion in AUM about four months after launch, with over $40 billion in cumulative trading volume, $300 million-plus daily volume across roughly 100 assets, and more than $6 billion in 1:1 conversions between underlying equities and tokens.

other.title_zh: 黑森林FLUX 3 Klein开源：官方自测超Qwen，玩家却嫌不如旧版4B
other.title_en: 黑森林FLUX 3 Klein开源：官方自测超Qwen，玩家却嫌不如旧版4B
other.latest_update_zh: 新增了定价信息（每1000张图0.009美元起），以及开发者反馈：编辑能力较强、细粒度文字较弱、有身体恐怖伪影报告，并面临Krea 3和Moss Image的竞争。
other.latest_update_en: Added pricing details (from $0.009 per 1K images) and developer feedback: solid editing, weak fine-text detail, reports of body-horror artifacts, and competition from Krea 3 and Moss Image.

other.title_zh: 【Circle：2026 上半年收入约 14 亿美元，59% 分给 USDC 合作伙伴】
other.title_en: 【Circle：2026 上半年收入约 14 亿美元，59% 分给 USDC 合作伙伴】
other.latest_update_zh: 新增披露：H1 2026 收入约 14 亿美元中，8.19 亿美元（59%）支付给 USDC 分销合作伙伴及交易成本；另有 4.73 亿美元（34%）用于许可、银行关系、结算流动性、合规和产品开发，净利润约 7%。USDC 在 H1 2026 链上交易量超过 36 万亿美元，6 月约占全球稳定币交易量的 77%。
other.latest_update_en: Added disclosure: of ~$1.4B H1 2026 revenue, $819M (59%) went to USDC distribution partners and transaction costs; another $473M (34%) covered licensing, banking, settlement liquidity, compliance, and product development, leaving ~7% net profit. USDC posted over $36T in H1 2026 on-chain volume and accounted for ~77% of global stablecoin volume in June.

other.title_zh: 自10月30日起，商业账户将被视为同意Meta抓取其网站内容
other.title_en: Business accounts will consent to Meta scraping their websites Starting Oct. 30
other.latest_update_zh: 新报道指出，这些条款还允许Meta利用外部内容来“开发、改进、研究”和“训练”AI，包括在新闻出版商网站上，而不仅仅是抓取和授权内容。
other.latest_update_en: New reporting specifies the terms also allow Meta to use outside content to "develop, improve, research," and "train" AI, including on news publisher sites, not just scrape and license content.

other.title_zh: Filecoin 创世代币归属期结束并调整奖励机制
other.title_en: Filecoin genesis vesting ends and reward mechanism adjusted
other.latest_update_zh: Filecoin 推出其 Solstice 奖励机制，重新分配并销毁奖励，宣布随着创世归属期结束，每日 FIL 发行量下降约 75%，并推出面向企业和 AI 代理的存储产品，包括 Integral Spacetime、兼容 S3 的 Fil One，以及面向代理的链上存储支付工具。
other.latest_update_en: Filecoin introduced its Solstice reward mechanism that reallocates and burns rewards, announced a ~75% drop in daily FIL issuance as genesis vesting ends, and launched enterprise/AI-agent storage products including Integral Spacetime, S3-compatible Fil One, and agent-facing on-chain storage payment tools.

other.title_zh: 比特币因宏观数据与地缘冲突多次跌破关键价位并引发大规模清算
other.title_en: Liquidations jump to $547 million as oil rally hits crypto market
other.latest_update_zh: 在 CPI 和 PPI 数据高于预期后，比特币跌破 80,000 美元，24 小时内引发近 9.48 亿美元的加密清算，使美国现货 ETF 持有者在其约 82,300 美元的平均成本基础附近陷入亏损。
other.latest_update_en: Bitcoin slid below $80,000 after hotter-than-expected CPI and PPI data, driving nearly $948 million in crypto liquidations over 24 hours and leaving U.S. spot ETF holders underwater near their ~$82,300 average cost basis.

other.title_zh: Jupiter推出对标PaperTrade的高杠杆交易产品YOLO，最高支持1000倍杠杆
other.title_en: Jupiter推出对标PaperTrade的高杠杆交易产品YOLO，最高支持1000倍杠杆
other.latest_update_zh: YOLO上线不足24小时交易量突破10亿美元。
other.latest_update_en: YOLO surpassed $1 billion in trading volume within 24 hours of launch.

other.title_zh: 腾讯混元发布Hy Memory 2.0：模型、框架、应用三层全开源，开源记忆框架评测第一
other.title_en: 腾讯混元发布Hy Memory 2.0：模型、框架、应用三层全开源，开源记忆框架评测第一
other.latest_update_zh: 新增披露：Hy Memory 2.0新增工作记忆与代码记忆，可结合Git记录追踪文件和函数修改历史（包括回滚代码追溯）；专用模型为Hy-Memory-30B-A3B（总参数300亿，每次激活约30亿）；四套记忆系统测试平均55.49分，略高于Opus 5的54.62分；MemHub让Cursor、Codex、Claude Code等10款工具共用一份本地记忆。
other.latest_update_en: New details disclosed: Hy Memory 2.0 adds work and Git-linked code memory, tracing file and function modification history including rolled-back code; the dedicated model is Hy-Memory-30B-A3B (30B total parameters, about 3B activated); on four memory system tests it averaged 55.49, slightly above Opus 5's 54.62; MemHub lets 10 tools including Cursor, Codex, and Claude Code share one local memory store.

other.title_zh: 币安宣布将于2026年11月10日停止Binance Pool及相关服务
other.title_en: Binance to Discontinue Binance Pool and Related Services on November 10, 2026
other.latest_update_zh: 币安矿池算力已下跌约65%，矿工迁移至其他矿池，且2022年10月推出的5亿美元借贷计划在关闭通知中未提及；EMCD和OCEAN等替代矿池正积极争取迁出矿工。
other.latest_update_en: Binance Pool's hashrate has fallen roughly 65%, miners are migrating to alternative pools, the $500 million lending program launched in October 2022 was not addressed in the closure notice, and alternative pools including EMCD and OCEAN are actively courting displaced miners.

other.title_zh: Strategy斥资9.508亿美元回购STRC，远超同期比特币买入
other.title_en: Strategy prioritizes $950 million STRC buyback over expanding its Bitcoin treasury
other.latest_update_zh: 截至2026年10月11日，Strategy的USD Cash从8月30日的16.1亿美元降至6.405亿美元，降幅60%；20亿美元STRC回购授权仅剩3.548亿美元；独立USD Reserve同期从51.0亿美元降至48.8亿美元。按近七周约9.7亿美元的消耗速度，若不补充，USD Cash约四周内耗尽。
other.latest_update_en: As of Oct 11, 2026, Strategy's USD Cash fell 60% from $1.61B on Aug 30 to $640.5M; only $354.8M of its $2B STRC buyback authorization remained; the separate USD Reserve declined from $5.10B to $4.88B. At the ~$970M burn pace over less than seven weeks, USD Cash could run out in about four weeks absent replenishment.

other.title_zh: Kling 4.0把单次视频拉到30秒，10月上线
other.title_en: Kling 4.0把单次视频拉到30秒，10月上线
other.latest_update_zh: Kling 4.0于10月15日全量上线（此前9月底仅有Flash向部分付费用户开放），30秒1080P生成约450积分/约16元，新增时间线、画布与Agent功能，并支持通过MCP、CLI调用；10-bit HDR、最长2分钟续拍和开发者API仍未上线。
other.latest_update_en: Kling 4.0 fully rolled out on October 15 (after only a Flash preview for some paying users in late September): ~450 credits (~¥16) for a 30s 1080P clip, new timeline/canvas/Agent features and MCP/CLI access, while 10-bit HDR, up to 2-minute extension and the developer API remain unavailable.

other.title_zh: Anthropic CEO Amodei 呼吁放缓AI发展速度以保障安全
other.title_en: Anthropic chief urges slowdown in AI development to safer pace
other.latest_update_zh: Anthropic 已向 METR 研究人员提供员工级内部系统访问权限，用于独立的风险与事件评估，并同意 METR 有权发布其评估结果，Anthropic 无权阻止。
other.latest_update_en: Anthropic has granted METR researchers employee-level access to its internal systems for independent risk and incident evaluations, and agreed it cannot block METR from publishing its findings.

other.title_zh: 【WSJ：Bo Hines 任职白宫期间，其持股公司通过 Tether 相关合作获 630 万美元】
other.title_en: 【WSJ：Bo Hines 任职白宫期间，其持股公司通过 Tether 相关合作获 630 万美元】
other.latest_update_zh: WSJ/Protos 补充细节：Tether 通过 Bitfinex 与中介 Notorious 向 Nxum 支付，首笔 249 万美元于 2025-05-11 转出；Hines 离开白宫后合同直接转给 Nxum；Nxum 否认 Hines 在白宫期间收到 Tether 相关资金；报道还提及相关超级 PAC 资金。
other.latest_update_en: WSJ/Protos added details: Tether routed payments to Nxum via Bitfinex and intermediary Notorious, with the first $2.49M sent on May 11, 2025; the contract was transferred directly to Nxum after Hines left the White House; Nxum denied Hines received Tether-derived funds during his White House tenure; the report also mentioned related super PAC funding.

other.title_zh: 迪拜VARA批准Kraken母公司Payward运营，Kraken随后在迪拜上线
other.title_en: Dubai VARA Approves Kraken Parent Payward, Kraken Subsequently Launches in Dubai
other.latest_update_zh: Kraken在获得虚拟资产监管局（VARA）的全面市场批准后已在迪拜开展业务，将其受监管业务版图扩展至阿联酋。
other.latest_update_en: Kraken has launched operations in Dubai after receiving full market approval from the Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA), expanding its regulated footprint into the UAE.

other.title_zh: 渣打银行在阿联酋推出比特币和以太坊现货交易
other.title_en: Standard Chartered launches spot Bitcoin and Ether trading in the UAE
other.latest_update_zh: 渣打银行将其在阿联酋的比特币和以太币现货交易扩展至专业投资者，符合条件的客户可在现有银行账户内交易；资格要求净资产至少400万迪拉姆（约110万美元），并计划进一步扩大准入。
other.latest_update_en: Standard Chartered expanded its spot Bitcoin and Ether trading in the UAE to professional investors, allowing eligible clients to trade within existing bank accounts; eligibility requires at least AED 4 million (~$1.1M) in net assets, and the bank plans to broaden access further.

other.title_zh: 欧盟将 Circle 发行的 USDC 认定为首个“重要”电子货币代币，Circle 欧洲赎回政策允许临时延迟
other.title_en: Circle can delay European USDC redemptions if reserves cannot cross borders
other.latest_update_zh: 欧洲银行管理局将 Circle 发行的 USDC 指定为欧盟首个 MiCA 下的“重要”电子货币代币，自 2026 年 11 月 12 日起，将其资本、储备、流动性及恢复/赎回计划的直接监管权从法国 ACPR 移交至 EBA，并配套签署新的 EBA–NYDFS 合作备忘录。
other.latest_update_en: The European Banking Authority designated Circle-issued USDC as the EU's first 'significant' e-money token under MiCA, transferring direct supervision of its capital, reserves, liquidity and recovery/redemption plans to the EBA from France's ACPR starting 12 November 2026, and paired with a new EBA–NYDFS cooperation memorandum.

other.title_zh: 布鲁克林检方捣毁针对俄语使用者的加密骗局背后112台服务器
other.title_en: Brooklyn Prosecutors Take Down 112 Servers Behind Crypto Scam Targeting Russian Speakers
other.latest_update_zh: 新增细节：该行动于上周执行，源自三年调查，基础设施涉及乌克兰及其他东欧国家；未宣布逮捕；诈骗者还以虚假资金追回服务二次接触受害者；布鲁克林地区检察官虚拟货币部门此前已查封或干扰约400个相关域名。
other.latest_update_en: New details: the operation was carried out last week after a three-year investigation, involved infrastructure in Ukraine and other Eastern European countries, no arrests were announced, scammers re-contacted victims with fake recovery offers, and the DA's Virtual Currency Unit had previously seized or disrupted about 400 related domains.

other.title_zh: ⚡️美国9月PPI年率录得6.3%，高于市场预期
other.title_en: ⚡️美国9月PPI年率录得6.3%，高于市场预期
other.latest_update_zh: 核心PPI环比上涨0.7%，同比上涨5.0%，能源成本上涨的影响传导至经济各领域，未来六个月投入价格预期指标升至2022年以来最高，强化了美联储继续加息的预期。
other.latest_update_en: Core PPI rose 0.7% MoM and 5.0% YoY, with energy costs feeding through the economy; the six-month input price expectations gauge rose to its highest since 2022, reinforcing expectations of further Fed tightening.

other.title_zh: Bybit 推出美股与 ETF 交易并开发代币化股票产品 mStocks
other.title_en: Bybit Expands Beyond Crypto With Direct Access to U.S. Stocks & ETFs
other.latest_update_zh: Bybit CEO Ben Zhou 宣布，Bybit 股票交易未来将支持股票作为交易抵押品、推出股票借贷服务，并支持从富途、Moomoo 等券商转仓。
other.latest_update_en: Bybit CEO Ben Zhou announced that Bybit stock trading will in the future support stocks as trading collateral, offer stock lending services, and enable transfers in from brokers such as Futu and Moomoo.

other.title_zh: Coinbase 推进比特币托管的后量子密码学方案
other.title_en: Coinbase Advances Post-Quantum Cryptography Plan for Bitcoin Custody
other.latest_update_zh: Coinbase 发布了一项提案，敦促比特币立即开始为量子计算做准备，建议采用灵活的后量子签名方案、分阶段采用、备份量子安全密钥，并将休眠或迁移延迟钱包的争议作为单独议题处理。
other.latest_update_en: Coinbase published a proposal urging Bitcoin to begin preparing for quantum computers now, recommending flexible post-quantum signature schemes, staged adoption, a backup quantum-proof key, and treating dormant or late-migrating wallets as a separate debate.

other.title_zh: 菲律宾央行限制银行向主要加密平台Coins.ph转账
other.title_en: Philippine Central Bank Curbs Bank Transfers to Major Crypto Platform Coins ph
other.latest_update_zh: 新报道补充称 Coins.ph 多名合规高管离职，包括首席合规官及反洗钱监控负责人，并披露其拥有超 1800 万用户、日现货交易量约 5000 万美元、控制菲律宾约 75%-80% 比索兑稳定币流动性。
other.latest_update_en: New reporting adds that multiple Coins.ph compliance executives have departed, including the chief compliance officer and AML monitoring head, and discloses it has over 18 million users, about $50 million daily spot volume, and controls roughly 75%-80% of Philippine peso-to-stablecoin liquidity.

other.title_zh: 俄罗斯央行发放首批加密货币交易所与托管机构牌照
other.title_en: Russia's central bank issues first crypto exchange and custodian licenses
other.latest_update_zh: 俄罗斯央行授权Sberbank（以及VTB等公司）作为持牌加密货币交易所运营商和托管机构，该银行准备从2026年12月1日起通过其平台提供BTC、ETH和USDT交易。
other.latest_update_en: Russia's central bank authorized Sberbank (alongside VTB and other firms) as a licensed crypto exchange operator and custodian, with the lender preparing to offer BTC, ETH and USDT trading through its platforms starting Dec. 1, 2026.

other.title_zh: Gemini 4 Argon：我们通往前沿智能的下一个时代
other.title_en: Gemini 4 Argon: our next era of frontier intelligence
other.latest_update_zh: 谷歌宣布通过付费版 Gemini API 向全球开发者和企业正式推出 Gemini 4 Argon，并同时开放 Google AI Ultra 订阅使用。这标志着此前受限的 Fairwind Program 首发阶段结束，进入面向开发者/企业的普遍可用阶段。
other.latest_update_en: Google announced the general availability of Gemini 4 Argon through the paid Gemini API for developers and enterprises worldwide, as well as via the Google AI Ultra subscription. This marks the end of the earlier restricted Fairwind Program-only phase and the start of broad developer/enterprise access.

other.title_zh: BNY与Citadel Securities测试代币化美国国债，以加速华尔街融资
other.title_en: BNY, Citadel Securities test tokenized U.S. Treasuries to speed up Wall Street financing
other.latest_update_zh: 新报道明确该交易是主要三方回购平台上首笔使用代币化资产的三方回购：Citadel Securities经BNY在Tradeweb买入一只2年期美国国债，BNY在其私有数字账本上记录代币化版本并在数分钟内完成交割，随后Citadel将该代币化国债作为隔夜三方回购抵押品从BNY获得现金。
other.latest_update_en: The new report specifies the transaction was the first tri-party repo on a major platform using a tokenized asset: Citadel Securities bought a 2-year U.S. Treasury via BNY on Tradeweb, BNY recorded a tokenized version on its private digital ledger and settled in minutes, then Citadel used the tokenized Treasury as collateral for an overnight tri-party repo to obtain cash from BNY.

other.title_zh: Metaplanet 拟发行约 520 亿日元零息可转债，用于偿还比特币担保借款及回购股份
other.title_en: 【Metaplanet 拟发行约 3.33 亿美元零息可转债，用于还款及回购股票】
other.latest_update_zh: Metaplanet CEO Simon Gerovich 将以0.75%年利率出借最多5500万股个人持股，以降低机构投资者对冲借券成本并优化债券发行条件；8月18日宣布的对Super League Enterprise（SLE）的投资预计很快完成，但需经SLE股东大会批准并满足其他交割条件，交易完成后SLE计划更名为Superplanet, Inc.。
other.latest_update_en: Metaplanet CEO Simon Gerovich will lend up to 55 million personal shares at 0.75% annual interest to reduce institutional hedging borrowing costs and optimize bond issuance conditions; the August 18 announced investment in Super League Enterprise (SLE) is expected to complete soon, subject to SLE shareholder approval and other closing conditions, after which SLE plans to rename to Superplanet, Inc.

other.title_zh: 【Polygon Labs 已完成对 Coinme 的收购】
other.title_en: 【Polygon Labs 已完成对 Coinme 的收购】
other.latest_update_zh: 新增监管覆盖细节：OMS 已覆盖美国 48 个州，持有 37 张州级货币转账牌照、11 项豁免资格，并在 FinCEN 注册为货币服务业务机构。
other.latest_update_en: Added regulatory coverage details: OMS covers 48 US states with 37 state money transmitter licenses, 11 exemptions, and FinCEN MSB registration.

other.title_zh: 荷兰央行授予Qivalis电子货币牌照，用于符合MiCA的欧元代币
other.title_en: Dutch central bank grants Qivalis e-money license for MiCA-compliant euro token
other.latest_update_zh: 披露 Qivalis 由 37 家欧洲主要银行支持，需满足 MiCA 其余要求（包括发布白皮书）后方可发行代币，计划未来几个月内发行，并通过银行、加密货币交易所和支付服务提供商分发，而非直接面向消费者。
other.latest_update_en: Disclosed that Qivalis is backed by 37 major European banks, must meet remaining MiCA requirements including publishing a whitepaper before token issuance, plans issuance in coming months, and will distribute via banks, crypto exchanges and payment service providers rather than directly to consumers.

other.title_zh: 【StarkWare 推出 OffMarket，支持 Polymarket 用户进行隐私交易】
other.title_en: 【StarkWare 推出 OffMarket，支持 Polymarket 用户进行隐私交易】
other.latest_update_zh: OffMarket 已向公众开放（此前自8月起小范围试用），基于 Starknet 零知识共享隐私池；合约经 OpenZeppelin 审计并完成形式化验证；目前每账户存款上限 1000 USDC，池内约 150 万美元、1.7 万笔存款；服务非 Polymarket 官方产品，属其验证 Builder 计划，沿用地理限制包括禁止美国用户；独立合规机构 Financial Privacy Inc. 保管主查看密钥用于制裁筛查及合法披露。
other.latest_update_en: OffMarket is now open to the public (following a limited trial since August), based on a Starknet zero-knowledge shared privacy pool; contracts audited by OpenZeppelin and formally verified; current deposit cap of 1,000 USDC per account, with about $1.5M and 17k deposits in the pool; not an official Polymarket product, part of its verified Builder program, subject to geographic restrictions including a U.S. ban; independent compliance firm Financial Privacy Inc. holds the master viewing key for sanctions screening and lawful disclosure.

other.title_zh: OpenAI正洽谈收购加密安全公司Trail of Bits
other.title_en: OpenAI正洽谈收购加密安全公司Trail of Bits
other.latest_update_zh: 收购谈判被报道是由一起安全事件引发的：OpenAI会议室发现隐藏录音设备，一名工程师已被FBI逮捕。
other.latest_update_en: The acquisition talks are reported to be motivated by a security incident: a hidden recording device found in an OpenAI conference room, with an engineer arrested by the FBI.

other.title_zh: Blur 宣布关闭网站前端并停止匹配新 Blend 贷款
other.title_en: Blur to Shut Down Website Frontend and Stop Matching New Blend Loans
other.latest_update_zh: Blur宣布将于11月12日关闭其网站前端，并停止Blend匹配新的NFT贷款，此举引发收藏者的欢呼，他们认为其免版税模式和代币激励损害了NFT市场。
other.latest_update_en: Blur announced it will shut down its website frontend on Nov. 12 and stop Blend from matching new NFT loans, prompting cheers from collectors who blame its royalty-free model and token incentives for damaging the NFT market.

other.title_zh: Meta发布Muse Wonder与Muse Wonder Full前沿AI模型
other.title_en: Meta releases Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full frontier AI models
other.latest_update_zh: 新报道补充了Muse Wonder与Muse Wonder Full发布后的更多细节：两款模型引入Active Memory与Active Focus能力；Artificial Analysis独立评分显示Muse Wonder Full为56、Muse Wonder为52，高于Claude Fable 5.1与GPT-6 Astra的53，但低于Claude Opus 5.5的58；Abacus.AI的Bindu Reddy质疑Muse Wonder表现；标准版Wonder每百万输入token收费4美元，Wonder Full仅限Muse Code每月50美元或200美元订阅档。
other.latest_update_en: New reporting adds more post-launch details for Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full: the models introduce Active Memory and Active Focus capabilities; Artificial Analysis independent scores show Muse Wonder Full at 56 and Muse Wonder at 52, above Claude Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra at 53 but below Claude Opus 5.5 at 58; Abacus.AI's Bindu Reddy challenged Muse Wonder's performance; standard Wonder charges $4 per million input tokens, and Wonder Full is limited to Muse Code's $50 or $200 monthly subscription tiers.

other.title_zh: 【钱志敏 400 亿非法集资案进展：检方申请没收 6.18 万余枚比特币等资产，法院已受理】
other.title_en: 【钱志敏 400 亿非法集资案进展：检方申请没收 6.18 万余枚比特币等资产，法院已受理】
other.latest_update_zh: 天津二中院于9月28日立案受理该没收申请，并于10月13日发布公告；同时披露了更详细的没收财产清单，包括72,745.79502枚BCH、72,745.78555枚BSV、72,745.7845枚BCH（中本聪愿景）、3,605,989.9995枚XRP、70,081,208.62553222枚DOGE（已由英国司法机关转换后存入计息账户）以及美元、欧元、英镑现金、珠宝、银行余额和投资组合等。
other.latest_update_en: The Tianjin No. 2 Intermediate Court accepted the confiscation application on Sept 28 and issued an announcement on Oct 13; it also disclosed a more detailed asset list including 72,745.79502 BCH, 72,745.78555 BSV, 72,745.7845 BCH (Satoshi Vision), 3,605,989.9995 XRP, 70,081,208.62553222 DOGE (converted by UK judicial authorities into an interest-bearing account), plus USD, EUR, GBP cash, jewelry, bank balances and investment portfolios.

other.title_zh: Anthropic 重新设计源代码管理
other.title_en: Redesigning source control at Anthropic
other.latest_update_zh: 补充确认Anthropic主仓库已从Git迁出，迁移至自研版本控制系统Scion；该系统由7名工程师借助Claude在5个月内开发，并配套推出代码审查工具Antique。
other.latest_update_en: Added confirmation that Anthropic migrated its main repository off Git to the purpose-built VCS Scion, developed by 7 engineers over 5 months with Claude assistance, alongside a code review tool called Antique.

other.title_zh: PancakeSwap核心团队在治理论坛提出"The Flip"提案：LP分成升至88%，CAKE排放削减约69%
other.title_en: PancakeSwap Proposes Raising LP Fee Share to 88% and Cutting Daily CAKE Emission
other.latest_update_zh: 提案细节进一步明确：协议费降至12%并归入国库，v2保持不变；每日7000枚CAKE排放全部划入新设立的生态增长基金Pantry，用于营销、合作及新池子引导；基于2025年交易量测算LP将多获得约6200万美元手续费；CAKE通缩仍按Tokenomics 3.0推进。
other.latest_update_en: Proposal details further specified: protocol fee reduced to 12% and directed to treasury, v2 unchanged; all 7,000 daily CAKE emissions to new Pantry ecosystem growth fund for marketing, partnerships, and new pool bootstrapping; LPs estimated to gain ~$62M more in fees based on 2025 volume; CAKE deflation remains on Tokenomics 3.0 track.

other.title_zh: OKX分阶段上线统一代币化股票现货交易
other.title_en: OKX rolls out unified tokenized stock spot trading in phases
other.latest_update_zh: OKX 将上线统一代币化股票现货交易对，包括 xSHLD 和 xSQQQ，由 xStocks（Backed Assets）支持，以 USDT 报价 24/7 交易，并支持在 Solana 和 X Layer 上充提。
other.latest_update_en: OKX will list unified tokenized stock spot pairs including xSHLD and xSQQQ, backed by xStocks (Backed Assets), with 24/7 USDT-quoted trading and deposits/withdrawals on Solana and X Layer.

other.title_zh: Anthropic 警告自主复制型 AI 蠕虫可能通过消费级物联网设备传播
other.title_en: Anthropic warns self-replicating AI worms may spread across consumer IoT devices
other.latest_update_zh: Anthropic的研究警告称，AI可能像计算机蠕虫一样在廉价消费设备间传播，研究显示GLM-5.2在模拟网络中自主完成发现-传输-运行-传播循环，Qwen3.5-9B在9种硬件类型中的8种上自我部署，而失败学习将部署成功率从45%提升至61–84%。
other.latest_update_en: Anthropic research warns that AI could spread like a computer worm across cheap consumer devices, showing GLM-5.2 autonomously completing a find-transfer-run-propagate loop in a simulated network, Qwen3.5-9B self-deploying on 8 of 9 hardware types, and failure-learning raising deployment success from 45% to 61–84%.

other.title_zh: 微软新AI芯片降低对英伟达GPU的依赖
other.title_en: Microsoft’s new AI chip makes it less reliant on Nvidia’s GPUs
other.latest_update_zh: 新增细节：微软明年可能部署超过100万颗Maia 300；Maia 300计算芯粒采用台积电2nm工艺，每颗配备288GB HBM4显存，内存带宽达18TB/s；单个机柜功率约167kW；上一代Maia 200已在Microsoft Copilot中运行，支持OpenAI、微软自家及开源模型。
other.latest_update_en: New details: Microsoft may deploy over 1 million Maia 300 units next year; Maia 300 compute dies use TSMC 2nm process, each with 288GB HBM4 memory and 18TB/s bandwidth; each rack draws about 167kW; previous-generation Maia 200 is already running in Microsoft Copilot, supporting OpenAI, Microsoft and open-source models.

other.title_zh: 【Starknet 推出隐私原语 Shadow Accounts，应用可提供隐私模式切换】
other.title_en: 【Starknet 推出隐私原语 Shadow Accounts，应用可提供隐私模式切换】
other.latest_update_zh: 补充说明影子账户是由受保护 STRK20 余额注资的独立伪名 Starknet 地址，用于在隐藏与主钱包关联的前提下参与公开 DeFi 活动；首个集成计划于次日上线。
other.latest_update_en: Added that Shadow Accounts are pseudonymous Starknet addresses funded from shielded STRK20 balances for public DeFi activity while concealing the link to the main wallet; the first integration is scheduled for the next day.

other.title_zh: Sui Devnet新增后量子签名支持，目标2027年一季度主网上线
other.title_en: Sui Devnet Adds Post-Quantum Signature Support, Targets Mainnet Rollout in Q1 20
other.latest_update_zh: 后续报道确认 ML-DSA-65 在 Devnet 协议版本 139 中作为原生账户签名方案加入，单签和多签账户均支持，验证者可验证后量子密钥授权交易；测试网和主网目前仍不接受此类签名，主网时间取决于独立审计和测试网反馈。
other.latest_update_en: Follow-up reporting confirms ML-DSA-65 was added as a native account signature scheme in Devnet protocol version 139, supporting single- and multi-signature accounts, with validators able to verify transactions authorized by post-quantum keys; Testnet and Mainnet still do not accept such signatures, and Mainnet timing depends on independent audits and Testnet feedback.

other.title_zh: IMF发现：代币化股票需求真实，但仍波动剧烈且流动性不足
other.title_en: Tokenized Stocks Show Real Demand But Remain Volatile and Illiquid, IMF Finds
other.latest_update_zh: IMF 10月《全球金融稳定报告》首次用专门章节讨论代币化市场：截至7月底，不含回购和稳定币的代币化RWA公开市场规模约650亿美元（信贷约304亿、货币市场基金约175亿、股票约23亿），代币化回购30日平均日交易量达3030亿美元；并警告代币化资产可能成为杠杆积累及流动性与期限错配的新渠道，以及稳定币/代币化存款作为主要结算工具带来的发行方信用风险和集中度风险。
other.latest_update_en: The IMF’s October GFSR dedicates its first special chapter to tokenization: tokenized RWA public market (ex repo/stablecoins) was ~$65B as of end-July (credit ~$30.4B, MMFs ~$17.5B, equities ~$2.3B) with tokenized repo 30-day average daily volume at $303B; it warns tokenized assets could become a new channel for leverage and liquidity/maturity mismatches, and flags stablecoin/tokenized-deposit settlement concentration/credit risks.

other.title_zh: DeepSeek或将完成约120亿美元融资，腾讯和宁德时代或参投
other.title_en: DeepSeek或将完成约120亿美元融资，腾讯和宁德时代或参投
other.latest_update_zh: 融资规模从此前报道的至少800亿元人民币进一步提高至约1000亿元人民币，投前估值仍约5000亿元人民币，新进产业投资方包括石溪资本、中芯聚源、CPE源峰、君联资本、吉利等。
other.latest_update_en: The funding size increased from the previously reported at least ¥80B to roughly ¥100B, with the pre-money valuation unchanged at about ¥500B and new industrial investors including Shixi Capital, SMIC Capital, CPE, Legend Capital, and Geely.

other.title_zh: 韩国下令封锁 27 家未注册海外加密货币交易所的网站，
other.title_en: South Korea Orders Website Blocks on 27 Unregistered Overseas Crypto Exchanges,
other.latest_update_zh: FIU的网站封锁措施经韩国媒体与通信标准委员会10月6-7日审议后批准；名单进一步列出Phemex、Bitrue、CoinW、BTCC、DigiFinex等交易所，并说明FIU通过韩语服务、营销和韩元交易等标准判断海外运营商是否面向韩国用户。
other.latest_update_en: The FIU's website-blocking measures were approved following reviews by the Korea Media and Communications Standards Commission on Oct. 6–7; the list further names exchanges such as Phemex, Bitrue, CoinW, BTCC, and DigiFinex, and the FIU assesses Korean targeting via Korean-language services, marketing, and KRW transactions.

other.title_zh: 英国高等法院裁决后，英国保留38亿英镑比特币查获资产的可能性上升
other.title_en: UK chances of keeping £3.8bn bitcoin haul rise after High Court ruling
other.latest_update_zh: 伦敦高等法院进一步明确，该案 61,000 BTC（约 50 亿美元/38 亿英镑）受害者索赔适用中国法律；受害者律师计划上诉，所有权归属留待后续程序。
other.latest_update_en: The London High Court further specified that Chinese law governs victims' claims to the 61,000 BTC (about $5bn/£3.8bn); victims' lawyers plan to appeal and ownership will be decided later.

other.title_zh: Federated Hermes计划于明年年初首次发行代币化基金份额
other.title_en: Federated Hermes计划于明年年初首次发行代币化基金份额
other.latest_update_zh: 管理着9110亿美元资产的Federated Hermes表示，将于明年初与数字证券基础设施提供商Prometheum合作，首次发行代币化基金份额，货币市场基金可能成为首批产品之一。
other.latest_update_en: Federated Hermes, a $911 billion asset manager, said it will issue tokenized fund shares for the first time early next year in partnership with digital securities infrastructure provider Prometheum, with money market funds possibly among the first products.

other.title_zh: 全球金融监管机构呼吁跨境信息共享，并制定稳定币危机应对计划
other.title_en: Global financial watchdog calls for cross-border information sharing, planning for stablecoin crisis
other.latest_update_zh: FSB报告详述了3000亿美元稳定币市场、99%锚定美元、关联发行人的特定风险、假名性和破产法差异，并计划在10月15日G20会议上讨论。
other.latest_update_en: FSB report details $300 billion stablecoin market with 99% USD peg, specific risks of affiliated issuers, pseudonymity and insolvency law differences, and plans for Oct 15 G20 discussion.

completed.title_zh: Term Finance 治理攻击与 Meta Vaults 关闭
completed.title_en: Term Finance governance exploit and Meta Vaults shutdown
completed.latest_update_zh: Term Finance 在攻击后永久关闭 Meta Vaults。
completed.latest_update_en: Term Finance permanently shut Meta Vaults after the exploit.

completed.title_zh: Solana 首次约束性通胀递减治理投票
completed.title_en: Solana's first binding disinflation governance vote
completed.latest_update_zh: 验证者通过提案，将通胀递减率提高至 30%。
completed.latest_update_en: Validators passed the proposal, raising the disinflation rate to 30%.

completed.title_zh: Tectonic 遭攻击并触发 Cronos 回滚
completed.title_en: Tectonic exploit triggers Cronos rollback
completed.latest_update_zh: Cronos 官方事后报告确认受影响的借贷活动约 1.204 亿美元，其中约 1.112 亿美元通过回滚恢复，但 919 万美元在验证者暂停网络前已转出。
completed.latest_update_en: Cronos official post-mortem confirms affected borrowing activity about $120.4M, with ~$111.2M reversed via rollback, but $9.19M exited before validators halted the network.

completed.title_zh: Polars 2.0预发布
completed.title_en: Pre-Release of Polars 2.0
completed.latest_update_zh: Polars 2.0 正式版发布，此前为预发布版本。
completed.latest_update_en: Polars 2.0 final release is now available, moving beyond the pre-release stage.

completed.title_zh: Coldcard 第三波被盗资金约45%已转移，比例不代表全部损失
completed.title_en: Coldcard exploiter moves 45% of funds stolen from ‘Wave 3’ attacks, Galaxy says
completed.latest_update_zh: 白帽黑客将52.37枚比特币从Coldcard黑客事件中转移至新成立的恢复信托地址；约40%的Wave 2资金被确认为白帽活动；受害者可在cryptorecoverytrust.com查询资金是否被追回；另有3.0134枚比特币无先前追踪记录流入该地址。
completed.latest_update_en: Whitehats moved 52.37 BTC from the Coldcard hack to a newly formed recovery trust; roughly 40% of Wave 2 funds identified as whitehat activity; victims can check cryptorecoverytrust.com to see if funds were recovered; an additional 3.0134 BTC with no prior tracking history flowed to the same address.

completed.title_zh: 美国参议院否决《CLARITY法案》程序性投票，加密市场结构立法受挫
completed.title_en: Coinbase CLARITY Act: Senate Cloture Vote Explained - Cryptonews
completed.latest_update_zh: 《数字资产市场清晰法案》在国会陷入停滞，促使SEC和CFTC等美国机构试图以自己的监管规则取代该立法。
completed.latest_update_en: The Digital Asset Market Clarity Act has stalled in Congress, prompting U.S. agencies like the SEC and CFTC to attempt to substitute their own regulations for the legislation.

completed.title_zh: Liquid Network 在 3.2 亿美元漏洞事件后恢复出块
completed.title_en: Liquid Network resumes block production after $320M exploit
completed.latest_update_zh: 储备覆盖率更新为85.8%，缺口约603 BTC；Liquid 表示锚定退出需完全背书并完成安全审查后方可重启。
completed.latest_update_en: Reserve coverage updated to 85.8%, shortfall ~603 BTC; Liquid says peg-outs require full backing and completed security reviews before restart.

completed.title_zh: 美联储加息几近锁定，Clarity法案投票临近
completed.title_en: Federal Reserve Rate Hike Close To A Lock ; Clarity Act Vote Looms : Week Ahead
completed.latest_update_zh: 美联储主席沃什10月16日在曼谷IMF会议期间拒绝预判年内剩余两次议息会议结果，市场对10月加息的概率从约30%降至约17%，美元走低。
completed.latest_update_en: Fed Chair Warsh on Oct 16 at the IMF meetings in Bangkok declined to pre-judge the remaining two rate decisions of the year, cutting October hike odds from about 30% to roughly 17% and weakening the dollar.

completed.title_zh: Revolut被骗向黑客交出富裕客户的护照和比特币交易记录
completed.title_en: Revolut tricked into handing hackers the passports and Bitcoin histories of wealthy customers
completed.latest_update_zh: 意大利邮政警察正在调查一起政府电子邮件泄露事件，黑客涉嫌利用该泄露获取Revolut客户数据；意大利CERT-AGID报告自2026年初以来已处理超过650起涉及滥用或非法PEC账户的案件。
completed.latest_update_en: Italian cybercrime police are investigating a government email breach that hackers allegedly used to obtain Revolut customer data; Italy’s CERT-AGID reported over 650 cases of abused or illicit PEC accounts since the start of 2026.

completed.title_zh: Balancer 提出并获批关闭协议，将国库分配给 BAL 持有者
completed.title_en: Balancer Proposes Shutting Down and Returning Its $9 Million Treasury to BAL Holders
completed.latest_update_zh: BAL 持有者已批准有序关停提案 BIP-928，分叉提案 BIP-929 未获通过；现有资金池运行至 10 月 30 日（合作方可申请将特定 V3 池延长至 11 月 30 日），期间可随时提取资金，11 月 30 日 V3 Vault 暂停，自 2027 年 5 月底起持有者可销毁 BAL 按比例获得 DAO 金库资产。
completed.latest_update_en: BAL holders approved the orderly wind-down proposal BIP-928 while the fork proposal BIP-929 was rejected; pools run normally until Oct 30 (partners may apply to extend certain V3 pools to Nov 30), withdrawals remain available throughout, the V3 Vault pauses on Nov 30, and from late May 2027 holders can burn BAL for a pro-rata share of DAO treasury assets.

completed.title_zh: XRP Ledger距离启动下一次重大支付升级仅差一票
completed.title_en: XRP Ledger is one vote away from starting its next big payments upgrade
completed.latest_update_zh: PermissionDelegationV1_1 修正案已于10月8日激活上线，账户可将支付、合规审批等限定权限授予独立账户而无需交出主密钥；官方同时警告在相关修复激活前不要委派 PaymentBurn 权限，另有关于验证者投票计数服务器缺陷的补丁仍在审议中。
completed.latest_update_en: The PermissionDelegationV1_1 amendment activated on Oct. 8, letting account owners delegate scoped powers such as payments and compliance approvals to separate accounts without sharing primary keys; users are warned not to delegate PaymentBurn until a related fix activates, and a separate server vote-counting patch remains under review.

completed.title_zh: Zcash NU7 治理提案获批并推进主网升级
completed.title_en: Zcash NU7 governance approved and mainnet upgrade advanced
completed.latest_update_zh: Zcash 的 NU7 升级已在公共测试网上激活，区块目标时间从 75 秒缩短至 25 秒，比原计划提前；60% 的交易手续费被转入未来挖矿奖励储备；旧版 Sprout 隐私系统被禁用。主网计划于 11 月 5 日启动，开发者将于 10 月 20 日审查测试结果后决定激活。
completed.latest_update_en: Zcash's NU7 upgrade activated on public testnet, cutting target block time from 75 seconds to 25 seconds ahead of schedule; 60% of transaction fees redirected to a future mining reward reserve; legacy Sprout privacy system disabled. Mainnet planned for Nov. 5, with developers to review test results and decide on activation Oct. 20.

completed.title_zh: 高盛转向，现预测美联储将在 10 月加息
completed.title_en: Bitcoin, ether swing after unanimous quarter-point Fed rate hike as Warsh takes aim at inflation
completed.latest_update_zh: 高盛改变预测，现在预计美联储将在10月再次加息，逆转此前预测。
completed.latest_update_en: Goldman Sachs now expects another Fed rate hike in October, reversing its prior forecast.

completed.title_zh: 微软与Coinbase的调查导致'EvilTokens'背后的骗子被捕，这是一个由AI驱动的DIY钓鱼网络 - fortune.com
completed.title_en: Microsoft and Coinbase probe leads to arrest of crooks behind 'EvilTokens', a DIY phishing network powered by AI - fortune.com
completed.latest_update_zh: 新增事实：Coinbase 追踪到 EvilTokens 约 110 万美元平台收入，流向四个 Tron 地址（2025 年 10 月至 2026 年 6 月）；该钓鱼服务入侵超过 12,000 个邮箱、涉及 10,000 多个组织；执法方查获 50 个网站并关停 150 多个相关域名；英国警方于 9 月 11 日逮捕两名嫌疑人，后获有条件保释。
completed.latest_update_en: New facts: Coinbase traced about $1.1 million in EvilTokens platform revenue across four Tron addresses from October 2025 to June 2026; the phishing service compromised over 12,000 inboxes across more than 10,000 organizations; authorities seized 50 websites and disabled over 150 related domains; UK police arrested two suspects on Sept. 11, later released on conditional bail.

completed.title_zh: CME 期货上市之际，比特币现金上涨 27%，比特币当日回吐涨幅
completed.title_en: CME Group to List Bitcoin Cash and Uniswap Futures Oct. 19
completed.latest_update_zh: CME公告拟上市比特币现金期货后，比特币现金盘中上涨14%，收盘涨27%，成交量超周一两倍；比特币SV上涨20%，Uniswap一度涨11%后回吐涨幅。
completed.latest_update_en: After CME announced it would list Bitcoin Cash futures, Bitcoin Cash rose 14% intraday, closed up 27% on more than twice Monday's volume; Bitcoin SV rose 20%, and Uniswap spiked 11% before giving back gains.

completed.title_zh: Neutron治理攻击致Cosmos Hub暂停并资金被盗
completed.title_en: Neutron governance attack leads to Cosmos Hub halt and fund drain
completed.latest_update_zh: 新增关键事实：在Cosmos Hub重启并扫走1.23百万ATOM后，168,990.9 ATOM因THORChain退款在七个区块后到达攻击者关联地址，未在恢复交易中被拦截，随后被转入Osmosis分批卖出约266,841 USDC并部分换成ETH；此外，攻击初始损失估计约440万美元，Neutron正筹备重启并恢复受影响合约。
completed.latest_update_en: New material facts: after Cosmos Hub restarted and swept 1.23M ATOM, 168,990.9 ATOM arrived at the attacker-linked address seven blocks later via a THORChain refund, escaped the recovery transaction, and was moved to Osmosis and sold in batches for about 266,841 USDC, partly converted to ETH; the initial attack impact was estimated at roughly $4.4M, and Neutron is preparing to restart and restore affected contracts.

completed.title_zh: Bitget 遭朝鲜关联黑客攻击，约3.88亿美元被盗
completed.title_en: Bitget Suffers DPRK-Linked Hack with Roughly $388M Stolen
completed.latest_update_zh: Chainalysis 使用内部 AI 加速追踪，将 20 多小时的手动跨链对账压缩至 10 分钟以内；新报道还补充了 Near Intents 拒绝超 5000 万美元相关兑换后自身遭攻击、THORChain 继续处理、Circle 和 Tether 冻结约 31.8 万美元稳定币等洗钱应对细节。
completed.latest_update_en: Chainalysis used in-house AI to accelerate tracing, compressing 20+ hours of manual bridge reconciliation into under 10 minutes; the report also adds laundering response details: Near Intents rejected over $50M in related swaps before being hacked itself, THORChain kept processing, and Circle and Tether froze about $318,000 in stablecoins.

completed.title_zh: KelpDAO 就 2.92 亿美元 rsETH 跨链漏洞起诉 LayerZero 及其 CEO
completed.title_en: KelpDAO sues LayerZero and CEO over $292M rsETH bridge exploit
completed.latest_update_zh: 新报道披露：原告为KelpDAO母公司Evercrest Technologies，在加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省起诉LayerZero Labs及CEO Bryan Pellegrino，指控过失、虚假陈述和诽谤，并称攻击后Kelp用户已提取超6.5亿美元；约145亿美元资产宣布从LayerZero迁移至Chainlink CCIP；LayerZero CEO称诉讼无依据。
completed.latest_update_en: New coverage discloses that plaintiff is Evercrest Technologies, KelpDAO's parent, suing LayerZero Labs and CEO Bryan Pellegrino in British Columbia on claims of negligence, misrepresentation and defamation; Kelp users have withdrawn over $650M since the attack; roughly $14.5B in assets have announced migrations from LayerZero to Chainlink CCIP; and LayerZero's CEO called the suit meritless.

completed.title_zh: Bitwise NEAR 现货 ETF 获美国上市批准并开始交易
completed.title_en: Bitwise NEAR spot ETF wins U.S. listing approval and begins trading
completed.latest_update_zh: Bitwise NEAR ETF（NRR）上线首日资产管理规模达 3600 万美元，净流入 3550 万美元，成交量为 1510 万美元。
completed.latest_update_en: Bitwise NEAR ETF (NRR) debuted with $36 million in first-day assets under management, $35.5 million in net inflows, and $15.1 million in trading volume.

completed.title_zh: Zano 在 Gateway Address 漏洞利用后回滚区块链一个月
completed.title_en: Zano rolls blockchain back a month after Gateway Address exploit
completed.latest_update_zh: Zano 发布事后分析，披露攻击者通过 Gateway Address 漏洞在 8 月 29 日和 9 月 25 日分别铸造约 1840 万枚 ZANO，共 3690 万枚未授权 ZANO 及 fUSD；攻击者支付 100 ZANO 注册费并先行测试伪造资产，首次铸造近一个月未被发现。恢复将主要通过交易所和支付服务进行，交易所将回放被回滚撤销的提款，团队将贷记受影响的存款。
completed.latest_update_en: Zano's post-mortem revealed the attacker exploited the Gateway Address vulnerability to mint about 18.4M ZANO on Aug. 29 and another 18.4M on Sept. 25, totaling 36.9M unauthorized ZANO plus fUSD; the attacker paid a 100 ZANO registration fee, tested a fabricated asset first, and the first mint went unnoticed for nearly a month. Recovery will primarily run through exchanges and payment services, with exchanges to replay withdrawals reversed by the rollback and the team crediting affected deposits.

completed.title_zh: 假冒GIWA Layer 2跨链桥被掏空766 ETH
completed.title_en: Fake GIWA Layer 2 Bridge Drained of 766 ETH
completed.latest_update_zh: 披露更多细节：DYORSWAP 因假 GIWA 链复用了真实链 ID 9134 而被骗集成，逾 1,335 个地址共桥入 767.65 ETH（约 200 万美元），资金被骗子通过 Tornado Cash 转移；疑似骗子地址由 Binance 和 Gate 出资，DYORSWAP 已向用户分发逾 200 ETH 补偿，并有团队地址在链上要求骗子归还资金。
completed.latest_update_en: More details emerged: DYORSWAP was tricked into integrating the spoofed GIWA chain because it reused the genuine chain ID 9134; 1,335 addresses bridged 767.65 ETH (~$2M), which the scammers drained and funneled through Tornado Cash. Suspected scammer addresses were funded from Binance and Gate, DYORSWAP has distributed over 200 ETH in compensation, and a team-linked address has asked the scammers on-chain to return the funds.

completed.title_zh: Anthropic发布Claude Sonnet 5.5与Sonnet 5模型
completed.title_en: Anthropic releases Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5 models
completed.latest_update_zh: Anthropic 公布 Sonnet 5.5 防蒸馏措施的初步效果：蒸馏攻击者提取的 Claude 推理 Token 减少约 90%–99%，已封禁数万个相关账号，并自 9 月 24 日起恢复对因安全防护被拦截的蒸馏类请求收费。
completed.latest_update_en: Anthropic disclosed initial results of its Sonnet 5.5 anti-distillation measures: extraction of Claude reasoning tokens by distillation attackers fell roughly 90%–99%, tens of thousands of related accounts were banned, and charging resumed since September 24 for blocked distillation-related requests.

completed.title_zh: AMD 将以超过 80 亿美元收购 AI 公司 World Labs
completed.title_en: AMD is acquiring AI company World Labs in a deal worth more than $8 billion
completed.latest_update_zh: 彭博社估计，交易完成后李飞飞净资产将至少升至16亿美元，较此前增加逾五成；她持有 World Labs 约19%股份，并在今年2月公司融资估值超50亿美元后成为亿万富豪；World Labs的研究团队和模型将获得AMD算力支持。
completed.latest_update_en: Bloomberg estimates that upon completion of the deal, Fei-Fei Li's net worth will rise to at least $1.6 billion, an increase of more than 50%; she holds about 19% of World Labs and became a billionaire after the company's February funding round valued it above $5 billion; World Labs' research team and models will receive AMD compute support.

completed.title_zh: Open Standard 稳定币 OUSD 正式上线，由 Stripe 旗下 Bridge 发行
completed.title_en: Open Standard's OUSD stablecoin goes live, issued by Stripe-owned Bridge
completed.latest_update_zh: Open USD 作为 Stripe 默认稳定币上线后，新增了分发细节：Mastercard 的分发路径通过 BVNK，Visa 提供有限测试版访问，Coinbase 计划于 10 月 1 日跟进上线。
completed.latest_update_en: After Open USD launched as Stripe's default stablecoin, new distribution details emerged: Mastercard's route runs through BVNK, Visa offers limited beta access, and Coinbase is scheduled to follow on Oct. 1.

completed.title_zh: NEAR Intents 遭攻击损失超380万美元后暂停服务并追回资金
completed.title_en: NEAR Intents exploited for over $3.8M, halts services, and recovers funds
completed.latest_update_zh: NEAR 联创 Illia Polosukhin 表示，NEAR Intents 被盗资金已在不到 24 小时内锁定责任方、建立沟通，并于 UTC 时间 14:30 全额追回；追回归功于 Intents 上的 AI 安全层 SHIELD 及侦查工作。
completed.latest_update_en: NEAR co-founder Illia Polosukhin said the stolen NEAR Intents funds were fully recovered after the responsible party was identified and contacted within 24 hours, with full recovery completed at 14:30 UTC; he credited the AI security layer SHIELD on Intents and investigative work.

completed.title_zh: 德国监管机构拒绝 MiCA 申请，Bitcoin.de 交易仍处暂停状态
completed.title_en: Bitcoin.de trading remains halted as German regulator rejects MiCA application
completed.latest_update_zh: BaFin 拒绝后，Bitcoin.de 计划通过两家受监管的德国机构重建交易和托管模式：一家作为交易对手方，另一家负责加密资产托管；平台保留应用、品牌和客户界面。客户仍可提取加密资产，但交易和欧元存款暂停，合作方尚未公布，恢复服务无确定日期；公司可在一个月内提出异议，也可能重新申请授权。
completed.latest_update_en: After BaFin's rejection, Bitcoin.de plans to rebuild trading and custody through two regulated German institutions: one as trading counterparty and one for crypto custody, while retaining its app, brand and customer interface. Withdrawals remain open, but trading and euro deposits are suspended; the partners are unidentified, no restart date is set, and the company may object within one month or reapply for authorization.

completed.title_zh: Anthropic发布Claude Haiku 5.5：价格降90%，多项评测超过GPT-6 Luna
completed.title_en: Anthropic发布Claude Haiku 5.5：价格降90%，多项评测超过GPT-6 Luna
completed.latest_update_zh: 受Claude Haiku 5.5发布带来的定价与性能竞争压力影响，港股大模型公司智谱和MiniMax股价盘中分别下跌超过6%和9%。
completed.latest_update_en: Amid competitive pricing and performance pressure from the Claude Haiku 5.5 launch, Hong Kong-listed Zhipu and MiniMax shares fell more than 6% and 9% intraday.

completed.title_zh: 【币安在阿联酋推出 bStocks，首批包括 Circle、英伟达、特斯拉等】
completed.title_en: 【币安在阿联酋推出 bStocks，首批包括 Circle、英伟达、特斯拉等】
completed.latest_update_zh: bStocks 用户持仓金额突破 10 亿美元，累计交易量超过 400 亿美元，日均交易量超过 3 亿美元，上线资产接近 100 种，自上线以来直接持股与 bStocks 的 1:1 转换规模达 60 亿美元。
completed.latest_update_en: bStocks surpassed $1 billion in user AUM, cumulative trading volume above $40 billion, average daily volume over $300 million, nearly 100 listed assets, and about $6 billion in 1:1 conversions between directly held shares and bStocks since launch.

completed.title_zh: THORChain 高管指责 Tether 暂时冻结 USDT 金库
completed.title_en: Tether Blacklists Four THORChain Vaults Holding 1.45 Million USDT
completed.latest_update_zh: Tether 在数小时后解冻了此前被列入黑名单的四个 THORChain USDT 金库地址，约 145 万 USDT 被冻结后恢复，THORChain 交易随之恢复。
completed.latest_update_en: Tether unfroze the four previously blacklisted THORChain USDT vault addresses hours later, restoring access to about 1.45 million USDT and allowing THORChain trading to resume.

completed.title_zh: XRP Ledger 披露并修复可无限铸造 XRP 的支付路径漏洞
completed.title_en: XRP Ledger patched old flaw that could create XRP from nothing
completed.latest_update_zh: 新披露该漏洞是支付引擎中的整数溢出，自 2015 年支付引擎编写以来一直存在；攻击者通过消耗数百个特制订单簿报价可使买方应付款项溢出并少付，而账本内置的“未创建 XRP”安全检查使用同样的错误算术，因此无法拦截。漏洞由 XRPL 漏洞赏金计划于 9 月报告。
completed.latest_update_en: Newly disclosed that the flaw was an integer overflow in the payment engine, present since the engine was written in 2015; an attacker could consume hundreds of specially crafted order-book offers to overflow the buyer's owed amount and underpay, while the ledger's built-in 'no XRP created' safety check used the same broken arithmetic and failed to catch it. The bug was reported through the XRPL bug bounty program in September.

completed.title_zh: 英高院裁定「钱志敏案」逾6.1万枚比特币相关权属主张适用中国法，涉案资金约41亿英镑
completed.title_en: 英高院裁定「钱志敏案」逾6.1万枚比特币相关权属主张适用中国法，涉案资金约41亿英镑
completed.latest_update_zh: 该裁决的实际后果明确：约1.6万名参与英国追索程序的中国受害者可能只能拿回本金及利息，而无法分享涉案比特币价格暴涨带来的增值收益。
completed.latest_update_en: The ruling's practical consequence was clarified: approximately 16,000 Chinese victims participating in UK recovery proceedings may recover only principal plus interest, and cannot share in the massive price appreciation of the seized bitcoin.

completed.title_zh: 美国9月CPI数据超预期
completed.title_en: U.S. September CPI exceeds expectations
completed.latest_update_zh: 9月核心CPI环比上涨0.33%，高于预期，前值为0.29%；「美联储传声筒」Timiraos称这强化了美联储年内再次加息的理由，并引发对加息时机的讨论。
completed.latest_update_en: September core CPI rose 0.33% month-over-month, hotter than expected, versus 0.29% prior; WSJ's Nick Timiraos said this reinforces the case for another Fed rate hike this year and raises timing questions.

completed.title_zh: ⚡️国际刑警逮捕HEX和PulseChain创始人Richard Heart
completed.title_en: ⚡️国际刑警逮捕HEX和PulseChain创始人Richard Heart
completed.latest_update_zh: HEX代币价格下跌近30%，市值蒸发约1.6亿美元，市场对创始人被捕消息做出反应。
completed.latest_update_en: HEX token price fell nearly 30%, erasing about $160 million in market value, as market reacted to reports of founder's arrest.

completed.title_zh: 【Upbit 将下架 Zilliqa（ZIL）】
completed.title_en: 【Upbit 将下架 Zilliqa（ZIL）】
completed.latest_update_zh: Upbit 下架公告引发市场反应，ZIL 短线暴跌超22%，跌至0.0027美元。
completed.latest_update_en: The Upbit delisting announcement triggered a market reaction: ZIL plunged over 22% intraday to $0.0027.
